tāmarai maruta nila malarāka civaperumāṉ virumpum malarāka, tamiḻ aṟiñarkaḷ pōṟṟuvar. kampaṉ maruta nilattiṉ māṇpai eṭuttukkāṭṭa eṇṇiyapoḻutu avaṉ uḷḷatti ṉiṉṟu taṇ porunai āṟṟil taṇṇīr poṅki eḻuntu varuvatu pōl, kavitai poṅkat toṭaṅkiyatu,
taṇṭalai mayilkaḷāṭat tāmarai viḷakkantāṅkak
koṇṭalkaḷ muḻaliṉ ēṅkak kuvaḷaikaḷ viḻittu nōkkat
teṇṭirai eḻiṉikāṭṭat tēmpiḻi  makarayāḻiṉ
vaṇṭukaḷ iṉitupāṭa marutam vīṟṟirukkum mātō
eṉṟu iṉitu pāṭiṉāṉ.
maruta nilam, māṟṟuyarnta poṉṉilam eṉṟu pulavarkaḷ pukaḻvar.  ēṉaiya mūṉṟu nilamakkaḷum taṅkaḷ nilattiṟkiṭaitta ceyporuḷkaḷaiyum, viḷaiporuḷaiyum maruta nilamakkaḷiṭam paṇṭamāṟṟāka aḷittu nel pul, eḷ, koḷ, payaṟu mutaliya poruḷkaḷaip peṟṟuc ceṉṟaṉar.  poruḷ vaḷattāl aṅku iyal icai nāṭakam pōṉṟa nuṇkalaikaḷ vaḷarntiruppatai makkaḷ kaṇṭukaḷittuc ceṉṟaṉar.  aṅku, eṅkum kāyum kaṉiyum niṟaintiruntaṉa.  malarkaḷ kottuk kottāy malarntu toṅkiṉa.  kampaṉ ivaṟṟaiyellām kūṟātu mayilkaḷ tāmarai malarkaḷ, kuvaḷaip pūkkaḷ vaṇṭukaḷ ākiyavaikaḷiṉ āṭṭattaiyum aḻakaiyum maṇattaiyum, rīṅkārattaiyum vaittu maruta nilattiṉ māṇpai eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟāṉ.  āṭaka araṅkil āy mayilkaḷ āṭavum anta āṭṭattiṟku ēṟṟavāṟu tāmarai taṉatu pūvākiya viḷakkaik kāṭṭutākavum, kuvaḷai malarkaḷai nāṭakam pārppavar kaḷākavum nīril eḻum alaikaḷait tiraic cīlaikaḷākavum vaṇṭukaḷiṉ iṉiya ōcaiyai yāḻākavum maruta nilam kalaiyiṉṟu vīṟṟirukkum oru perum nilappirapuvākavum oru putiya nāṭaka araṅkai namakkuk kaṟpaṉai ceytu kampaṉ kāṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.  nāṭakam, icai, viḷakku, tiraiccīlai ākiyavaikaḷ nāṭṭiyattiṟku iṉṟiyamaiyāta pāttiraṅkaḷ.  itaṉaik kampaṉ kaviṉuṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatu cuvaittu iṉpuṟattakkatākum.
iḵtaṉṟi, maruta nilattil poruḷātāra vaḷattālum, aṟiviṉ āṟṟalālum, kaṟpaṉait tiṟattālum makkaḷ civaṉai maruta nilat teyvamāka uyarttiṉar.  avaṉai viṇṇil kōṭāṉu kōṭi kal tolaivil cuḻaṉṟōṭum ceññāṉṟiṉukkum mēlum uyarttiṉar. pattarai māṟṟup pacumpoṉṉilum māṟṟuyarnta pacumpoṉṉākap pukaḻntaṉar.  avaṉ ēḻulakiṟkum ataṟku appāl eṇṇilāt tolaiviṟkum ellāp pirapañcattiṟkum mutalvaṉākak koṇṭaṉar ulakil civaṉait tavira vēṟu teyvamē illai.  ulakilē aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ kumari toṭṭu imayam varai maṭṭumalla īḻam, malayam, ciṅkapuram, cāvakam, cumattirā pōrṉiyō, tāylāntu, kampōṭiyā, antamāṉ pōṉṟa kiḻakkāciya nāṭukaḷil maṭṭumalla āppirikkā mecapottāmiyā, pāpilōṉ, cumēriyā, ellam, cīriyā, acīriyā akkēṭiyā cālṭiyā, pālatīṉam, ciṉṉa āciyā kākaca ittāli, kirīpāku turuyitiyar (Druids) amerikkā pōṉṟa nāṭukaḷukkellām ceṉṟu civaṉ eṉṉum nāmattaip parappi, kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭi, kalaivaḷarttu icai payiṉṟu paṇpāṭu parappi oḻukkam ōmpi vantaṉar.  ulakil mutaṉ mutalāka camayattai aṉṉiya nāṭṭārkkup parappa 1600- āṇṭukaṭku muṉ vantavarkaḷ kiṟittavarkaḷ eṉṟu 20  -āṇṭukaṭku muṉ cila veḷḷaiyarkaḷ kūṟivantaṉar.  50 - āṇṭukaṭku muṉ intiyā, ilaṅkai, malēciyā, ciṅkapuram, cāvakam, kampōṭiyā, tāylāntu, intōcīṉam, campāṉ, cīṉā, raciyā, koriyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkellām putta canniyācikaḷ ceṉṟu pautta neṟiyaip parappi vantaṉar eṉṟu cila vaṭa intiyarkaḷ kūṟivantaṉar.  iṉṟu, cumār aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ, caivarkaḷ caiva neṟiyai kumari toṭṭu nēppāḷam varai, parmātoṭṭu paluccitāṉ varai maṭṭumalla ekiptu, amerikkā, pāpilōṉ, pālatīṉam mutaliya ulaka nāṭukaḷ aṉaittiṟkum caiva muṉivarkaḷ ceṉṟu civaneṟiyaip parappi, tirukkōyilkaḷai eḻuppi, caivap paṇpāṭṭaiyum caivakkalaikaḷaiyum parappi vantuḷḷaṉar eṉṟum uṇmai uṇarap peṟṟuḷḷatu. 1922- ām āṇṭu cintuveḷi akaḻ āyviṟkup piṉ 5000-m āṇṭukaṭkumuṉ cintu veḷiyil civaṉ, umai, civaliṅkam murukaṉ, piḷḷaiyār, nilatteyvam, nīrtteyvam marat teyvam pōṉṟa teyvaṅkaḷ vaḻipaṭappaṭṭu vantaṉar eṉṟum āriyar varumuṉ intiyā muḻuvatum civaṉeṟi paraviyiruntatu eṉṟum intiya maiya araciṉ akaḻ ārāyccit tuṟaiyiṉar kaṇṭu ulakiṟku inta uṇmaiyai uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉai viḷakki i.pi. hēval eṉṉum aṟiñarum, pēṭrik kērlṭṭaṉ pōṉṟa aṟiñarum ulakiṟku mutaṉ mutalāka uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar atōṭu tamiḻ moḻikku ēṟṟam aḷittatil ciṟanta paṅku nallāyar kālṭuvel avarkaḷukku uṇṭu.1
oru kālattil intiyā muḻuvatum tirāviṭarkaḷum caivacamayamum niṟaivuṟṟiruntatu.  intiyāvil cumār 4000-m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ nilaviya tirāviṭarkaḷ camayam caivam eṉappaṭum.  itu intiyāviṉ tēciya matam. caivam  ulakaḷāviya paḻamperum camayam.  itu āriyam, pauttam, kiṟittavam ekōvā neṟi (yūtar neṟi), epirēyarkaḷiṉ el neṟi ākiya ellāc camayattiṟkum muntiya neṟi; nīṇṭa vāṇāḷaip peṟṟa palam vāynta paḻamperum camayam; iṉṟum iḷamai kuṉṟātu eḻil māṟātu iḷamaip polivuṭaṉ ēṟṟamuṭaṉ tikaḻum naṉṉeṟi eṉṟu poruḷ tarum muṟaiyil cintuveḷi akaḻ āyvai naṭattiya iyakkunarkaḷiṉ talaivarum, intiya maiya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvuttuṟai iyakkunarkaḷiṉ taḷapatiyumāṉa cāṇmārcal ulakiṟku eṭuttukkāṭṭiṉār.2
caivam paḻamperum camayantāṉ; ulakaḷāviya uyarnta neṟitāṉ; eṉṟālum atu cumār ki.mu. 7500-kku muṉṉar āriyarkaḷāl peruntākkutalukku āṭpaṭṭu cintu āṟṟaṅkaraiyi ṉiṉṟu taṇporunai āṟṟaṅkarai varai piṉ taḷḷappaṭṭatu.  ataṉāl caivam aḻiyavillai; citaiyavillai. āriyam, caivac caṭaṅkukaḷ palavaṟṟai taḻuviyatu; āriyarkaḷiṟ palar caivarāyiṉar. āriyap pārppaṉar āriya neṟiyait tuṟantu, āriyaneṟiyait tākki ataṉ akattaiyum mukattaiyum māṟṟiviṭṭaṉar.  pala āriyap pārppaṉar caivantaḻuvi pulāl uṇavait tuṟantu, yākattai maṟantu, uṭalil tirunīṟu aṇintu kaḻuttil uruttirākkam pūṇṭu ciciṉatēvar eṉṟu oru kālattil tam muṉṉōr iḻittuk kūṟiya civaliṅkattai vaḻipaṭa muṉvantaṉar.  cilar aṟupattu mūṉṟu nāyaṉmārkaḷiṉ iṭaṅkaḷaik kūṭa kaippaṟṟiṉar.  campantar, cuntarar, māṇikkavācakar pōṉṟōr caiva camaya kuravarkaḷāy āriya (camayattaiyum) pautta camaṇa
camayaṅkaḷaiyellām etirttu veṟṟiyīṭṭiṉar.  intiyāviṟkuḷ āriyarkaḷ intiraṉ talaimaiyil pukuntu tirāviṭarkaḷaik koñcam koñcamākat teṉ intiyāvaraip piṉ taḷḷiṉar.  itaṉāl āriyarkaḷ intiyāvil pukuntu innāṭṭil taṅkum iṭattaip peṟṟaṉar.  eṉṟālum avarkaḷ veṟṟi veṟum pōli veṟṟi eṉpatai oru āṅkilap pēraṟiñar, intiraṉ ciṟu pūcalil tirāviṭarai veṉṟāṉ; āṉāl civaṉ pōril āriyarai veṉṟāṉ eṉṟu āṇittaramāka eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.1  caivantaḻuvāta āriyarkaḷ caivam oru camayam alla eṉṟu ulakam muḻuvatum paṟai aṭittu vantaṉar.  caivattiṟku oru tattuvacātiram (Philosophy) kūṭa uṇṭu eṉṟu airōppiya tattuva ñāṉikaḷ palar aṟintu koḷḷā vaṇṇam iruṭṭaṭippuc ceytuḷḷaṉar.  pauttar kaḷum, camaṇarkaḷum muculimkaḷum, kiṟittavarkaḷum civaneṟiyait tākkit tamiḻakattil taṅkaḷ camayattiṟku āḷcērkkum paṇiyil tamiḻarkaḷukkum, tamiḻp paṇpāṭṭiṟkum, tamiḻ neṟikkum iṭarviḷaittuḷḷaṉar.  āṉāl tamiḻnāṭṭiṉ varalāṟu, tamiḻakattil nāṭṭiṟku putitāka vanta intiya tēcīyamatamallāta enta camayamum nilaittu niṟka
villai eṉṟu kūṟukiṟatu.  intiyāvaiyum, tamiḻ nāṭṭaiyum putta camaṇa neṟikaḷ āṭci celuttiya kālattil caivacamaya kuravarkaḷ tōṉṟi avviru camayarkaḷaiyum tamiḻakattiṉiṉṟu atu irunta taṭam kūṭa aṟiya muṭiyā vaṇṇam avaṟṟait tuṭaittu aḻittuviṭṭaṉar.  pautta, camaṇa camayaṅkaḷai nāṭṭaiviṭṭu viraṭṭiyaṭitta varalāṟu, tēvāra tiruvācakaṅkaḷil iṉṟum poṉṟātu poli vuṟṟut tikaḻkiṉṟatu.
aṉaittintiya neṟiyākiya camaṇattaiyum aṉaittulaka neṟiyāka niṉṟa pautta camayattaiyum mika eḷitil etirttu oru coṭṭu utiramum cintātu  intiya tēcīya neṟiyāṉa caivam veṟṟiyīṭṭiyuḷḷatu.  ayal neṟiyāḷarkaḷai veṉṟa caivacamayat talaivarkaḷil appar cariyai vaḻi niṉṟavar eṉṟum campantar kiriyai vaḻi niṉṟavar eṉṟum, cuntarar yōkaneṟi niṉṟavar eṉṟum māṇikkavācakar ñāṉaneṟi niṉṟavar eṉṟum, tamiḻ neṟiyāka eḻunta cariyai, kiriyai, yōkam, ñāṉam (aṟivu) eṉṉum pēroḷiyiṉ muṉ camaṇa pautta anniya nāṭṭu neṟikaḷ eḷitil maṟaintaṉa eṉṟum tamiḻaka varalāṟu kūṟukiṟatu.  ēḻām nūṟṟāṇṭil cēra, cōḻa, pāṇṭiya, toṇṭai nāṭṭu aracar
kaḷiṉ pērātaravai camaṇa pautta camayaṅkaḷ muṟṟākap peṟṟiruntum avaikaḷai tamiḻppaṇ iyainta oru cila tēvarāp pāṭalkaḷiṉ mūlam aṭiyaṟṟa marampōl viḻuntu maṟaintu oḻiyumāṟu ceytuviṭṭatu caivanaṉṉeṟi. maṉṉarkaḷ aṉaivarum tam tavaṟukku maṉṉippukkōri civaṉ aṭiyārkaḷ kālil vīḻntu vaṇaṅki civaṉukku āṭpaṭṭuviṭṭaṉar.
appar aṭikaḷ talaimaiyil campantar, cuntarar, māṇikka vācakar mutaliyōr āṟṟiya civat toṇṭiṉ mūlam intiya nāṭṭiṉ tēcīya neṟiyākiya civaneṟi veṟṟiyīṭṭiyatu. camaṇa pautta neṟikaḷai etirppatil civaneṟiyāḷarkaḷukku āriyarkaḷ palar tuṇai niṉṟaṉar.  ataṉ mūlam āriyarkaḷ tamiḻnāṭṭil taṅkaḷukkum taṅkaḷ moḻikkum ōraḷavu iṭam tēṭik koṇṭaṉar eṉpatu maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmaitāṉ eṉṟālum maṉōṉmaṇiyam āciriyar cuntaram piḷḷai, nellai kā. cu. piḷḷai, nākai maṟaimalai aṭikaḷ muyaṟciyāl caivamum, tamiḻum puṉitamuṟivum āriya māyaiviṭṭu akalavum orupēr iyakkattiṟku aṭi kōlap peṟṟuḷḷatu.
civaṉai vaḻipaṭum kūṭṭattār caivar eṉṟu tēvāra āciriyar kālattiṟkuc ciṟitumuṟpaṭṭup peyar vaittirukkalām  eṉṟālum ki.mu. 3000 - āṇṭaḷavil arappaṉ paṇpāṭu arumpiya kālattilē cintuveḷiyil civaṉ, āṭavallāṉ, pacupati, umātēvi pōṉṟa caivat teyvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟat toṭaṅkiyuḷḷaṉa.  iṉṟu antat teyva uruvaṅkaḷ poṟitta muttiraikaḷum, tāyattukaḷum ērāḷamākak kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa.
ātikālat tamiḻar vaḻipaṭṭa cemporuḷākiya civattiṟku caṅka kālattilum ataṟku muṉṉarum iṟaiyōṉ, kaṭavuḷ, periyōṉ eṉṟa peyarkaḷ kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  nutal vaḻi nāṭṭat tiṟaivaṉ, eṉa maṇimēkalaiyilum kaṭavuḷ eṉa puṟanāṉūṟṟilum piṟavā yākkaip periyōṉ eṉac cilappatikārattilum cemporuḷ eṉṟu tirukkuṟaḷilum kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa. pala aṟiñarkaḷ īcaṉ, kaṇṇutaṟ peruṅkaṭavuḷ, mukkaṇṇaṉ, vēlaṉ, cūlaṉ, caṭaiyaṉ, mukkaṭ kaṭavuḷ, maṅkaipaṅkaṉ, muḻumutaṟkaṭavuḷ eṉṟellām kūṟivantuḷḷaṉar.
mēlum civaṉ, ciyaṉ, cipā, ciyōṉ, el, elcaṭai, viricaṭai, al, il, ol pāl, (pakal) āṇpil acur, attāt, ṭayōṉica, martūk naṉṉar, taṅkaḷ eṉṟa peyarkaḷil palvēṟu nāṭukaḷil civaperumāṉ vaḻipaṭappaṭṭuḷḷār.  avar kāḷai mītu niṟpatum, avar kaiyil tiricūlam tāṅki niṟpatum avar civaṉ eṉpatai uṟutippaṭuttum civa vaḻipāṭṭait toṭarntu umātēvi vaḻipāṭum nanti vaḻipāṭum civaliṅka vaḻipāṭum pala nāṭukaḷil paravi uḷḷaṉa.
niṟka, makkaḷ tamiḻakattil mikat toṉmaiyāṉa kālattilē teyva vaḻipāṭṭait toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉar.  paḻaṅkaṟkālattilē āla marattiṉ aṭiyil oru ciṟiya kuraṭu eḻuppi atil oru kallai nāṭṭi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉar.  oru ciṟiya kaṭuku pōṉṟa vittiṉiṉṟu muḷaittuk kiḷaittu paṉṉūṟu pēr taṅkak kūṭiya periya marattiṉ kīḻ taṅkaḷ teyva uruvaṅkaḷai vaittu vaḻipaṭum iṭamākak koṇṭaṉar.
tamiḻarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷ ātiyil iṟaivaṉaik kallāla marattiṉ kīḻ kaṇṭaṉar eṉpatu tamiḻarkaḷiṉ aitīkam; nampikkai; uṟuti. tamiḻarkaḷiṉ teyva vaḻipāṭu mutaṉ mutalāka ālamarattiṉ aṭiyiṉiṉṟu arumpiyatu eṉṟu aṉumāṉikkappaṭukiṟatu.  makēntiramalaiyil civaperumāṉ taṭcaṇāmūrttiyāy atāvatu teṉmukak kaṭavuḷāy, kurumūrttamāy  kal ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil amarntu caṉakar, caṉāntarar, caṉaṟkumārar, ākiya nāṉku tamiḻ muṉivarkaḷukku nāṉmaṟaikaḷai aruḷiṉār eṉṟu tamiḻarkaḷiṉ camayanūṟkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  ataṉāl civaperumāṉai ālamar kaṭavuḷ eṉṟu iṉṟum pōṟṟi varukiṉṟārkaḷ.

coṉṉa ākamam tōṟṟuvit taruḷiyum - 
eṉṟa tiruvākku atai uṟutippaṭuttukiṟatu.
ālamaram, tamiḻarkaḷiṉ uḷḷattiṟku ukantatāyum karuttaik kavarntatāyum iruntatu.  aṇup pōṉṟa oru ciṟiya kaṭukupōṉṟa vitaiyiṉiṉṟu eḻunta oru nīṇṭa paranta periya maram taṉ nīṇṭa kiḷaikaḷait tāṅka iṭai iṭaiyē viḻutu viṭṭu nilattait toṭṭu, vērviṭṭuḷḷatu.  periya pantalait tāṅka iṭai iṭaiyē tūṇkaḷ naṭṭiyatu pōl viḻutukaḷ vērviṭṭu maram evvaḷavu peritākap paṭarntālum kiḷaikaḷ noṭintu viḻāmal tāṅki niṟpataiyum paṉṉūṟu makkaḷ ataṉ aṭiyil taṅki ataṉ niḻalai nukarntum paḻattait tiṉṟu makiḻvataiyum tamiḻarkaḷ kaṇṭu viyantaṉar.  ālamarattaiyum ataṉ payaṉaiyum aṟintu ataṉaip puṉita maramāka eṇṇip pōṟṟiṉar.
āla marattiṉ aṭiyil maṇṇaik kuvittu mēṭākki ataic camataḷamākac ceytu, antac camataḷamāka uḷḷa kuraṭṭiṉ naṭuvil oru mukkōṇa vaṭivilāṉa kallaiyō, allatu nīṇṭa marakkaṭṭaiyaiyō, naṭṭu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  mukkōṇa vaṭivamāṉa kal tāyiṉ ciṉṉamākavum, nīṇṭa marak kompu tantaiyiṉ ciṉṉamākavum karutappaṭṭatu.  ulakil mutalil tāy āṭciyum tāy vaḻipāṭum nilaviyatu.  appāl tantai āṭciyum tantait teyva vaḻipāṭum nilaviyatu eṉṟu pala camūka iyal nūlai uṇarnta aṟiñarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.
ūr tōṟum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil tiruuruvam amaittu vaḻipaṭum oru marapu tamiḻakattil eḻuntatu.  inta vaḻipaṭum iṭam potu il eṉappaṭṭatu.  appāl atu ampalamāka māṟiyatu.  ampalattil teyvat tiruuruvam iṭampeṟṟatu. ampalattil teyvam uṟaiyum  taṟiyākiya tūṇ oṉṟu naṭappaṭṭatu.  nīrāṭit tūymai yuṭaiyōrāy makaḷir ampalattai aṭaintu meḻuki, kōlamiṭṭu, nantā viḷakkēṟṟi malar tūvi pōṟṟi vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  piṉṉar pakaivarkaḷ ūriṉiṉṟu ciṟaipiṭittu vanta makaḷiraiyum inta vaḻipāṭṭil īṭupaṭac ceytaṉar.  ūrukkup putiyavarkaḷ vantāl ampalattil taṅkuvatum uṇṭu.  paṭṭiṉappālai eṉṉum paḻam perum caṅka nūl aṭiyil varumāṟu kūṟukiṟatu.
koṇṭi makaḷir uṇṭuṟai mūḻki
anti māṭṭiya nantā viḷakkiṉ
malaraṇi meḻukkam ēṟippalar toḻa
vampalar cērkkum kantuṭaip potiyil -
ippāṭṭiṟku nacciṉārk kiṉiyar, pakaivar maṉaiyōrāyp piṭittu vanta makaḷir palarum, nīruṇṇun tuṟaiyilē ceṉṟu muḻuki, meḻukum vaḻakkattiṉaiyum avarkaḷ anti kālattē koḻuttiṉa aviyāta viḷakkattiṉaiyum naṟumaṇam nāṟum nalla pūkkaḷaiyum cūṭṭiya taṟiyiṉaiyuṭaiya ampalam eṉṟu kūṟukiṟār.  kantu teyvam uṟaiyum taṟiyākum.  vampalar cērkkum potiyil putiyavarkaḷ palarum ēṟit toḻuvataṟkum taṅkuvataṟkum uriya iṭamāyiṟṟu potiyilai meḻuki viḷakkum iṭṭirukka vampa makaḷirai vaittār.  ataṉāl tamakkup pukaḻ uḷatām eṉṟu karutiṉar eṉṟu virivurai tarappaṭṭatu.
ivvāṟu tamiḻarkaḷ ūr tōṟum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantiṉai vaittu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantu vaittu vaḻipaṭum iṭam ālamuṟṟam eṉappēr peṟṟatu.

poykai cūḻnta poḻiṉmaṉai makaḷir -  
eṉap puṟanāṉūṟṟuc ceyyuḷ pukaḻkiṟatu.
ālamar kaṭavuḷ aṉṉa niṉ celvam 
vēlkeḻu kuricilkaṇ ṭēṉākaliṉ
eṉṟa puṟanāṉūṟṟuc ceyyuḷum ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil araṉāriṉ tiru uruvai vaittu vaḻipaṭuvatu paṇṭaik kālat tamiḻar marapu eṉpatai naṉku pulappaṭukiṟatu.
ātikālattil tamiḻarkaḷ ālamarattiṉ aṭiyil kantuvai vaittu vaḻipaṭṭa vaḻakkam nīṇṭa kālamāka avarkaḷ kumukāyattai viṭṭu akalavillai.  ālamaraṅkaḷ illāta ūril taṅkaḷ ūril uḷḷa vēṟu maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil teyva uruvaṅ kaḷai vaittu vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.
tamiḻar kumukāyam vaḷarcci peṟṟu kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭi ataṉ uḷḷē teyva uruvaṅkaḷai vaittu vaḻipaṭum nākarikam eḻunta kālattum avarkaḷ ātikālattil teyva uruvaṅkaḷai vaittu vaḻipaṭṭa marattai maṟakkavillai.  atai tala viruṭcamākak koṇṭu kōyiluḷ ataṟku oru ciṟappāṉa iṭam aḷittuḷḷaṉar.  tirupputtūril talaviruṭcam koṉṟai, akattiyāṉ paḷḷiyil tala viruṭcam vaṉṉimaram,  tiruvāṭāṉaiyil  tala viruṭcam vilvamaram,  tiruāmarttūril tala viruṭcam vaṉṉi maram,  tiruāṉaikkāvil tala viruṭcam veṇṇāval, tirukaḷ eṉṟum ūriṉ tala viruṭcam pāricātam, cikkal eṉṉum ūriṉ talaviruṭcam mallikai; tirunelvēli nellaiyappar kōyil talaviruṭcam mūṅkil, tirukkuṟṟālattil talaviruṭcam palāmaram;  tiruvīḻimiḻalaiyil tala viruṭcam vīḻic ceṭi;  maturaiyil tala viruṭcam kaṭappamaram; tiruppātirip puliyūril tala viruṭcam pātiri maram, tiruppukalūril tala viruṭcam puṉṉaimaram;  tirumaḻapāṭiyil talaviruṭcam paṉaimaram;  tirunellikkāvil talaviruṭcam nellimaram; ivvāṟu ovvoru ūrilum ovvoru maram tala viruṭcamāka uḷḷatu.  itu tirukkōyil eḻumuṉ ātiyil marattiṉ kīḻ teyva uruvam vaittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭatu eṉpatai naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.

maṉṟamum potiyilum kantuṭai nilaiyum
eṉṟa tirumurukāṟṟup pāṭalum muṟkālattil maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil kāṭukaḷilum mēṭukaḷilum, āṟṟaṅkaraikaḷilum,  kuḷakkarai kaḷilum, kaṭaṟkaraikaḷilum kuṉṟukaḷilum, maṉṟukaḷilum teyva uruvaṅkaḷ vaittu vaḻipaṭappaṭṭu vantaṉa eṉpatai eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.
periya nākarikam eḻunta ikkālattum perumpālāṉa teyvattiru uruvaṅkaḷ maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyilē iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  perumpālum oru ūrukku iraṇṭu mūṉṟu piḷḷaiyār uruvaṅkaḷ irukkum.  avaikaḷ perumpālum vēmpu, aracu maraṅkaḷ aṭiyilē iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  cila ūrkaḷiltāṉ piḷḷaiyār kōyilil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷār.
iḵtaṉṟi tamiḻ nāṭṭil pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avaikaḷ perumpālum nāṉku puṟamum cuvar eḻuppap peṟṟu mēlē caṭṭamum viṭṭamum vaittu malluk kaikaḷ vaittu ōṭukaḷ vēynta kūraik kōyilkaḷil iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
iṉṟum ciṟṟūrkaḷilum, ēṉ? pērūrkaḷilum cila tāyt teyvaṅkaḷukku aṭi peruttum nuṉi ciṟuttum caturat tūṇ vaṭivil 4, 5 aṭimutal 8 varai maṇṇāl kaṭṭap peṟṟō, allatu ceṅkaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭappeṟṟō mēlē cuṇṇaccāntu pūcappeṟṟa pīṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. cila pīṭaṅkaḷil teyva uruvaṅkaḷum palavita vaṇṇattil tīṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
ātikālattil oṉṟu allatu nāṉku aintu āka irunta teyvaṅkaḷ palavāki āyirakkaṇakkāṉa kōyilkaḷaip peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.

kaṭṭiṭak kalai 
kaviṉ kalaikaḷil kaṭṭiṭak kalai oṉṟu.  kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyaiviṭa, makkaḷukku iṉṟiyamaiyāta kalai etuvum illai.  makkaḷiṉ uṭal nalattiṟku ūṟu viḷaivikkum veyyil maḻai, kāṟṟu iṉṉōraṉṉa iyaṟkaiyiṉ kōpattiṟkut tappuvikka  maṉitaṉ uṟaiyuḷai uruvākkiṉāṉ.  muṟkālattil illaṅkaḷ makkaḷaik koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷiṉ pacikku tappum araṇkaḷāvum viḷaṅkiṉa.
ātikālattil maṉitaṉ kāṭukaḷil vilaṅkukaḷiṉ naṭuvē, vilaṅkukaḷ pōl vāḻntu vantāṉ.  avaṉukku akkālattil uṭukka uṭaiyum, paṭukkap pāyum uṇṇa uṇavum, oṇṭak kuṭicaiyum iṉṟi aṅkum iṅkum alaintu tirintāṉ.  avaṉ uyirai ōmpa uṭalaip pātukākkat talaippaṭṭāṉ.  uṇavup poruḷkaḷaic cēkarikka muṟpaṭṭāṉ.  vilaṅkukaḷai etirttu veṭṭavum, marañceṭi koṭikaḷait tuṇṭikkavum, maraṅkaḷi luḷḷa paḻaṅkaḷai kīḻē vīḻttavum kaṟkaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttavum muṉ vantāṉ.  kal avaṉatu vāḻkkaiyiṉ muṉṉēṟṟattiṟkum, ciṟappiṟkum nākarikattiṟkum tuṇaiyāka iruntatu.
makkaḷ nāḷaṭaivil paṭippaṭiyāka nākarikam aṭaintaṉar.  aṟivu vaḷarcci peṟṟaṉar.  vacikka vīṭum pucikka uṇavum uṇṭākkik koḷḷa uṇarntaṉar.  vilaṅkiṉ oru pirivāka vāḻnta maṉitaṉ aṟivāṟṟal peṟṟu nākarika vāḻkkaiyai eytiṉāṉ.  avaṉ nākarika vāḻkkaiyai aṭaivataṟkup pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷ kaḻintaṉa.
maṉita vāḻkkaikku iṉṟiyamaiyāta uṇavu, uṭai uṟaiyuḷ ākiyavaṟṟaip peṟa  iṭaiviṭātu muyaṉṟāṉ avaṉatu ariya muyaṟciyiṉ payaṉāy palavitat toḻilkaḷai uṇarntāṉ.  mutalil avaṉ payirt toḻilait toṭaṅkiṉāṉ.  appāl nūl nūṟkavum necavu neyyavum, vīṭu kaṭṭavum vaḻikaṇṭāṉ.
avaṉatu paṭṭaṟiviṉ payaṉāka toḻilkaḷ pala nāṭṭil urup peṟṟeḻuntaṉa.  oru toḻilai uṇarntu atai niṟaivāṉa toḻilāka viḷaṅkac ceyvataṟku maṉitaṉ paṉṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷaik kaṭakka nērntatu ulakil maṉitaṉ pala toḻilkaḷaip paṭaittāṉ.  avaṉ toḻilkaḷaip paṭaippataṟku uyarnta karuvikaḷai uruvākkiṉāṉ.  avaṉ kaṇṭa toḻilukku iṉṟiyamaiyāta uyarnta mūlapporuḷkaḷaik kāṇa pala iṭaṅkaḷukkum ceṉṟu alaintu tirintuḷḷāṉ.  appāl avaṉ aritiṟ kaṇṭa toḻilkaḷai eḷitāka muṭikkavum eḻil peṟac ceyyum muyaṟci ceytāṉ avaṉatu muyaṟciyil avaṉ periya veṟṟiyai īṭṭiṉāṉ.  avaṉatu kaivaṇṇam meyvaṇṇattaiyum veṉṟatu.  ciṟpat toḻilāḷi teyvam pōl uyarntāṉ.  avaṉ paṭaitta ciṟpap poruḷkaḷ iyaṟkaiyaiyum veṉṟaṉa.  avaṉ teyvattai yum viñci viṭṭāṉ eṉṟu pulavarkaḷ pukaḻ mālai cūṭṭiṉar.
maṉitaṉ ātiyil uṇavup poruḷaic cuṭṭuttiṉṉat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ. appāl atai neyyiliṭṭu vatakkic cāppiṭavum, uppu, puḷi, miḷaku mutaliyavaṟṟaic cērttu aṟucuvaiyuṭaṉ uṇṇavum terintāṉ.
avaṉ melliya nūlai nūṟkavum, aḻakiya āṭaikaḷai neyyavum, tuṇikaḷukku civappu, mañcaḷ, karuppu, nīlam, ūtā pōṉṟa eṇṇilā vaṇṇaṅkaḷai ūṭṭavum vaḻi kaṇṭāṉ.  āṭaikaḷil paṟavai, vilaṅku, ceṭi, koṭi, ilai, pū, kāy pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷait tīṭṭi eḻil mikum uṭaikaḷai aṇiya muṉ vantāṉ.  paṭṭāṭaikaḷaiyum, kampaḷi āṭaikaḷaiyum ceytu aṇintu akamakiḻntāṉ.
avaṉ ātiyil ōlaik kuṭicaikaḷait tāṉ kaṇṭāṉ.  appāl maṇ cuvarkaḷai nāṟpuṟamum eḻuppi mēlē ōlaikaḷāl kūrai vēyntu atil uṟaintāṉ.  piṉ maravīṭukaḷaiyum, ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum kalantu cuvar eḻuppi mēlē  marattiṉāl caṭṭamum viṭṭamum, mallukaḷum, paṭṭiyalkaḷum amaittu kūraikku ōṭu vēyntāṉ.  piṉṉar cuvarkaḷiṉ mītu uttaramum, kaṭṭaikaḷum vaittuk kaṭṭi ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum cērttu mēṟṟaḷam iṭṭu maṭṭap pāy vīṭukaḷaik kaṭṭiṉāṉ.  piṟaku oṉṟiraṇṭu māṭikaḷaiyum amaittāṉ.  vīṭukaḷil tūṇkaḷum, palakaṇikaḷum, nilaikaḷum, katavukaḷum, uttaramum, kaṭṭaikaḷum, palakaikaḷum, pōtikaikaḷum iṭam peṟṟaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ muṟṟam, tāḻvāram paṭṭālai, iraṇṭām kaṭṭu, araṅku, tuyiliṭam, aṭukkaḷai, paṇṭaka cālai, nilā muṟṟam pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷaip peṟṟaṉa.  kaṭṭiṭam ciṟṟillam, māḷikai, araṇmaṉai, kōyil, kaḷañciyam, araṇ pōṉṟu palavakaiyāy vaḷarcciyuṟṟatu.
maṉitaṉ tāṉ kaṇṭa ellāt toḻililum ellāt tuṟaiyum nuṇṇuṇarvaic celutti avaikaḷai aḻaku peṟavum, cuvaiyuṟavum, uṟuti poliyavum, iṉimai ceṟiyavum ceytāṉ.  ivaṟṟai maṉitaṉ kalai eṉṟu kūṟiṉāṉ.  makkaḷ kaṇṭa uṇavu, uṭai, uṟaiyuḷ pōṉṟavaikaḷil maṭṭumalla maruttuvam, ōviyam, nāṭakam, nāṭṭiyam, eḻuttu, moḻi, icai pōṉṟavai aṉait tilum kalaiyaip pukuttiṉāṉ. kalai eṭṭāka eḻuntu eṭṭeṭṭāka aṟupattu nāṉkāka malarntu nūṟṟeṭṭāka uyarntu iṉṟu āyirat teṭṭāka vaḷarntu mēlum eṇṇaṟṟa tāka virintuḷḷatu.
makkaḷatu aka uṇarcciyiṉ teḷivāṉa nilaiyiṉiṉṟē perukkeṭuttu veḷit tōṉṟum cīriya kalai uṇarcciyiṉ payaṉākattāṉ ulakam kaṇṭu viyantu pōṟṟum ulakil oppaṟṟa cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ malarntatu.  aḻakuṇarcciyiṉ ariya nuṇukkamē avaṉi pōṟṟum ajantā ōviyamāka uruppeṟa muṭintatu.  kalaiyiṉ nuṇṇiya eḻucciyē ellōrākkukaic ciṟpamāka kāntārak kaviṉ ciṟpamākat tuḷirtteḻuntatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷil kaivaṇṇac ciṟappē tillai āṭa vallaṉāy, nellaik kūttaṉāy, kōṉērirācapuram ampalavāṇaṉāy eḻil peṟṟilaṅkumpaṭi ceytatu.  cōḻa nāṭṭu kaṭṭiṭak kalai vallunarkaḷiṉ aḷappaṟiya ciṟpac ciṟappē tañcaip peruvuṭaiyār kōyilāka ulakil oppaṟṟa viṇmuṭṭum vimāṉamāy eḻuntōṅkumpaṭi ceytatu.
kaṭṭiṭak kalai makkaḷ kaṇṭakaviṉ kalai oṉṟu.  atu naṉṟāṉa nākarikak kalai eṉṟum kūṟalām.  kaṭṭiṭak kalai, makkaḷ vāḻviṟku iṉṟiyamaiyāta ēṟṟamuṟṟa eḻiṟkalai eṉṟum collalām.  kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyil, toḻil nuṭpam, aḻaku, kaṟpaṉai ākiya mūṉṟu uyariya nilaikaḷai oruṅkē peṟṟa oppaṟṟa kalaiyāyiṟṟu.  kaṭṭiṭam kaṭṭuvataṟku ceṅkal ceyyum toḻil, kottu vēlai, taccuvēlai, irumpu vēlai, kaṭṭiṭap paṭam varaiyum vēlai mutaliya toḻilkaḷiṉ nuṭpam terintirukka vēṇṭiyatāyiṟṟu kaṭṭiṭam uṟutiyākavum uyaramākavum, vicālamākavum maṭṭum iruntāṟ pōtātu.  atil  vāḻpavarkaḷiṉ vacatikku uriyatākavum, cukātārattiṟku ēṟṟatākavum uḷḷattiṟku uvakai aḷippatākavum eḻil nalam vāyntatākavum irukka vēṇṭum.  uṟaiyuḷ kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpamākac ciṟantirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟāl atu kāṇpavarkaḷiṉ kaṟpaṉaiyait tūṇṭat takkatākat tulaṅka  vēṇṭum.  kaṟpaṉai palavakaikaḷil tūṇṭap peṟalām.  cila kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ varalāṟṟut toṭarpāl kaṟpaṉaiyaik kavaralām.  cila kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ ataṉ puṉitat taṉmaiyāl makkaḷ uḷḷattaik kavarak kūṭum.  kaṟpaṉaiyait tūṇṭak kūṭiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaiyellām kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eṉṟu kūṟa muṭiyātu.  kavarcci aḻakiṉ aṭippaṭaiyil amaintirukka vēṇṭum.  kaṭṭiṭam ciṟitākavō, peritākavō, putitākavō, paḻaiyatākavō, kuḷḷamākavō, uyaramākavō-eppaṭiyum irukkalām.  āṉāl atu aḻaku amaintatāy ciṟpa nuṭpam ceṟivatāy irukka vēṇṭum.  avvāṟu iruntāl atu kaṭṭiṭa ciṟpam eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭum.  aḻaku eṉpatu kaṟpaṉaiyai tūṇṭum vēlaippāṭṭaik kuṟippatākum.
oru nāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭac  ciṟpak kalai vaḷarccikku mūlatāramāy amaintuḷḷatu avarkaḷ camayaṅkaḷākum.  avai kaṭṭiṭak kalai vaḷarccikku aṭi kōliyatu  poṉṉē pōl pōṟṟi vaḷarttatu.  mēlum atu ciṟappākak kōyil kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyaip pēṇivaḷarttatu.  camayam vaḷartta kōyilkaḷ, paṭimakkalaikku uṟaiviṭamāy iruntaṉa.  kōyilkaḷ, icai, nāṭakam, nāṭṭiyam, kaṇitam, uṇavu, aṇikalaṉ, tiruviḷakku, āṭaikaḷ, kalveṭṭu, ceppēṭukaḷ, icaik karuvikaḷ, veḷḷi, cempup pāttiraṅkaḷ, ōviyam iṉṉōraṉṉa eṇṇilāk kalaikaḷaiyum vaḷarttaṉa.  avaṟṟai kalaip poruḷkaḷaikkākkum kalai araṇkaḷ eṉṟu kūṟiṉum cālap poruntum.  intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kalai āyvut tuṟai vallunarāka matikkappaṭum aṟiñar tiru. perkūcaṉ avarkaḷ, kaṭavuḷ vaḻipāṭṭiṟkākak kōyil kaṭṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟa ārvamē ellōrum viyantu pōṟṟum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ tōṉṟuvataṟku mūlātāramāy iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟiyatu āḻnta karuttuṭaiyatākum.  iṟaivaṉ uṟaivataṟku ēṟṟa iṭattai uruvākka vēṇṭum eṉṟa ārvam kalai vaḷarccikku iṉṟiyamaiyāta karupporuḷai uṇṭākkiyatu.  anta māperum nōkkattiṉ tūṇṭutal eṇṇilāk kōyilkaḷai eḻuppiyatu.  maṉṉarkaḷum makkaḷum kaviṉ peṟum kalaik kōyilkaḷai uruvākkiṉar.  eṉavē kōyil, ellāk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaiyum viṭa kaviṉuṟum vaṉappuḷḷatāy, eṉṟum poṉṟāta uṟutiyuḷḷatāy ulakam viyakkum uyarnta nilaiyil ki.pi. aintām nuṟṟāṇṭil, cōḻap pēraracaṉ kōcceṅkaṇāṉ eḻupatu māṭak kōyilkaḷai eṭuppittāṉ.  irācarācaṉ ulakil uyarnta vimāṉattaiyuṭaiya tañcaip peruvuṭaiyar kōyilai eṭuppittāṉ.  itu paktiyiṉ ciṉṉam.  mokalāya maṉṉaṉ  ṣājakāṉ taṉ maṉaiviyiṉ niṉaivāka ulakilē vilaiyuyarnta aḻakiya maṇi māḷikaiyāka matikkap peṟum tājmakālai eḻuppiṉāṉ.  itu kātaliṉ ciṉṉam.  iraṇṭum intiyak kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ kaṇ eṉak karutappaṭupavai.  ulakilē paktiyum kātalum ulakil uyarnta kaṭṭiṭak kalaikaḷai eḻuppuvataṟku aṭippaṭaiyāy iruntaṉa eṉpatu naṉku teriya varukiṟatu.   tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷ campantapaṭṭa maṭṭil avarkaḷiṉ araṇmaṉaikaḷ eṉṟu kūṟattakkavaikaḷ etuvum kāṇappaṭavillai.  āṉāl avarkaḷ eḻuppiya kōyilkaḷ āyiram āyiram āṇṭukaḷ ākiyum aḻiyātu nilaittu niṟkiṉṟaṉa.  namatu māmaṉṉarkaḷ taṅkaḷukku uyarnta araṇmaṉaiyai amaittiruntaṉarkaḷā?  ciṉṉañ ciṟu kallil vāḻntiruntaṉarā eṉṟa aiyappāṭṭaik kūṭa eḻuppuvatāka uḷḷatu.  atu evvāṟāyiṉum irukkaṭṭum, avarkaḷ taṅkaḷuk keṉṟu vilaiyuyarnta kōyilkaḷai (araṇmaṉaikaḷai)  amaippatai viṭa iṟaivaṉukkeṉṟu kōyil amaippatilum, avai eṉṟum nilaittu niṟpatilum atu ulakam uḷḷaḷavum iruntu eppoḻutum pūcai, naivēttiyaṅkaḷ naṭaipeṟuvatilum atika akkarai koṇṭiruntārkaḷ eṉpatai avarkaḷ kōyilkaḷukku aḷitta nipantaṅkaḷum, kalveṭṭukaḷum, ceppēṭukaḷum naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭupavaiyāka uḷḷaṉa.
ulakilē intiyāviltāṉ atikamāṉa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  atilum eṉṟum aḻiyāta kaṟkōyilkaḷ uyariya ciṟpaṅkaḷai yuṭaiya aḻakiya kōyilkaḷ uṇṭeṉṟu ellā nāṭṭaṟiñarkaḷ karutukiṉṟārkaḷ.
ulakilē uyarnta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaiyum, tirukkōyilkaḷai yum, araṇkaḷaiyum amaikkum paṇpum marapum tiṟaṉum tirāviṭa iṉattiṟkē uṇṭu.  ulakilē enta nāṭṭilāyiṉum āyiram āṇṭiṟku muṉ uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ irukkiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟappeṟṟāl atu niccayam tirāviṭarkaḷāl allatu avarkaḷatu iratta campantamāṉa uṟaviṉarkaḷāl eṭuppikkappaṭṭatāka irukkum eṉṟu aimpatu āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ  eṉatu tantaiyār tiru.vaṭi. aruṇācalakkavirāyar avarkaḷ kūṟiṉārkaḷ.  aṉṟu avarkaḷ kūṟiya kūṟṟil eṉakku nampikkai illai.  iṉṟu avarkaḷatu vārttaiyil 100kku 100 catavikitam uṇmaiyirukkiṟatu eṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ.
kaviṉ peṟum kaṭṭiṭam etu?  ciṟanta kalai etu?  makkaḷukku iṉṟiyamaiyāta paṇi etu?  eṉpatu kālattiṟkuk kālam māṟu paṭum.  nāṭṭiṟku nāṭu māṟupaṭum.  iṉattiṟku iṉam vēṟupaṭum.  makkaḷiṉ eṇṇam, nōkkam, aḻakuṇarcci avarkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷarcci, poruḷātāra nilai, taṭpa veppa nilai, kiṭaikkak kūṭiya poruḷkaḷ nākarikam pōṉṟavai kaṭṭiṭac ciṟpattiṉ amaippai, tarattai nirṇayam ceyyat tuṇaiyāy iruntu vantuḷḷaṉa.
paṇṭaik kālattiya ekiptiya nāṭṭu makkaḷiṉ vāḻkkai aṟivulakam eṉṟum āḻntu cintikkat takkatāy amaintuḷḷatu.  oru puṟam koṭiya kōra nilaiyaiyuṭaiya pālaivaṉam.  maṟṟoru pakkam eṅkum pacumaiyai parappi eḻil tarum ceṭi koṭi kaḷaiyum, kottuk kottākap pūttuk kuluṅkum vaṇṇa malarkaḷaiyum, tiraṇṭa kāykaḷaiyum, paḻuttut toṅkum iṉiya paḻak kulaikaḷaiyum, uyarnta uṇavup poruḷāṉa vāṟ kōtumai vayalkaḷai piṟa vāḻkkaikku iṉṟiyamaiyāta poruḷkaḷai ceḻittu vaḷaracceyyum Ús(Neela)  nīla āṟṟaṅkaraikaḷil uḷḷa ūrkaḷilum atai aṭuttuḷḷa nakarkaḷilum ciṟṟūr kaḷilum vāḻntavarkaḷ. avarkaḷ tirāviṭa iṉattiṉ neruṅkiya  uṟaviṉarkaḷ.  atai avarkaḷ camayamum, teyvaṅkaḷum, moḻiyum paṇpāṭum varalāṟum kalaikaḷum uṟutippaṭuttukiṉṟaṉa.  avarkaḷ cāviṟku añciyatillai.  maraṇam oru muṭivāṉa nilai eṉṟu nampiyatillai.  uyir uṭalai viṭṭup pirivatu uṇmai.  āṉāl atu uyiriṉ iṟutinilai alla.  cāvu uyirkaḷukku eḻum oru māṟṟu nikaḻcciyait taviṟa vēṟalla.  oruvaṉuṭaiya uyir uṭalai viṭṭu nīṅkiya piṉ - atāvatu ivvulakait tuṟantapiṉ vēṟu ulakiṟ ceṉṟu ellā vāḻkkai nalattaiyum peṟṟu iṉpuṟṟu vāḻntu varum eṉpatu paṇṭaiya ekiptiya makkaḷiṉ nampikkai.  eṉavē avarkaḷ uyirtuṟanta piṉṉarum uṭalai keṭātavāṟu maruntiṭṭu peṭṭikaḷil vaittu avarkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya poruḷkaḷai yellām vaittu putaittu camāti eḻuppiṉar.  aṉṟu avarkaḷ eḻuppiya camātikaḷiṉ kōpuraṅkaḷē (piramiṭukaḷē) kōyilkaḷāka malarntaṉa.  nilaiyāṉa pēṟum uṟutiyum ekiptiya makkaḷiṉ kuṟikkōḷāka iruntaṉa.  avarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷaip pōl periya kal tūṇkaḷ viṭṭu, kal uttaraṅ
kaḷai vaittu periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷai eḻuppiṉar.  avarkaḷ nāṭṭil takutiyāṉa kaṟkaḷ kiṭaikkavillai.  veḷināṭu
kaḷiṉiṉṟu mikunta ciramappaṭṭu kaṟkaḷaik koṇṭu kallālāṉa camātik kōpuraṅkaḷai eṭuppittaṉar.  cāvaka nāṭṭiluḷḷa peruṅkōyilkaḷ aṉaittum maṉṉarkaḷiṉ camātikaḷiṉ mītē eṭuppikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu;  tamiḻ nāṭṭiluḷḷa pala paḻaiya kōyilkaḷ cittarkaḷ camātiyiṉ mītu eṭuppikkap peṟṟavai eṉṟu iṉṉiṉṉa cittarkaḷ camātiyiṉ iṉṉiṉṉa ūrk kōyil eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa eṉṟum cila aṟiñarkaḷ viḷakkan tantuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉ mūlam ekiptiya nākarikam, tirāviṭa marapai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭatu eṉpatai eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatāka amaintuḷḷatu eṉat teriyavarukiṟatu.
kirēkkarkaḷ iyaṟkai eḻilum, eṇṇaṟṟa vaḷamum vāynta nāṭṭil vāḻnta makkaḷ. aḻakum, uṇmaiyum kirēkkarkaḷiṉ paṇpāṭṭil irukaṇkaḷāka nilaviṉa.  avarkaḷ kalaikaḷil aḻakum meyyum iṇaintu ēṟṟamuṟṟu ilaṅkiṉa.  avarkaḷ nāṭṭiṟ kiṭaitta calavaik kaṟkaḷāl kōyilkaḷaiyum, kaṭṭiṭaṅ
kaḷaiyum amaittu kaṭṭiṭak kalaikku ciṟappūṭṭiṉar.   kirēkkar
kaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyilum, cilaikkalaikaḷilum meṉmaiyum tiṇmaiyum, nayamum polivuṟṟaṉa.
tirāviṭarkaḷ teyva nampikkai vāyntavarkaḷ.  uṭalai iṟaivaṉ vāḻum kōyilāka eṇṇupavarkaḷ itaṉai naṭamāṭuṅ kōyil eṉṟu avarkaḷ maṟainūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  eṉṟum aḻiyātu nilai peṟṟirukkum iṟaivaṉukku eṉṟum aḻiyā uṟaiviṭamāka kukaik kōyilaiyum kuṭai varaik kōyilaiyum kaṟṟaḷikaḷaiyum amaittavarkaḷ āṇṭavaṉ aḻivaṟṟavaṉ avaṉ uṟaiyum kōyilum aḻivaṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku meyp pittavarkaḷ. kallāl aṭippaṭaiyum, taḷamum, cuvarkaḷum, tūṇkaḷum, uttaramum, pāvu kallum koṇṭu kōyil amaittavarkaḷ.  ulakam aḻiyiṉum tāṉ aḻiyātu niṟkum taṉit taṉmai peṟṟa taṅkaḷ iṟaivaṉai vaḻipaṭa nilaiyāṉa kōyilkaḷai uruvākkiyavarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷ eṉṟu ulakak kōyil varalāṟṟil uyarnta iṭattaip peṟṟavarkaḷ.  tirāviṭa makkaḷ paṭaitta viṇmuṭṭum vimāṉaṅkaḷum, mukilaḷāvum kōpuraṅkaḷum tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ uyarnta koḷkaikaḷukkum kuṟikkōḷkaḷukkum oru uyariya ciṉṉam pōl tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa.
ulakil, makkaḷ vāḻum palvēṟu pakutikaḷilum toṉmai yāṉa kālattilē taṉittaṉiyē kaṭṭiṭak kalai eḻuntuḷḷatu.  atu aṉṟaiyac cūḻnilaikaḷukkēṟpavum, makkaḷiṉ tēvaikaḷuk kēṟpavum vaḷarntuḷḷatu.  paḻaṅkāla kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ, avaṟṟai uruvākkap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭa poruḷkaḷ, avaṟṟiṉ aḻipāṭukaḷ ammakkaḷiṉ aṟivu, paṇpāṭu, nākarikam, kalai, varalāṟu, camayam mutaliyavaṟṟai aṟintu koḷḷat tuṇaiyāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.
ātikālak kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyilum iṭaikkālak kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyum, kaṭṭiṭak kalaic ciṟpamum aḻakum, uṟutiyum uḷḷavai kaḷāyt tikaḻkiṉṟaṉa.  aracarkaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷum, vaṇikar kaḷum āṭampara vāḻkkai naṭatti vantaṉar.  eṉṟālum kalai vaḷarppatilum kaṇṇōṭṭam celuttupavarkaḷāy iruntaṉar.  aracarkaḷiṉ ātaravaip peṟṟu ciṟpikaḷ taṅkaḷ kalvi aṟivai yum kalai aṟivaiyum, kaṟpaṉait tiṟaṉaiyum payaṉpaṭutti ciṟanta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaiyum, oppaṟṟa ōviyaṅkaḷaiyum, cīriya cilaikaḷai yum, pāvaṅkaḷ oḷirum paṭimaṅkaḷaiyum paṭaittu teyvam uṟaiyum tirukkōyilkaḷaiyum aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉai kaḷaiyum aḻaku poliya amaittuḷḷaṉar.  itu nilakkiḻārkaḷ taṅkaḷiṉ piraputtuva nilaiyai eṉṟum nilai peṟṟu niṟkac ceyta tantiram eṉpar cilar muṟpōkku eḻuttāḷarkaḷ.
iṉṟu, ulakil uḷḷa ellā nāṭukaḷum aṇmaiyil uḷḷa nāṭukaḷaip pōl neruṅkit toṭarpu koḷḷat toṭaṅki yuḷḷaṉa.  oḷiyaiyum oliyaiyum viṭa vēkamākac cellum viṇṇūrti cilamaṇi nēraṅkaḷil ulakaic cuṟṟi varukiṉṟatu.  oruvārattiṟkuḷ tiṅkaḷai aṭaikiṉṟaṉa.  cila tiṅkaḷukkuḷ, cevvāy, putaṉ, viyāḻaṉ pōṉṟa kōḷkaḷai aṭaikiṉṟaṉa.  aṅkuḷḷa nilaikaḷaip pūmiyil uḷḷa makkaḷukku uṇarttu kiṉṟaṉa.  ulakam aṉaittiṟkum potuvāṉa kāṅkiriṭ pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭap poruḷkaḷ payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ciṟpam, ōviyam pōṉṟa kalaiyaṇikaḷ niṟainta kaviṉuṟum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ eṅkum eḻuppap peṟukiṉṟaṉa.  makkaḷ vāḻkkaiyil eḻuntuḷḷa kalvi, kuṭiyiruppu, aracāṭci mutaliyavaikaḷukku ēṟpa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ uṟutiyākavum, vacatiyākavum, aḻakākavum kaṭṭappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
tamiḻakattil ātiyil arumpiyatu teyva tiru uruvaṅkaḷ tāṉ.  teyvat tiru uruvaṅkaḷ tōṉṟip pallāyiram āṇṭu
kaḷukkup piṉṉar tiruk kōyilkaḷ eḻavillai.  āṉāl teyvat tiru uruvaṅkaḷai periya maraṅkaḷiṉ aṭiyil vaittē vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  periyār ci. em. irāmaccantiraṉ ceṭṭiyār (muṉṉāḷ intu aṟanilaiyap pātukāvaṟ kaḻakattiṉ āṇaiyāḷar)  intiyāvō camayattaik koṇṭatu āṉāl tamiḻnāṭō camayattilum, camaya nilaiyaṅkaḷaic ciṟanta kuṟikkōḷākak koṇṭu viḷaṅkukiṟatu vēṟu nāṭṭu aṟiñarkaḷ evar inta nāṭṭiṟku vanta pōtilum iṅkuḷḷa camaya nilaiyaṅkaḷaik kaṇṭu makiḻntu viyantu eḻutātār illai.  ākavē tamiḻ makkaḷ camaya nilaiyaṅkaḷukku vaḷarcci tantu avaikaḷaic cīriya muṟaiyil vaikkappaṭuvataiyē kuṟik kōḷākak koṇṭiruntārkaḷ eṉpatil aiyamillai camaya uṇarcci eppōtu ēṟpaṭṭatu eṉṟu colla iyalātu eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
makkaḷ iṉattil camaya uṇarcci avarkaḷ kaṟkāla makkaḷāy irukkum kālattilē tuḷirttu viṭṭatu.  tāyē ātiyil taṉṉaip peṟṟavaḷāy kāppavaḷāy araciyāy, maruttuvacciyāy, pātukākkum taṉṉalamaṟṟa kaṭavuḷāyk kāṇappaṭṭāḷ.  avaḷ iṟanta iṭattil naṭukal nāṭṭi avaḷai vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉāṉ appāl tantaikkum, peruñcittarkaḷukkum, niṉaivukal kaṭṭi vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉōm.  nīṇṭanāṭkaḷukkup piṟakē nammaip pōla namatu camūkat talaivarkaḷiṉ māḷikaiyaip pōl iṟutiyāy namatu aracaṉiṉ araṇmaṉaiyaip pōl nām vaḻipaṭum teyva uruvaṅkaḷukku kaṭṭiṭam eḻuppat toṭaṅki ṉōm.  nakaram, niyamam, kōṭṭam, paḷḷi, ālayam eṉṟa pataṅkaḷ kōyilukku vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  kōyil eṉṉum patam kō + il eṉap pirittu aracaṉ vīṭu eṉṉum poruḷil payaṉpaṭutti appāl iṟaivaṉ uṟaiyum iṭattiṟkē nilaiyāṉa peyarāka nilaittu niṟkac ceytu viṭṭōm.  oru kālattil maṉṉaṉaik kaṭavuḷāka, allatu kaṭavuḷiṉ avatāramāka eṇṇiya kālattil avaṉ uṟaiyum iṭattaik kōyil eṉṟu payaṉpaṭuttiyatu tavaṟalla.  appāl makkaḷ aṟivu mutircciyiṉ payaṉāka maṉṉaṉ teyvamāka muṭiyātu avaṉ uṟaiyum iṭam tēva kōṭṭamāka teyva uṟaiyuḷḷākavō āka muṭiyātu eṉṟa eṇṇam piṟakkavē iṟaivaṉ uṟaiyum illam kōyilākavum aracaṉ uṟaiyum maṉai araṇmaṉaiyākavum nilaipeṟṟu viṭṭatu.
iṟaivaṉukku eḻilārnta illaṅkaḷai amaittatu mikat toṉmaiyāṉa ēṟpāṭu.  ātiyil makkaḷ aka nāḻikaiyai maṭṭumē amaittārkaḷ.  makkaḷ iṟai uruvattiṟkē illam kaṇṭārkaḷē yoḻiya makkaḷ veyilukkum, kāṟṟiṟkum, veppattiṟkum, maḻaikkum kōyilōṭu cērttu iṭam amaikka villai  - amaippatu kūṭātu eṉṟum eṇṇiṉar.  namatu kōyilkaḷiṉ aṭippaṭaiyilē cāñci, kāñci, cāranāt, pūri pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷil pauttarkaḷ aka nāḻikaiyai maṭṭum amaittuḷḷārkaḷ.
mecapottāmiyā, ekiptu, kirīṭ kirīcu, urōm, pāracīkam, peru, mekcikkō, āppirikkā, cīṉam mutaliya nāṭukaḷil nilavi maṅki maṟaintupōṉa mataṅkaḷ cumār irupatu irukkalām.  iṉṟu uyiruṭaṉ nilavum intu camayam, pautta camayam, ilāmiya matam, kiṟittuva matam, yūta matam, corāṣṭaṭiriya matam, ciṇṭē camayam, kaṉpūciya matam ṭōvō matam, jaiṉacamayam ākiya pattu mataṅkaḷaic ciṟappākak kūṟalām.  ilāmiya camayam ki.pi 7-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil yūta kiṟittava camayattiṉ aṭippaṭaiyil eḻunta vayatil kuṟainta camayam, ki.mu. 1980-āṇṭiṟku muṉ piṟanta kiṟittuviṉ vaḻiyai yoṭṭi eḻunta camayam ilāmiya neṟikku muṉ tōṉṟiya matam, maṟṟaiya mataṅkaḷ etuvāy iruntālum iṉṟaikku 2500 -m āṇṭiṟku muṟpaṭṭavaikaḷē. iṟaivaṉai vaḻipaṭum iṭaṅkaḷ eṉṉum poruḷil ellā mataṅkaḷukkum kōyilkaḷ eṭuppittu avaṟṟiṉ amaippu kālattiṟkum iṭattiṟkum makkaḷiṉ nākarika vaḷarccikkum paṇpāṭṭiṟkum ēṟpa vaḷarntuḷḷatu.
paṇṭu toṭṭu iṉṟu varai ulakaṉaittum kōyil eḻuntuḷḷataṟkuk kāraṇam camaya uṇarcci makkaḷiṭam eppoḻutum ētō ōraḷavil iruntu vantatē eṉpatil aiyamillai.  añciyāyiṉum, aṉpupaṭṭāyiṉum neñcam! vāḻi, niṉai niṉṟiyūrai nī  eṉa namakku aṟivuṟuttiyuḷḷār āḷuṭaiya piḷḷaiyār.  mutalil ātikāla makkaḷ tāykkum, tāyt teyvattiṟkum ēṉ?  ammaiyappaṉukkum añci vaḻipaṭṭa makkaḷēyāvar.  nam kaṇṇiṟkup pulappaṭātu aṇuviṉukkum aṇuvāy nilavum aṟivuṭaiya peruñcaktiyeṉṟum perumpālum ataṟkaṭaṅki naṭantu tam muṭporutu koṇṭirukkum vēṟu ciṟu caktikaḷ tēvataikaḷ palavum uṇṭeṉṟum avaiyellām makkaḷ vāḻkkaiyil kalantu koṇṭu naṉmai tīmai mutaliyavaṟṟai nalkum taṉmai vāyntaṉa eṉṟum avaṟṟaiyellām nām vaḻipaṭṭāl avai nammait tuṉpuṟuttātu eṉṟu makkaḷ nampi vāḻkkaiyai naṭattiṉārkaḷ.  paṇṭaik kāla makkaḷ vaḻipaṭṭa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷ tantait teyvaṅkaḷ, kaṇṇaṉ teyvam makaṉ teyvam pōṉṟavai paṭippaṭiyāy uyarntaṉa.  mēṭṭiṟkum malaikkum, viṇṇiṟkumāka uyarntaṉa.  ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, cevvāy, putaṉ, mutaliya kōḷkaḷākavum, neruppu, nilam, nīr kāṟṟu, ākāyam maṭṭumiṉṟi iṭi, maḻai mutaliyavaikaḷum teyvaṅkaḷāyiṉa.  ivaṟṟait teyvaṅkaḷākak koṇṭu ivaṟṟiṟku uyir pali iṭutal paipiḷil kūṟum ātām kālattil iruntu iṉṟu varai ellā mataṅkaḷum palvēṟu peyaril perum vaḻakkāy iruntu vantatu eṉpatu uṟutiyākum.  paḻaṅkālattil namatu camayaṅkaḷil irunta mūtātaiyarkaḷ āṭumāṭu kutirai oṭṭakam kōḻi mutaliyavaṟṟai maṭṭumiṉṟi maṉita uyirkaḷaiyum paliyiṭṭu vantārkaḷ.  anta vaḻakkam iṉṟu kūṭa muṟṟāka niṟuttappaṭavillai.  tām uṇṇum kāykaṟip poruḷaiyum  tam kaṭavuḷukkup paṭaittatuṇṭu.  ippaṭi pali, vēḷvi ceyyum poḻutu tām vaḻipaṭum teyvattaip pōṟṟi pukaḻntu tam kuṟaikaḷaik kūṟuvatuṇṭu.
uṇmaiyai uraippatāṉāl iṉṟu kōyilil irukkum palipīṭam kēraḷattil palikkal eṉṟa peyaril iruppavaikaḷ aṉaittum ātikālattil uyirkaḷaip paliyiṭṭa iṭamēyākum.  iṉṟu uyirppali caivarkaḷ kōyilil maṭṭumalla kattōlikka kiṟittavarkaḷ kōyilkaḷilum palippīṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl uyirppali ceyvatillai.  āṉāl caiva camaya aṟivarkaḷ palippīṭaṅkaḷ, maṉitaṉ iṟaivaṉ cannitikkup pōkum muṉ taṉ uḷḷattil uḷḷa tīya eṇṇaṅkaḷai viṭṭuviṭṭu (akaṟṟi) puṉitamāṉa uḷḷattōṭu celka eṉpatai niṉaivūṭṭuvataṟku vaittirukkiṟatu eṉṟu tattuvak karuttukkaḷ kūṟuvatu pōl kiṟitavarkaḷum kūṟukiṟārkaḷām.   āṉāl ātimaṉitaṉākiya ātām-ēvāḷ eṉpavarkaḷ makkaḷ iruvar iruntārkaḷ avarkaḷil oruvaṉ kāpayar kāyīṉ avaṉ vivacāyi, maṟṟavaṉ āṭumāṭukaḷai mēyppavaṉ.  ivviruvarkaḷil āṭumēyppavaṉ kaṭavuḷukku (karttarukku) āṭu māṭukaḷaip paliyiṭṭu vantāṉ.  kaṭavuḷ avaṉ mītu piriyamāka iruntār.  avaṉukku vēṇṭiya naṉmaikaḷaic ceytu vantār.  mūttavaṉākiya kāyīṉ vēḷāṇmai ceypavaṉ avaṉ kaṭavuḷukku appam, paḻam, kāykaṉi kiḻaṅku mutaliyavaikaḷaip paṭaittu vaḻi paṭṭu vantāṉ.  kaṭavuḷ (tēvaṉ) avaṉ mēl piriyamāka illai. eṉavē avaṉ kōpamum poṟāmaiyum koṇṭavaṉāka āpēl eṉṉum tampiyai veṭṭik koṉṟu viṭṭāṉ.  itaṉaip paipiḷ eṉṉum kiṟittavat tirumaṟai eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.  āpirakām taṉmakaṉaip paliyiṭa aḻaittuc ceṉṟatum kaṭavuḷ atait taṭuttatum piṉ avaṉ aṇmaiyil niṉṟa āṭṭaip paliyiṭṭatum teḷivāyk kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  kiṟitavarkaḷ iṉṟu palipīṭam vaittirukkiṟārkaḷ.  pali iṭuvatillai eṉṟālum avarkaḷiṉ kaṭavuḷākiya ekōvā āṭu māṭu, mutaliya palikaḷai virumpi ēṟṟuk koṇṭatōṭu maṉitap paliyaiyum ēṟṟuk koṇṭiruk kiṟār eṉṟu cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyum.
iṉṟu civaṉ kōyilkaḷilum pala tāyt teyvaṅkaḷiṉ palipīṭam uṇṭu pali iṭuvatillai.  appar cāmi kālattiṟku piṉ civaperumāṉukku āṭumāṭu, erumai kōḻi mutaliyavaikaḷ paliyiṭṭatuṇṭu civaperumāṉ taṉ paktarkaḷiṭam piḷḷaikkaṟi kēṭṭa kataiyum uṇṭu.  pala kōyilkaḷilum tēr iḻukkum pōtu kōḻikkuñciyaip paṭṭatuṇṭu.  vīṭukaṭṭi muṭintatum taccuk kaḻittal eṉṉum peyarāl āṭṭai paliyiṭṭu ataṉ utirattai vīṭṭil teḷippatum uṇṭu.  iṟanta uyirkaḷukku kōḻikkuñcai capparattil (pāṭaiyil) kaṭṭik koṇṭu pōy paliyiṭṭu atai vaṇṇārkaḷ eṭuttuk koḷvatum uṇṭu.  itaṉai maṟaiyātu caivap periyār caccitāṉantam piḷḷai yavarkaḷ B.A.B.T mutal mutal maṉitaṉ vaḻipaṭa kōvilā iruntatu.  ippaṇi mēṭaiyē iruntatu.  ovvoru ūrilum iyaṟkai vaḷam ceṟintatōr  pakkattil ceḻittut taḻaittu vaḷarnta marattaṭiyil palippīṭam amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu.1  kaṭavuḷ aṅkeḻuntaruḷi taṉṉai vaḻipaṭuvōr tarum palikaḷaiyum ceyyum tōttiraṅkaḷaiyum ēṟṟu koḷkiṉṟār eṉṉum  nampikkai valuttatum appāṟai irunta iṭattiṟkē perum matippēṟpaṭṭu viṭṭatu.  kuṟitta nāṭkaḷil ammēṭaikkum ceṉṟu paliyiṭṭup pōṟṟi varam vēṇṭum pōtu maṭṭumiṉṟi ammēṭaiyaik kāṇa nērnta pōtellām kaṭavuḷai niṉaittu vaṇaṅki celvatum iyalpāyiṟṟu.
neṭuṅkālam varaiyil ippalimēṭaiyait tavira vēṟu kōyilkaḷ evaiyum ēṟpaṭṭatākat teriyavillai.  piṉpu maṉitaṉ taṉ karuttukaḷaip parup poruḷāka veḷiyiṭuvataṟku muyaṉṟapōtu tāṉ kaṇṭa poruḷkaḷiṉ uruvaṅkaḷai varaiyat talaippaṭṭāṉ cittiram ivvāṟu tōṉṟiyatu.  piṉpu puṟakkaṇṇāṟ kāṇap peṟāta maṉak kaṇṇāṟ kaṇṭa kāṭci kaḷaiyum uruvaṅkaḷaiyum cittarikkalāṉāṉ.  nāḷaṭaivil ivvaṭivaṅkaḷai maṇṇilum marattilum kallilum paṉṉāṭ kaḷukkup piṉ ulōkaṅkaḷilum ceyyum tiṟamaiyum vaḻakkum perukiṉa.
ippaṭik kaṭavuḷai vaḻipaṭuvataṟku ēṟpaṭṭa paruvuruvaṅ kaḷaip paṇṭaiya maṉitaṉ pali mēṭaik ketiril eḻuntaruḷap paṇṇiṉāṉ.  ivaṟṟuḷ mikavum paḻaiyatu aṉaṟ koḻuntu vaṭivāyuḷḷa civaliṅkamē eṉṟu karuta iṭamuṇṭu eṅṅaṉa meṉṟu ciṟitu kāṇpām.  ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ tī mutaliya iyaṟkaip perum poruḷkaḷait taṉittaṉi tēvataikaḷāyk koṇṭu vaṇaṅkiya makkaḷ nāḷaṭaivil aṟivu peruka avaruṭ ciṟantōr avaṟṟiluḷḷa nalamum valiyumellām orē iṟaivaṉuṭaiya teṉṟu kaṇṭaṉar.  appōtu avaṟṟai iṟaivaṉatu māperummēṉikaḷāka viḷakka nilaiyaṅkaḷākak karuti vaḻipaṭat talaippaṭṭārkaḷ avaṟṟuḷ tīyāṉatu makkaḷ kaikkeṭṭuvatāy avarkaḷāl vaḷarkkak kūṭiyatāṉa pōtu avvaṉaṟ piḻampai ciṟappu vakaiyil āṇṭavaṉ tirumēṉiyākak koṇṭu pōṟṟum vaḻakkam perukiṟṟu.  koṟkait tīyāṉatu neyyum viṟakum koṇṭu ōmpappaṭṭa pōtaṉṟit tōṉṟātu.  aṉṟiyum maṉitaṉ taṉ aṉpiṉ aṟikuṟiyāka avvaṉaṟ koḻuntiṟku nīrāṭalum āṭai canta maṇimalar puṉaitalum iyalāvaṉṟē?  ātaliṉ avvaṉaṟ piḻampuruvattai kallil amaittu vaṇaṅkum vaḻakkam tōṉṟiyatu.  ivviliṅka vaḻipāṭu paṇṭaiya  mekcikkō, ekiptu, arāpiyā mutaliya veḷināṭukaḷil iruntataṟkuc cāṉṟukaḷ kiṭaikkiṉṟaṉa. namatu nāṭṭil ippaṇṭaiya vaḻipāṭu imayam mutal kumari varaiyil iṉṟaḷavum kāṇak kiṭakkiṉṟatu aṟiñarkaḷ ivviliṅkattiṉ kaṇ tattuvam kaṭanta taṉi mutaṟ poruḷāṅ kantaḻiyai vaḻipaṭukiṉṟaṉar.  maṟṟaiyōriṟ palar oru marattiṉ kīḻ kallilō maṇṇilō ivviliṅka vaṭivaic camaittu tam iṣṭa teyvattai ataṉil varuvittu vaṇaṅkutal iṉṟum kaṇ kūṭāyuḷḷatu.  mikavum paṇṭaiyatāṉa civaliṅka vaḻipāṭṭuṭaṉ kai kāl mutaliya uṟuppukaḷ poruntiya palvēṟu uruvaṅkaḷai vaittuc ceyyum vaḻipāṭukaḷ piṉṉāṟpalkiṉa ivaṟṟai virikkiṟ perukum.
ivvāṟellām uruva vaḻipāṭu peruki varukaiyil aḷapparum perumaiyuṭaiya āṇṭavaṉ vatitaṟkuttakka ciṟappamainta kōyil vēṇṭum eṉṉum viruppamum muyaṟciyum tōṉṟiṉa.  aracaṉillattiṉum pārkka āṇṭavaṉ uṟaiyuḷ cīriṉum ciṟappiṉum viñci viḷaṅka vēṇṭum eṉṉum ārvam perukiṟṟu.  ivvāṟu kōyilkaḷ ulakeṅkum tōṉṟip perum polivōṭu nilavalāyiṉa eṉṟu caiva cittānta camayattai piracurikka eḻunta centamiḻc celvi eṉṉum tiṅkaḷ ēṭṭil uṇmaiyai maṟaikkātu veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷār.1
kōyilkaḷ eppaṭit tōṉṟiyatu.  uruva vaḻipāṭu eppaṭit tōṉṟiyatu.  ekkālat tōṉṟiyatu eṉṟa ārāycci tamiḻarkaḷukku eḻuntatē illai.  atōṭu tām aṟinta uṇmaiyai ulakiṟku uṇartta vēṇṭum eṉṟa eṇṇamum eḻuntatē illai.  caiva camayattaip parappa eḻunta kaḻakaṅkaḷum nūṟpatippuk kaḻakaṅkaḷum, tiṅkaḷ itaḻkaḷum namatu kōyilkaḷaip paṟṟi nūl eḻuta muṉ vantatē illai.  perci piravuṇ, cōviyat tuprayal, ṭellā kirāmriṣ pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭaṟiñar nūlkaḷaip parappavō allatu tamiḻākkam ceytu veḷiyiṭavō itu varai muṉ varavillai.  tēvāram, tiruvācakam, tirukkuṟaḷ, akanāṉūṟu, puṟanāṉūṟu pōṉṟa nūṟkaḷaiyum veḷiyiṭṭu kācu campātippatilē kaṇṇum karuttāka ituvarai iruntu vantuḷḷaṉar.  ulakameṅkaṇum tamiḻarkaḷ ceṉṟu āṅkāṅkē akaḻ āyvu ceytu tamiḻarkaḷum avarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷāṉa tirāviṭarkaḷum upaitiyā, ellam, aciriyā, akkēṭiyā, cumēriyā, ekiptu, kirīṭ mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷukkum malēciyā, tāylāntu, kampōṭiyā, cāvakam, pālittīvu pōṉṟa iṭaṅkaḷuk
kellām ceṉṟu palappala periya kōyilkaḷaiyum tiru uruvaṅ
kaḷaiyum ceytu civaṉeṟiyaip parappiya ceytikaḷai ayalnāṭṭu tolporuḷ āyvuttuṟaiyiṉar veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷa ceyti
kaḷaiyum, nūṟkaḷaiyum tamiḻ makkaḷukkut terivikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu ciṟitum avarkaḷ eṇṇiyatillai.  cintu veḷiyil caiva naṉmakkaḷ eḻuppiya ciṟanta nākarikattaip paṟṟi ettaṉai nūṟkaḷ veḷivantuḷḷaṉa.  cintu veḷi makkaḷ eḻutiya eḻuttukkaḷaip paṭikka kōpaṉ kēkaṉ aṟiñarkaḷum leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalaik kaḻakamum eṇṇaṟṟa aṟiñarkaḷaik koṇṭu laṭcam laṭcamāka poṟkācukaḷaic celaviṭṭu āyvu ceytu veḷiyiṭṭu varuvatil namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭu caivacittāntak kaḻakamō camayap piracārak kaḻakamō, tirāviṭak kaḻakam, tirāviṭa muṉṉēṟṟak kaḻakamō, akila intiya aṇṇā ti.mu.ka niṟuvaṉamō kaṭukaḷavum kavalaippaṭṭatuṇṭā?  itaṟku oru celavuk kācum celaviṭṭa tuṇṭā?  tamiḻ nāṭṭil tamiḻar peyarāl eḻuntuḷḷa araciyal niṟuvaṉaṅkaḷum, camaya niṟuvaṉaṅkaḷum tam vayiṟṟāttiṟattait tīrttuk koḷḷa vaḻi tēṭuvatil kaṇṇum karuttumāy irukkiṟatē oḻiya tamiḻ iṉattiṉ nalaṉai nāṭiyatē illai.  iṉṟallāviṭiṉum viraivil tamiḻ makkaḷ uṇmaiyai uṇarntu ivarkaḷiṭam kaṇakkuk kēṭka muṉ varuvārkaḷ eṉpatu uṟuti.  appoḻutu kā. cu. piḷḷaikku kalleṭuttēṉ, aṇṇāviṟkuc camāti kaṭṭi malarmālai cūṭṭi tūpa tīpaṅkāṭṭiṉēṉ, aṇṇā peyarai akila intiyā muḻuvatum parappi avar cilaikku mālai cūṭṭiṉēṉ eṉṟu kūṟit tappittuk koḷḷa muṭiyātu.
tamiḻakattilē caiva camayattaik kāppataṟku eḻunta maṭaṅkaḷō, allatu paktarkaḷō namatu tamiḻarkaḷukku kōyilaip paṟṟiyō, cilaikaḷaip paṟṟiyō ceppu uruvaṅ kaḷaip paṟṟiyō nalla nūṟkaḷ āṅkilattilō veḷiyiṭavillai.  namatu nāṭṭaic cērnta kāṣmīrattil vaḷarntuḷḷa caiva neṟiyaip paṟṟiyō, cāvakam, pāli, kampōcakam mutaliya nāṭṭil caiva camayikaḷ kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷaip paṟṟiyō oru nūlum eḻuta eṇṇiyatē illai.  cālṭiya nāṭṭil 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku muṉ oru peruṅkōyil eḻuntatu.  mecapottāmiyāvil mukō eṉṉum akaḻ āyvil naṉṉar eṉṟa civaṉ kōyil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu. ikkōyil cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷālāṉatu kīḻ iruntu mēlē ovvoru pirakāramum parappiṟ kuṟaintatāy oṉṟiṉ mēl oṉṟāka mūṉṟāvatu mēṭaiyil ucciyil oru aka nāḻikai uḷḷatu ataṉ muṉ palimēṭaiyāka oru kaṟpāṟai uḷḷatu.  kōyiliṉ cuvarkaḷil veḷippuṟam paḷapaḷappāṉa nīla vaṇṇattil eṉāmal ōṭukaḷ patippikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu uṭpuṟam marappalakaikaḷ aṭikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ivaṟṟiṉ iṭai iṭaiyē paḷiṅkuk kaṟkaḷum poṉṉum maṇiyum koṇṭu ceyta ariya ciṟpaṅkaḷ pala uḷa.  itu tirāviṭarkaḷ kaṭṭiya peruṅkōyil eṉṟu mēṉāṭṭaṟiñarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ. aṭiyiliruntu mēlēyuḷḷa aka nāḻikai varai paṭikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.
vaṭa amerikkāvil kolāṭō eṉṉum āṟṟaṅkaraiyil uḷḷa kuṉṟiṉ mītuḷḷa civaṉ kōyil 1937-ām āṇṭu amerikkat tol poruḷ āyviṉar kaṇṭupiṭittu intak kōyil 10-āyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṟpaṭṭatu eṉṟu muṭivu kaṭṭiṉar.  itu iṅkilāntil uḷḷa pattirikaikaḷilellām veḷivantatu.  tamiḻaṉukku teriyātu.  tēvāram pāṭik koṇṭu irukkum civa paktaṉō, periya purāṇam paṭittāl civalōkam kiṭṭumeṉṟu nāṭōṟum civanēyac celvarkaḷukkē teriyātu terintālum aṅku pōy pārkkavō namatu makkaḷukku itaip paṟṟi viḷakkik kūṟavō avaciyam illāmal pōkiṟatu.  amerikkāvil uḷḷa cevvintiyar civaperumāṉ eṅkaḷ teyvam. avaṉ cevvintiyaṉāka iruppatāl intiyarkaḷ kūṭa avaṉai iṉṟu varai mīṉāṭci, umā tēvi mutaliya civaṉ maṉaiviyaik karuppi eṉṟu kūṟuvataip pōl civaṉai karuppaṉ eṉṟu kūṟat tairiyam piṟakkavillai.  intiyarkaḷ civaṉai tī vaṇṇaṉ, cevvaṇṇaṉ, ceyyōṉ, ceñcaṭaiyōṉ eṉṟellām kūṟi civaperumāṉ vaṭa amerikkāvil uḷḷa cevvintiyaṉ eṉṟum, avaṉ imayamalai mītuḷḷa intiya aracaṉākiya takkaṉ makaḷākiya pārvatiyaiyum, teṉ intiyāvil uḷḷa parattiyākiya mīṉāṭciyaiyum maṇantu koṇṭāṉ eṉṟum civaṉ amerikka cevvintiyarkaḷiṭamiruntu iravalākap peṟṟa teyvam eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.1
ekiptu nāṭṭiṉ talainakarākiya keyrōviṟku aṇmaiyil uḷḷa kījā eṉṉum iṭattil piṅk kōyil oṉṟuḷḷatu. itu 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku kuṟaintataṉṟu. karuṅkal eḷitil akappaṭāta cālṭiyā nāṭṭuk kōyil pōlaṉṟi ekiptil eḷitil kiṭaikkum ikkōyil karuṅkallāl kaṭṭap peṟṟatu.  iṅkuḷḷa maṇṭapam 55 aṭi nīḷamuḷḷatu.  ciṟpa vēlaippāṭu ciṟitumaṟṟa caturat tūṇālāṉatu. tūṇkaḷ iraṇṭu varicaiyāka niṟuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ki.mu.1600 āṇṭiliruntu tāṉ ekiptil peruṅkōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  appu cimapal eṉṉum iṭattil 150-aṭi nīḷamum 100 - aṭi uyaramum uḷḷa kōyil pāṟaiyaik kuṭaintu ceyyappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ekiptiya nāṭṭil muṟkālattil tamiḻarkaḷ kuṭiyēṟi aṅku kōyilkaḷai eḻuppiṉar.  aṅku teyva uruvattai palarum eḷitil kāṇa muṭiyāta vakaiyil vaḻipaṭum muṟaikaḷ amaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉavām.  ekiptil civa vaḻipāṭum kāḷai vaḻipāṭum iruntatu.  iḵtaṉṟi kāḷai mukamum maṉita uṭalum uṭaiya atikāra nanti (Apis)  vaḻipāṭum iruntatu .
kiṭṭai nāṭṭil uḷḷa kōyilil nantiyum ataṉ mītu civaperumāṉ niṉṟu koṇṭu kaiyil maḻuvum cuttiyalum tiricūlamum tāṅki niṟpatu pōṉṟa uruvaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉṟu pala āciriyarkaḷ tam  nūṟkaḷil kuṟippiṭṭuḷḷaṉar.  annāṭṭiṉ kōyilkaḷ namatu nāṭṭiṉ tirukkōyilōṭu oppuvamaikāṭṭi oru āyvu nūlai eḻuta caiva cittāntikaḷō avarkaḷ camayamō, maṭamō nūl veḷiyīṭṭuk kaḻakamō eṇṇiyatē illai.  teruvil kiṭakkum  oru uṭainta kallai eṭuttu vaittuk koṇṭu civa civa eṉṟu talaiyil taṭṭuvatum kaṉṉattil pōṭṭuk koḷvatum kōyil kaṭṭuvataṟku taṉakku vēṇṭiyavar celvarkaḷ maṭātipatikaḷ kālil vīḻntu keñci poruḷ tiraṭṭuvatum periya tiruppaṇiyāka niṉaikkiṟār.  irukkiṟa eṇṇaṟṟa kōyilkaḷ ceppaṉiṭa vaḻiyaṟṟu carintu vīḻntu koṇṭirukkum pōtu uṭaintu teruvil kiṭakkum oru kallai civaliṅkam oṉṟu kūṟi kumpiṭuvatum kōyil kaṭṭa makkaḷiṭam paṇam kēṭpatum veṭkamāṉa ceyal. mutalil kumpiṭuvataṟku āṭkaḷait tiraṭṭu appāl oru ciṟu kōyilaik kaṭṭu.  caiva naṉmakkaḷ uṇṇa uṇaviṉṟi uṭukka uṭaiyiṉṟi paṭikka vaḻiyiṉṟi, paṭittavarkaḷukku vēlaiyiṉṟit tiṇṭāṭum poḻutu teruvil kiṭanta kallukku civaliṅkam eṉṟu peyar colli āyirakkaṇakkāṉa poruḷaip potu makkaḷiṭam tiraṭṭa muyaṟcippatā?  itu aṟamā?  intak kōyilikku civaṉ varuvāṉā?  kōyilkaḷ ellām kuccuk kārikaḷ vīṭṭiṟkuc camam eṉṟār kānti aṭikaḷ.  kōyilkaḷ kaḷḷarkaḷiṉ kukaikaḷ eṉṟār ēcunātar.  eṉavē ikkāla makkaḷukku mutalil kōyil eṉṟāl eṉṉa?  camayam eṉṟāl eṉṉa?  nām ēṉ kōyilukkuc cella vēṇṭum eṉpavaṟṟiṉai viḷakki namatu iḷam vāliparkaḷai, uṉatu kaippaṇattai vīṭṭu kōyilukku varac cey.  namatu camūka makkaḷ oṉṟu cēra, namatu camaya poruḷātāra muṉṉēṟṟam peṟa kāltuṭṭum celavaḻiyātu ēmāṟṟi vāḻum orucilar, kūraiyēṟi kōḻi piṭikka iyalāta kurukkaḷ vāṉattaik kīṟivaikuntam kāṭṭap pōvatu pōl ippoḻutu taṉṉalattiṟkāka tiruppaṇi ceyya muṉ vantuḷḷārkaḷ.  ivarkaḷ tiruppaṇi oḻika! oḻika!  eṉṟu kūṟi viṭṭu nām ulakil uḷḷa namatu kōyilkaḷaiyum, namatu nāṭṭu kōyilkaḷaipaṟṟi ārāyvōm; aḻintu koṇṭirukkum kōyilkaḷaip pātukāppōm kalaik karuvūlamāka ciṟpa maṇikaḷāy mūlai muṭukkukaḷilaḻintu vīḻntu koṇṭu irukkum tirukkōyilkaḷaip paḻutu pārkkavum namatu kōyilkaḷaiyum cilaikaḷaiyum cempuppaṭimaṅkaḷaiyum pātukākka muṉ varavēṇṭum. tamiḻ makkaḷai vaṇaṅki maṉṟāṭik kēṭṭuk koḷkiṟēṉ itaṉ uṇmaiyaṟiyāta makkaḷ ōyvu peṟṟa kālattil mōṭcam pōka eṇṇi piṟar poruḷaip payaṉaṟṟa vaḻikaḷukkākap payaṉpaṭuttuvatil muṉaiya vēṇṭām.  tāṉ mōṭcam pōka vēṇṭum eṉṟāl taṉ contap poruḷaic celaviṭṭuk kōyil kaṭṭaṭṭum. allatu taṉatu vīṭṭaiyē kōyilāka māṟṟaṭṭum.   atai varavēṟkiṉṟōm vāḻttukiṉṟōm.  kānti aṭikaḷ, oruvaṉukku 2 vēṭṭikaḷ tēvai 4,6,18 vēṭṭikaḷ vaittuk koṇṭāl itu tiruṭṭuttaṉam. 4 vēṭṭikaḷ vaittiruppavaṉ tiruṭaṉ 6 vēṭṭikaḷ vaittiruppavaṉ koḷḷaikkāraṉ 8 vēṭṭikaḷ vaittiruppavaṉ tīvaṭṭik koḷḷaikkāraṉ eṉṟār eṉpatai eṉatu tamiḻc cakōtarar kaḷukkum cakōtarikaḷukkum aṉpuṭaṉ terivittuk koḷkiṟēṉ.
niṟka kirēṭṭā (Crete) eṉṉum ittāli nāṭṭiṟku aṇmaiyil uḷḷa tīvu paṇṭaiyat tamiḻarkaḷuṭaiya kuṭiyēṟṟa nāṭu. heraṭṭōṭṭa eṉṉum paḻam perum varalāṟṟāciriyar kirēṭṭā makkaḷ tamiḻar (tamiḻ) eṉappaṭṭār  eṉṟu kūṟiyuḷḷār.  kirēṭṭā nākarikam cintu veḷi nākarikattōṭu mika neruṅkiya orumaippāṭuṭaiyatu.  kirēṭṭā makkaḷ mīṉavarkaḷ eṉap peṟṟaṉar.  cintu veḷi eḻuttum kirēṭṭā eḻuttum oṉṟu pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  kirēṭṭā nakaril uḷḷa oru nakariṟku civaṉ eṉṟu peyar.  kirēṭṭāvil cintu veḷiyil kaṭṭeṭuttataip pōṉṟa pala paḻam poruḷum annāṭṭu miṉōṉ araṇmaṉai yum (Palace of Minon)  kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku civa vaḻipāṭum civaṉ kōyil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.1
