cintu veḷi akaḻ āyvu
aimpatu āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ intiya aṟiñarkaḷiṟ cilar intiyāvil tēvarkaḷum arakkarkaḷumē uṇṭeṉṟu kūṟi vantaṉar.  appāl anāti kālam toṭṭu intiyāvil pirāmaṇar kaḷum cūttirarkaḷumē vāḻntu varukiṉṟaṉar.  appāl āṅkilēya varalāṟṟāciriyar intiyāvil āriyarkaḷum, tirāviṭarkaḷum uṇṭu.  āriyarkaḷ aḻakuvāyntavarkaḷ.  jermaṉ makkaḷum avarkaḷ moḻiyum āriyarkaḷuṭaṉ neruṅkiya toṭarpu koṇṭiruppatāyum viḷamparappaṭuttappaṭṭatu. piṉṉar āriyarkaḷ kāṇṭinēviyaṉ nāṭṭiliruntu vanta nākari makkaḷ.  avarkaḷ karuppu niṟamum cappai mūkkaiyumuṭaiya intiya nāṭṭiṉ paḻaṅkuṭimakkaḷai veṉṟu avarkaḷai nākarikap paṭuttiyuḷḷaṉar.  avarkaḷiṉ moḻi camakirutam, avarkaḷiṉ vētam irukku, yacur, cāmam atarvaṇam ākiyavaikaḷākum.  camakirutattiṉiṉṟē tamiḻ, teluṅku, kaṉṉaṭam, malaiyāḷam tuḷu, vaṅkāḷam, marāṭṭiram asām, pañcāpi mutaliya moḻikaḷ aṉaittum piṟantaṉa.  intiyāvil uḷḷa ellāt teyvaṅkaḷaiyum kalaikaḷaiyum intiyamakkaḷukku vaṭa moḻi vētamē vaḻaṅkiṉa eṉṟellām kūṟappaṭṭu vantaṉa.
vētakālap paṇpāṭṭiṟku muṉpu intiyāvil camayamō, tiruntiya moḻiyō, eḻuttō, perun teyvaṅkaḷō, kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyō, cilaiyō, veṇkalappaṭimaṅkaḷō, icaiyō, icaikkaruvikaḷō, kōyilō, aṇikalaṉkaḷō, ilakkaṇaṅkaḷō, ilakkiyaṅkaḷō, ōviyaṅkaḷō, piṟa kalaikaḷō, paṇpāṭō etuvum kiṭaiyātu.  civaṉ, pirammā, viṣṇu cuppiramaṇiyaṉ, umātēvi, caravati, laṭcumi mutaliya teyvaṅkaḷ ellām āriyarkaḷiṭamiruntu tirāviṭarkaḷ iravalākap peṟṟavaikaḷē eṉṟu kūṟi vantaṉar.
intiyāviṉ varalāṟu ki.mu. 1500-kku muṟpaṭṭataṉṟu (atāvatu āriyarkaḷ varukaikku muṟpaṭṭataṉṟu)  cila mēṉāṭṭāciriyarkaḷ kūṭa eḻuti vantaṉar.   1922-mutal 1931-ām āṇṭuvarai cintu veḷiyil naṭaipeṟṟa tol poruḷ āyvu intiya varalāṟṟiṉ toṭakkamum, toṉmaiyum, taṉmaiyum oppuvamaiyaṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku uṇarttiyatu. cintu veḷiyil eḻunta āyvu intiya varalāṟṟil kavvik kiṭanta iruḷai akaṟṟum pēroḷiyāy eḻuntatu.
nantāp perumai vāynta cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu ulaka varalāṟṟiṟkē oru tiruppu muṉaiyāka māṟiyatu.  intiya varalāṟṟiṉ iruṇṭakālattai ēṟṟa miku poṟkālamāka oḷipeṟac ceytuḷḷatu.  pāratap paṇpāṭṭiṉ aṭippaṭaiyāka amainta paṇpukaḷ aṉaittum cintu veḷi nākarikattiṉ ciṟappiyalpukaḷē eṉṟum varalāṟu kūṟum ceyti kēṭṭu ulakam viyappuṟṟuḷḷatu.
cintu veḷi varalāṟu intiyāviṉ toṉmaikku ōr aḷavukōl.  intiyap paṇpāṭṭiṉ taṉmaiyai (māṟṟai) uṇarttum uraikal.  ticai tavaṟic cellum mālumiyai nērvaḻic cellat tūṇṭum kalaṅkarai viḷakkiṉaip pōl tavaṟāṉa pātaiyil ceṉṟa varalāṟṟāciriyarkaḷ paḻaiya intiyāviṉ mītu vīcum putiya oḷi eṉṟu nēr vaḻi cellac ceytuḷḷatu.
iṉṟu intiyap paḷḷic ciṟārkaḷellām, cintu veḷi nākarikam ulakil oppaṟṟa nākarikam.  5000 -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ cintu veḷi nākarikattai ciṟanta nākarikam eṅkum arumpavillai.  cintuveḷi nākarikattiṉaip paṭaittamakkaḷ teṉṉintiyāvil vāḻum tirāviṭarkaḷē.  intiyāviṉ eḻuttum, camayamum, moḻiyum, kalaikaḷum, paṇpāṭum, nākarikamum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭiṉiṉṟu kiḷaittavaikaḷē eṉṟu teḷivāka uṇarntuḷḷārkaḷ.
ippoḻutu intiyāvil nūl eḻutupavarkaḷ evarāka iruppiṉum cintuveḷip paṇpāṭṭai mutal attiyāyamāka vaittē nūl eḻutat toṭaṅkiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  camīpattil veḷivarum pala nūlkaḷai uṉṉippākak kavaṉittu varukiṟēṉ.  varalāṟu, moḻi, eḻuttu, camayam, nāṭṭiyam, icai, icaik karuvi, āṭai, aṇikalaṉkaḷ, nakar amaippu, maruttuvam, mutaliya pala tuṟaikaḷaip paṟṟi veḷivanta nūṟkaḷilum cintu veḷi mutal iṭam peṟṟuḷḷatu.  eṉavē tirukkōyilaip paṟṟi eḻutap peṟṟa innūlilum ulakak kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyil toṉmaiyāṉa uyarnilaiyaip peṟṟirukkum cintu veḷik kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyum iṅku iṭam peṟutal ciṟappuṭaittākumaṉṟō?
arappāviṉ kaṭṭiṭakkalai
arappāviṉ kaṭṭiṭak kalai ciṟappu mikkatu.  cintu veḷi nakaraṅkaḷil mikat toṉmaivāynta nakar arappāvākum.  arappāvil ciṟappāṉa āṭci ki.mu.3000  -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ eḻuntatu.  atu civaperumāṉai muḻumutaṟ kaṭavuḷākak koṇṭa vēḷāṇ kuṭimakkaḷ āṭciyākum.  aṅku aracarkaḷ iruntaṉar.  avarkaḷ vēḷāḷar marapil vantavarkaḷ.  anta aracaṉ koṭi ērk koṭiyākum.  kōyilkaḷil uḷḷa koṭikaḷil erutu poṟikkap
paṭṭiruntatu.
cintu veḷiyil vēḷāḷar (kārāḷar) āṭci nilaviyatu.  aṅku āṭci purinta vēḷāḷar civaperumāṉai (kayilai malaiyil vīṟṟiruppavarai)  pacupati vaṭivilum, iliṅka vaṭivilum vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  avarkaḷ civaṉ kōyilukkut teṉ intiyāvaip pōla (tamiḻakattaip pōla)k kōyilukku ērāḷamāṉa varuvāyuḷḷa nilaṅkaḷai māṉiyamāka viṭṭiruntārkaḷ. avarkaḷil pakal veḷḷāḷar (cūriya kula vēḷāḷar, tiṅkaḷ (cantira) kula vēḷāḷar eṉṟum iru piriviṉar iruntaṉar.  vēḷāḷar kula muṭi maṉṉarkaḷ muṭi koṭi, kuṭai, iṇaik kayal, kaṭṭil, viḷakku, muracu mutaliya araca ciṉṉaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiyavarkaḷāka iruntaṉar.  avarkaḷ naṭumalaiyil (imayamalaiyil) uḷḷa puṉita mīṉai-atāvatu eṇ kuṇattāṉai (civaperumāṉaiyum) veḷḷaimalaiyil uṟainta murukaṉaiyum vaḻipaṭṭu vantaṉar.  aṅku iliṅkattai vaḻipaṭum villavarkaḷum, (kuṟiñci nila makkaḷum mīṉāṭṭai āṇṭa mīṉavarkaḷum neytal nila makkaḷum) iruntārkaḷ eṉṟum mīṉavarkaḷ (paratavarkaḷ) vēḷāḷar araciṟkut tuṇaiyāka iruntārkaḷ eṉṟum aṟikiṉṟōm.  itaṉai hirā aṭikaḷ tam kaṭṭuraikaḷil viḷakki eḻutiyuḷḷār.1
nakaraṅkaḷ
1920-ām āṇṭu pañcāp mānilattil iravi caṭlec āṟukaḷukku iṭaiyil tōṇṭiya poḻutu arappā eṉṉum iṭam akaḻntu kāṇappaṭṭatu.  inta nakaram cintu veḷiyil akaḻntu kaṇṭa nakaraṅkaḷil mikat toṉmaiyāṉatu.  itu cintu veḷiyil nilaviya āṭciyiṉ talainakarāka iruntirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu. inta nakaram akaḻnteṭutta poḻutu mikavum citaintu pōṉa nilaiyil iruntatu.  1922-ām āṇṭil cintu mānilattil larkkāṉā māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa mokañca-tārō eṉṉum nakar ākum.  inta nakar 70-aṭi uyaramuḷḷa maṇmēṭṭiṉ aṭiyil putaintiruntatu.   itu arappāvai viṭa citaivuṟātu nalla nilaiyilē uḷḷatu.  itu cintuveḷi āṭciyil arappāviṟkup piṉ talai nakarāka iruntirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu iḵtaṉṟi cintu mānilattilum, paluccitāṉ mānilattilum pala ūrkaḷ akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avaikaḷ kuvēṭṭā, amari, nal kuḷḷimeki, cōpu veḷi, cāṉku tārō, lokuñco, tārō, rūpār, kāḷipaṅkaṉ, cakpūrpāṉiciyāl, alimurāt pāṇṭivāki, kōṭcā nikāṅ kāṉ, cukār, kāccicā pōṉṟa nūṟṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa nakaraṅkaḷum ciṟṟūrkaḷum akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku akaḻntu kaṇṭeṭutta vīṭukaḷum poruḷkaḷum arappā mokañcatārō  ākiya iṭaṅkaḷil kiṭaitta poruḷkaḷukkum iṭaiyē ciṟu vēṟupāṭukaḷum illai.  ivai aṉaittum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭuṭaṉ iṇainta nakar amaippukaḷuṭaṉ iṇaintu kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.1
nakar amaippu
cintu veḷiyil akaḻntu kaṇṭa nakaraṅkaḷil ciṟappākak kuṟippiṭattakkaṉa arappā, mokañcatārō nakaraṅkaḷ eṉalām.  itu paṇṭaiyat tirāviṭa makkaḷ peṟṟirunta nakar amaipput tiṟaṉai eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatākum.  arappā iravi āṟṟaṅkaraiyil iruntatu.  mokañcatārō cintu āṟṟaṅkaraiyil iruntatu.  marakkalaṅkaḷil viḷai poruṭkaḷai ōriṭattiliruntu maṟṟōr iṭattiṟku eṭuttuc cellavum, makkaḷiṉ pōkkuvarattu vacatikkumāka āṟṟaṅkaraiyil nakaraṅkaḷai amaittuḷḷaṉar.  iṅku vāḻnta uḻavarkaḷ, cempuk kālattil amaitta intap paṇpāṭṭai āṟṟaṅkaraip paṇpāṭu eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.  inta mānakarkaḷ pala pirivukaḷākap pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ellāp pakutikaḷum orē mātiriyāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  oṉṟiṟkoṉṟu vēṟṟumai kāṇamuṭiyātavāṟu oḻuṅkākap pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. oru cemmaiyāṉa aṭippaṭaiyil cīrāka amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷa immānakar nērāṉa terukkaḷaiyum vacatiyāṉa illaṅkaḷaiyum periya māḷikaikaḷaiyum, uṟutiyāṉa potuk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaiyum uṭaiyaṉavāy eḻil peṟṟu viḷaṅkukiṉṟaṉa.  arappā mokañcatārō urūpār mutaliya nakaraṅkaḷ muṉ kūṭṭiyē naṉku tiṭṭamiṭappaṭṭu uṟutiyāṉa aṭippaṭaiyil amaikkappaṭṭa nakarkaḷākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  arappā nalla araṇaiyuṭaiya perum nakarākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟatu.  mokañcatārō atiṉum ciṟappuṭaiya mānakarākat tōṉṟukiṉṟatu.  mokañcatārō iṉṟaiya laṅkācaiyar vaṭṭattil uḷḷa pāṭṭāḷi makkaḷiṉ nakarappakutiyiṉaip pōla kāṇappaṭukiṟatu eṉṟu kūṟukiṟār oru āṅkila nāṭṭu eḻuttāḷar.
vīṭukaḷ amaippu
arappāvil potuk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ oruvitamākavum celvarkaḷ kuṭiyirukkum kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ oruvitamākavum ēḻai makkaḷum, naṭuttara makkaḷ vāḻum maṉaikaḷ oruvitamākavum uḷḷaṉa.  celvarkaḷ vāḻum māḷikai māṭikaḷaiyuṭaiyaṉavāyum pala aṟaikaḷ uḷḷaṉavāyum vicālamāṉatāyum uḷḷaṉa.  māḷikaiyil viruntiṉarkaḷ vantāl taṅkuvataṟkut taṉi aṟai uḷḷatu.  taiyalarkaḷ iruppataṟku ovvoru vīṭṭilum taṉi iṭaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa.  potuk kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷil vaṭṭa vaṭivamāṉa mēṭaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ēḻaikaḷum, toḻilāḷarkaḷum taṅkum ciṟu vīṭukaḷ ēḻu vīṭukaḷ iraṇṭu varicaikaḷil oṉṟāka amaikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  iraṇṭu varicaikaṭṭum iṭaiyē kuṟukiya pātai iruntatu.  iru pātaikaḷiṉ irupakkaṅkaḷum potut teruk kaḷil vantu kalantuḷḷaṉa.  toḻilāḷar illaṅkaḷil periya muṟṟaṅkaḷum ciṟiya aṟaikaḷum iruntaṉa.  arappāvil amaikkappaṭṭa illaṅkaḷ ki.mu.3000-kkum muṟpaṭṭaṉa.  ekiptil kaṭṭappaṭṭa illaṅkaḷ ki.mu.2000-kkup piṟpaṭṭaṉa vākum.  arappāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭa ciṟu illaṅkaḷ kūṭa nalla kāṟṟōṭṭamum veḷiccamum uḷḷatāy cukātāra nalattai eṇṇi amaikkappaṭṭaṉa.  cumēriyar, ekiptiyar illaṅkaḷ cukātāra nalaṉkaḷ kavaṉikkappaṭāviṭiṉum aḻakuṭaiyatāy iruntaṉa.  iṟantavarkaḷukkāka aṅku piramiṭ kōpuram cittira vēlaippāṭukaḷ niṟainta illaṅkaḷum iruntaṉa.  arappāvil cittira vēlaippāṭukaḷil atikac cirattaik kāṭṭappaṭavillai. iṟantavarkaḷukkākap periya camātikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭavillai.  uyarnta kōyilkaḷ kūṭa kaṭṭap paṭa villai.  āṉāl makkaḷ vāḻvataṟkēṟṟa cukātāramuḷḷa vacatiyāṉa vīṭukaḷ palakaṇikaḷ uḷḷatāy amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu kavaṉikkattakkatu.
ciṟiya illaṅkaḷ
arappāvil ēḻaikaḷ vāḻum ciṟu illaṅkaḷum cemmai yāka cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷaik koṇṭu oḻuṅkākak kaṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  avaikaḷ naṉṟākac cūḷaiyiliṭappaṭṭa cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷāl civappu niṟamuṭaiyatāka neṭukkum kuṟukkumāy aṭukki uṟutiyākavum aḻakākavum irukkumāṟu kavarcciyāka irukkumāṟu kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  perumpālum celvarkaḷ vīṭṭil maṭṭumiṉṟi ēḻaikaḷ vīṭukaḷilum taṉikkiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  potuk kiṇaṟukaḷ teruvilum uḷḷaṉa.  kiṇaṟukaḷ vaṭṭamāka amaikkappaṭṭatāl kiṇaṟukaḷ kaṭṭuvataṟkeṉṟu taṉiyāka vaḷainta ceṅkalkaḷ cūḷaiyil iṭappaṭṭu ventatākap pārttuk kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  cila iṭaṅkaḷil cuṇṇāmpuc cāntiṉālum ceṅkalkaḷ vaittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa cuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl perumpālāṉa vīṭṭuc cuvarkaḷ kaḷimaṇ cāntu koṇṭē kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  akkālattil cintu veḷiyil irunta kuḷirnta taṭpa nilaikku cuṭu maṇ cuvarkaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa vīṭukaḷ takka veppantaruvaṉavāy iruntirukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.  arappāvil uḷḷa enta vīṭukaḷilum māṭimuṉ mukappu (Balcony)  eṅkum kāṇavillai.  aṅku vāḻnta celvarkaḷum vayalkaḷukkup pōy ēr eṭuttu uḻutu vantirukka vēṇṭum  eṉṟu eṇṇuvataṟ kēṟpa celvarkaḷ vīṭukaḷil tavaṟātu oru kalappaiyuḷḷatu.  makaḷirkaḷ kōcā peṇkaḷāka illai.  vaṭa intiya intup peṇkaḷ pōl vīṭṭiṟkuḷ aṭaittu vaikkappaṭavillai.  camūka vāḻvil ellāt tuṟai kaḷilum pukuntu āṇkaḷōṭu ottuḻaittu camūkam uyarap pāṭupaṭṭu vantaṉar eṉṟu terikiṟatu-ovvoru vīṭṭilum malaṅkaḻikkat taṉiyiṭam iruntatu.
māṭa māḷikaikaḷ 
arappā periya parappāṉa cama nilattil amaikkappaṭṭa paḻam perum kōnakar.  celvarkaḷum, vaṇikarkaḷum, nilak kiḻārkaḷum maṉṉarkaḷum periya māṭa māḷikaikaḷ kaṭṭi ciṟappuṭaṉ vāḻntu vantuḷḷaṉar. māḷikaikaḷiṉ aṭippaṭaikaḷ akaṉṟatāy āḻam uḷḷaṉavāy naṉku cūḷaiyiṭappaṭṭa cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷai maṇ cāntu kalantu naṉṟāka moṅkāḷ pōṭṭu uṟutiyāṉa aṭaiyiṭṭu akalamāṉa cuvarkaḷ eḻuppi iraṇṭukku mēṟpaṭṭa māṭa māḷikaikaḷ uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ arappāvil pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl ciṟiya illaṅkaḷil aṭippaṭai iṭappaṭṭiruppatākat teriyavillai.  avaikaḷ uṭainta ōṭukaḷ ceṅkaṟtuṇṭukaḷ mutaliyavaṟṟai maṇ cāntu koṇṭu kalantu pōṭṭa aṭippaṭai mītu kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. māḷikaikaḷiṉ cuvarkaḷum, taḷaṅkaḷum, mūṭucākkaṭaikaḷum oruvitakkal koṇṭu naṉṟāka vaḻavaḻappākat tēyttu nīr aṭiyil kaciyāvaṇṇam uṟutiyāka amaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  taḷavaricaiyil iṭappaṭṭa kaṟkaḷ taḷataḷappākavum uṟutiyākavum iruntaṉa.  māṭip paṭik kaṭṭukaḷ uṟutiyāka amaikkappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  kuppait toṭṭikaḷ kaḻivu nīrt tēkkaṅkaḷ vāykkālkaḷ vaṭikālkaḷ nalla nilaiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  illaṅkaḷ tōṟum vaṭṭavaṭivilāṉa kiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  kiṇaṟukaḷukku nāṟpuṟamum kaipiṭic cuvarum kiṇaṟṟiṉiṉṟu kaḻivu nīr veḷiyē celvataṟku  caṟṟuc cāyvāṉa taḷamiṭappaṭṭa aṅkaṇamum uṭaiyatāy iruntaṉa.  ovvoru vīṭṭaic cuṟṟiyum maḻainīr veḷiyē ceṉṟu teruvil uḷḷa mūṭucākkaṭaikku cellattakkatāy ciṟu kālvāy kaṭṭappaṭṭiruntatu.
kūlak kaḷañciyam 
mokañcatārōvai viṭa arappāvil atikamāṉa kūlak kaḷañciyaṅkaḷ cālac ciṟappuṟṟiruntaṉa.  ivaikaḷ aṇi aṇiyāy aṭuttaṭuttu akalamum nīḷamum uyaramum uḷḷatāy amain tiruntaṉa.  oru kūlakkaḷañciyam 168 aṭi nīḷamum 13 aṭi akalamum 58 aṭi uyaramum uṭaiyatu.  ivaṟṟiṉ cuvar 9 aṭi kaṉam uḷḷatu.  ivai iraṇṭu varicaiyāyk kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ivviru varicaiyil oṉṟuk koṉṟuḷḷa tolaivu 23-aṭiyākum itaṉ mēlē uṟutiyāṉa taḷam - atāvatu maṭṭappāy pōṭap paṭṭirukkiṉṟatu.  ikkūlak kaḷañciyattiṉ iraṇṭu varicaiyāka eṭuppikkap peṟṟirukkum neṭiya cuvarkaḷuḷ ovvoru varicaiyilum āṟumaṇṭapaṅkaḷ amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru maṇṭapattaiyum cīrāka amaikkum vakaiyil aintu iṭaikaḷikaḷ amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru maṇṭapaṅ kaḷilum mūṉṟu neṭuñ cuvarkaḷ eḻuppap peṟṟu nāṉku aṟai kaḷākak pirikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  aṭiyil marappalakaikaḷ patikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ivaikaḷ kūlap poruḷkaḷai (tāṉiya maṇi kaḷai)k  koṭṭi vaippataṟkeṉṟē kaṭṭi vaikkap peṟṟatāyk kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ivaikaḷ aracāṅkap paṇṭaka cālaikaḷ pōlak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  itaṉāl ovvoru nilaccuvāṉtār kaḷum ērāḷamāṉa nilaṅkaḷai uṭaiyavarkaḷāy ciṟṟaracarkaḷ pōl vāḻntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  aracukku variyāka inta nilac cuvāṉtārkaḷ paṇam koṭātu kūlap poruḷkaḷaiyē aḷantu koṭuttirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷāl karutappaṭukiṟatu.1
ivaṟṟiṟku īṭāṉa kaḷañciyam ulakil eṅkum evarum kaṇṭatillai eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.
mokañcatārō 
mokañcatārō eṉṟa peyar ātikālattil  cintu veḷiyil vāḻnta makkaḷ iṭṭa peyar alla, intap pakutiyil uḷḷa makkaḷ, ippoḻutu immāvaṭṭa moḻiyil mokañcatārō (mohenjo-daro) - maṟaintōr maṇmēṭu eṉṉum poruḷpaṭum muṟaiyil peyariṭṭu aḻaittaṉar.  innakar 5000- m  āṇṭu muṉ aṭippaṭai iṭṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭa kō nakar ākum.  mutal kō nakar arappā.  arappā talainakarāka iruppatil pala iṭaiyūṟu irukkiṟatu eṉṟō allatu atu aḻipāṭuṟṟa teṉṟō mokañcatārōvai talainakarāka eḻuppi  irukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.
mokañcatārō nakar kaṭṭappaṭṭa iṭam mikap paranta camaveḷi ākum.  innakar ātiyilē naṉku tiṭṭamiṭṭuk kaṭṭap
paṭṭa mānakar ākum.  itu iraṇṭāvatu kōnakar āka irukkalām eṉṟum eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  itu mutalil oru caturak kal parappuṭaiyatu.  itil pattil oru pakutiyē akaḻntu āyvu ceyyap peṟṟatu.  innakar oru kālattil cīrum ciṟappumāy vāḻnta talainakarāka tikaḻntatu.  iṅkuḷḷa maṇmēṭṭiṉai akaḻntu kaṇṭeṭuttatiṉ payaṉāka ēḻaṭukkukaḷaik koṇṭa aḻinta nakaraik kaṇṭuḷḷaṉar.  1950-il innakariṉ ēḻāvatu aṭukkai iṉṟai (pākkitāṉ) araciṉ tol āyvuttuṟai akaḻ āyvuttuṟai iyakkunar taḷapati car mārṭṭi mar uyilar tōṇṭip pārttu mokañcatārō nākarikattil ettakaiya vēṟupāṭum kāṇappaṭavillai eṉṟu kūṟiṉār.
teru amaippu
mokañcatārōviṉ terukkaḷ kiḻakku mēṟkākavum teṟku vaṭakkākavum amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  teṉ kiḻakku, vaṭakiḻakkup paruvak kāṟṟiṉai uḷattiṟ koṇṭu nalla iḷaṅkāṟṟai etirpārttē terukkaḷ nīḷamākavum, akalamākavum amaikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  periya terukkaḷ 6-parlāṅku (mukkāl kal) nīḷam uṭaiyaṉa.  9-mutal 34-aṭi varai akalam uṭaiyaṉa.  periya terukkaḷil mūṉṟu vaṇṭikaḷ orē kālattil cellalām.  periya terukkaḷai pala kuṟunterukkaḷ nērāka veṭṭic celkiṉṟaṉa.  nāṉkaṭi akalamuḷḷa ciṟu cantukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  periya teruk
kaḷiṉiṉṟu kuṟunterukkaḷukku vaṇṭikaḷ cellum poḻutu teruviṉkaṭai kōṭiyil uḷḷa vīṭṭiṉ nērāṉa mūlaiyai cētappaṭuttāmal vīṭṭiṉ muṉai vaḷaivākak kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  ellāt terukkaḻivukaḷilum nīrppātai (mūṭu cākkaṭaikaḷ) uḷḷaṉa.  cantu muṉaiyil uḷḷa vaḷaivāṉa mūlaikaḷaiyuṭaiya vīṭukaḷiṉ arukil cellum mūṭu cākkaṭaiyum vaḷaivākavē amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  ovvoru kuṟunteruvilum kūṭa kiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷatu.  terukkaḷ nalla kāṟṟōṭṭam uḷḷaṉavāy irukkiṉṟaṉa.  cukātārattai naṉku kavaṉittu terukkaḷum vīṭukaḷum amaikkap
paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ varicaiyāka tam ellaikkuḷḷāka oḻuṅkāka amaikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa innakara makkaḷiṉ kuṭimaip paṇpu pōṟṟaṟkuriya tākum periya terukkaḷiṉ kōṭiyil kāvaṟ
kūṭaṅkaḷum ciṟṟuṇṭic cālaiyum uḷḷaṉa.
kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ amaippu muṟai
cintu veḷi makkaḷiṉ paṇpāṭum aṟivum nākarikamum avarkaḷiṉ kaṭṭiṭa amaippu muṟaiyil naṉku amaintu viḷaṅkukiṟatu.  ivarkaḷ eḻuppiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷukku cuṭṭa ceṅkaṟkaḷaiyum, ularnta maṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷaiyum payaṉpaṭutti yuḷḷaṉar.  ceṅkaṟkaḷ ellām orē aḷavil ceyyappaṭṭaṉa vākum.  atāvatu nīḷattiṟpāti akalam akalattiṟpātikaṉam.  ivaikaḷ tēvaikkēṟṟavāṟu palavaṭivil ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  cila caturamākavum cila vaḷaivākavum, cila mūlaikku ēṟṟavāṟu mukkōṇa vaṭivilum ceyyappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  ularnta maṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷaic cuṭuvataṟku kālvāykaḷ pala vaṭṭa vaṭivil iruntaṉa.  potuvākac ceṅkaṟkaḷ oṉpatu aṅkula nīḷamum 4 ½  aṅkula akalamum     2 ¼ aṅkulap parumaṉum uṭaiyaṉavāy uḷḷaṉa.  ceṅkaṟkaḷ mēṭupaḷḷaṅkaḷiṉṟi naṉṟāka aṟukkap paṭṭuc camaṉ ceyyap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  kiṇaṟu kaṭṭa taṉiyāṉa āppuc ceṅkal ceyyap paṭṭup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  kaḻivunīrkkāl vāykaḷ periya ceṅkaṟkaḷaik koṇṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭu mēlē mūṭap
paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  periya matilum araṇum amaippataṟku 29 aṅkula nīḷamum 14 ½ aṅkula akalamum 7 aṅkulap parumaṉum uṭaiya ceṅkaṟkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
mokañcatārōvil iraṇṭu, nāṉku, ēḻaṭukku varaiyuḷḷa uyarnta vīṭukaḷ kaṭṭap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  māṭikaḷ uyaramiṉṟi iruntaṉa.  mūṉṟaṭukku vīṭukaḷē atikam uḷḷaṉa.  iṅkuḷḷa makkaḷ taṅkaḷ nāṭṭiṉ taṭpa veppa nilaikaḷukkēṟpa kaṭṭiṭaṅ
kaḷaik kaṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.
kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiṉ puṟac cuvarkaḷai taṭpa veppa nilaikaḷ tākkuvatāl avaikaḷaic cuṭumaṇ ceṅkaṟkaḷāl amaittuḷḷaṉar.  taṭpa veppa nilaiyiṉ tākkutalkaḷukku uṭpaṭāta uṭpuṟac cuvarkaḷai ularnta-cūḷaiyiṭap peṟāta ceṅkaṟkaḷāl kaṭṭiyuḷḷār.  cuvarkaḷai, ceṅkaṟkaḷai vaittu maṇ cāntāṟ kaṭṭi, mēṟpūccākak kaḷimaṇ cāntaiyē pūci irukkiṉṟaṉar.  cila iṭaṅkaḷil kaḷimaṇṇuṭaṉ taviṭukalantu naṉṟākak kuḻaittu cāntākac ceytu meḻukiyuḷḷaṉar.  cuvarkaḷum, taraiyum kūraiyum kaḷimaṇṇāl pūcap peṟṟiruntatu.  cuvar mītu marattiṉālāṉa periya uttiraṅkaḷai vaittu avaṟṟiṉ mītu kūṭaikaḷaip parappi avaṟṟiṉ mītu nāṇaṟpāykaḷaip parappi appāykaḷ mītu kaḷimaṇ cāntaik kaṉamākap pūcik kūraimītu amaittu illam amaittu vāḻntaṉar kaṭṭiṭam kaṭṭum kottarkaḷ cuvarkaḷai oḻuṅkākavum nērākavum kaṭṭuvataṟku maṭṭap palakaikaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttiyuḷḷaṉar.  uttiraṅkaḷai vaippataṟkeṉṟē cuvarkaḷil periya caturamāka tuḷaikaḷai viṭṭiruntaṉar.  avaikaḷ iṉṟum naṉṟākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  kottarkaḷ cuvarkaḷaiyum taraiyaiyum mēṟkūraiyaiyum ciṟitum peritumāṉa maṭṭap palakaikaḷ, kaippāṇikaḷ, karaṇṭikaḷ mutaliyavaikaḷaip payaṉpaṭutti yuḷḷaṉar.  vīṭṭuc cuvarkaḷ cāḷaraṅkaḷ, vāyiṟpaṭikaḷ oḻuṅkāka vum peritākavum amaittu kaṭṭiṭam uṟutiyākavum vacatiyākavum amaittiruppatu akkālak kottarkaḷ kaṭṭiṭa amaippil niṟainta paṭṭaṟivuṭaiyavarkaḷ eṉpataip pulappaṭuttukiṟatu.
cuvarkaḷ ceṅkaṟkaḷai vaittu maṇ cāntu koṇṭu kaṭṭi eḻuppap peṟṟatāl uṟutiyāka irukka cuvarkaḷ akalamāka amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  vīṭṭuc cuvarkaḷ mūṉṟarai aṭimutal āṟu aṭi varai akalam uḷḷatāy mikapparumaṉāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  cintu āṟṟiṉ veḷḷattai eṇṇiyē cuvarkaḷ parumaṉāka amaikkap paṭṭirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  oṉṟiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa māṭikaḷaiyuṭaiya māḷikaikaḷ amaikkumpōtu mēl uḷḷa pārattait tāṅkuvataṟkāka cuvarkaḷiṉ akalam nīṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  oru periya kaṭṭiṭattiṉ oru cuvar akalam 5 aṭi 9 aṅkula kaṉamuṭaiyatāyum piṟa cuvarkaḷ 3 aṭi 6 aṅkulam, 4 aṭi 10- aṅkulam, 4 aṭi 5 aṅkulam uḷḷatāy amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  25 aṭi akalattil oru cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa araṇum uḷḷatu.
mokañcatārōvil pala tiṟappaṭṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  iraṇṭu, mūṉṟu, nāṉku nilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya vīṭukaḷ ērāḷamāka uḷḷaṉa.  akaṉṟa muṟṟaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya orē aṭukkuṭaiya māṭamuṭaiya vīṭukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ellā illaṅkaḷum mēṟṟaḷam uṭaiyavaikaḷākavē irukkiṉṟaṉa.  nālu puṟamum mēṟṟaḷattil kaipiṭiccuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. mēṟṟaḷattil viḻum maḻai nīr mēṟṟaḷattil ciṟitu nēramum taṅka vaḻiyiṉṟi kīḻē iṟaṅka mēṟṟaḷattil vāṭṭam vaittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭiruppatōṭu kīḻē nīr vantu cēra kuḻāykaḷum vaikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  kuḻāykaḷ maṇṇālum marattālum āṉavai.
ciṟiya illam
ciṟiya illaṅkaḷum pala uḷḷaṉa.  avai pāṭṭāḷi makkaḷiṉ illam eṉa eṇṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ciṟiya illam 4-aṟaikaḷ uḷḷatāy 30 aṭi nīḷamum 27 aṭi akalamum uṭaiyatu.  ivaikaḷ ellām ceṅkaṟkaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷēyākum.  ivaṟṟiṉ taḷam cāṇattiṉāl meḻukappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi kuṭilkaḷ amaittu vāḻum ēḻaikaḷ iruntiruppārō eṉṟa aiyamum uṇṭākiṟatu.  cintuveḷip paṇpāṭṭil piccaikkārarkaḷum illātavarkaḷum iruntiruppārkaḷā eṉṟu aiyam eḻukiṟatu.
cila periya māḷikaikaḷiṉ naṭuvil akaṉṟa muttaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  ataṉaic cuṟṟip pala aṟaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  aṟaikaḷ ciṟitāka nalla kāṟṟōṭṭam uḷḷatāyk kāṇappaṭu kiṉṟaṉa.  vāyiṟpaṭiyum kūraiyum uyarntatāy irukkiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl itaṉ upayōkam namakkup pulappaṭavillai.  ittakaiya illaṅkaḷ pala tamiḻ nāṭṭil iṉṟum uḷḷaṉa.
pērillam
akkālattu vēḷāṇmaiyāl uyarnta vāḻvaip peṟṟa peruṅkuṭimakkaḷ kūṭṭukkuṭumpa vāḻkkaiyaip peritum nāṭi vāḻntaṉar.  tāy tantaiyuṭaṉ āṇmakkaḷ taṅkaḷ tuṇaiviyarōṭum, peṇmakkaḷ taṅkaḷ kaṇavarōṭum oru illattil oṟṟumaiyuṭa ṉum aṉpuṭaṉum vāḻntu vantuḷḷaṉar.  itaṉai avarkaḷuṭaiya periya illamum avaṟṟiluḷḷa pala aṟaikaḷum naṉku eṭuttukkāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.  periya vīṭukaḷil cakōtararkaḷ vāḻvataṟku vīṭṭiṉiṭaiyē neṭuñcuvarkaḷ vaittu vīṭu pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
akkālattil kūlap poruḷkaḷai cēkarittuvaikkum kutirkaḷ pōṉṟavaikaḷ taraiyil patippittu vaikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  cila illaṅkaḷil māṭaṅkaḷum cuvar aṟaikaḷum amaintu uḷḷaṉa.  cila vīṭukaḷil camaiyaṟ pāṇṭaṅkaḷai vaittaṟkuriya marap peṭṭakaṅkaḷ cuvarkaḷil patippikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
māḷikaikaḷ
celvarkaḷ vāḻum māṭaṅkaḷ uḷḷa māḷikaikaḷ pala uḷḷaṉa.  avai iraṇṭiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa aṭukkukaḷaiyuṭaiya māḷikaikaḷ ākum.  ivai akaṉṟa kūṭaṅkaḷ, nīṇṭa tāḻ
vāraṅkaḷ periya muṟṟaṅkaḷ iṭai kaḻikaḷ ciṟiya vāyilkaḷ ciṟitum peritumāṉa pala aṟaikaḷaiyum uṭaiyaṉa.  ivaṟṟil uḷḷa mēṉilai māṭaṅkaḷ ceṅkal taḷavaricaikaḷai uṭaiyaṉa.  cila mēṉmāṭaṅkaḷ paṭukkai aṟaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  cila māṭaṅkaḷil payilum iṭam,nīrāṭum aṟaikaḷ, malaṅkaḻikkum ciṟṟaṟaikaḷ pōṉṟavaikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  māṭaṅkaḷukkuc cella ceṅkaṟ
kaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa paṭikkaṭṭukaḷum, marattiṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa paṭikkaṭṭukaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  cila māṭaṅkaḷukku ēṇikaḷ mūlam celvatum uṇṭeṉṟu terikiṉṟatu.  paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ perumpālāṉa māḷikaikaḷil veḷippuṟamē amaintuḷḷatu.  cila vīṭukaḷil paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uṭpuṟam uḷḷaṉa.  oru māḷikaiyil iraṇṭu paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ oṉṟiṟ koṉṟu aṇmaiyilē irukkumpaṭi kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  itu periya talaivaṉuṭaiya illam pōl kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  oru māḷikaiyiṉ muṉpuṟam cumār 100 aṭi muṉpuṟam akaṉṟa muṟṟam uḷḷatu.  piṉpuṟam 100 aṭi akaṉṟa tōṭṭam uḷḷatu. 
māperum māḷikai
iṅkuḷḷa māḷikaikaḷ aṉaittiṉum periya māḷikai oṉṟu mikavum uyaramākavum akaṉṟu nīṇṭatāyum aḻaku niṟaintatāyum uḷḷatu.  inta māḷikai 242 aṭi nīḷamum 112 aṭi akalamum uḷḷatu.  itaṉ aṇmaiyil itai viṭac caṟṟuk kuṟainta aḷavil 177-aṭi nīḷamum 117aṭi akalamum uṭaiya māḷikai oṉṟum kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  itaṟku aṭuttāṟ pōṟ maṟṟoru ciṟiya māḷikai oṉṟu uḷḷatu.  ataṉ vaṭapuṟam 87aṭi nīḷamum teṉpuṟam 83 aṭi nīḷamum uḷḷa cuvarkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  mēṟkup puṟac cuvar 38 aṭi nīḷamum kiḻakkup puṟaccuvar 48 aṭi nīḷamum uḷḷatu.  iṅku pala aṟaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  vīṭṭiṉ piṉpuṟam vaṭṭavaṭivāṉa kiṇaṟum uḷḷatu.  iṅku 4 aṭi akalamuḷḷa caturamāṉa tūṇkaḷ pala kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  it tūṇkaḷ inta māḷikaiyiṉ vaḷaivukaḷait tāṅkupavai.
inta māḷikaikaḷiṉ aṇmaiyil 56-aṭi nīḷamāṉa ciṟu viṭuti uḷḷatu.  itil nīṇṭa tūṇkaḷaik koṇṭa maṇṭapam, pala kūṭaṅkaḷum uḷḷa vaḻikaḷuṭaṉ kūṭiya pala aṟaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  inta aṟaikaḷ paṇṭaṅkaḷai vaippataṟkum camaiyal ceyvataṟkum, tuyilvataṟkum uṇavu uṇpataṟkum ēṟpaṭṭaṉa.  itu aracaṉatu araṇmaṉaiyāka irukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu. aṭutta māḷikaikaḷ amaiccar iḷavaracar pōṉṟavarkaḷiṉ māḷikaikaḷum ēvalāḷarkaḷiṉ illaṅkaḷumāka irukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇap
paṭukiṟatu.
iṅkuḷḷa illaṅkaḷil makaḷirkaḷ vacippataṟkut taṉiyiṭamum, māḷikai vāyiṟpuṟattai aṭuttu kāvalarkku oru ciṟṟam iruntatu.  vīṭṭiṉ piṉpuṟam vīṭṭukkārarkaḷ amarntu pēcuvataṟkēṟṟa kūṭaṅkaḷum uṇṭu.  ovvoru vīṭṭilum camaiyal aṟaikaḷum, paṭukkai aṟaikaḷum tavaṟātu uḷḷaṉa.  taṉiyē kuḷikkum aṟaikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  kuḷippaṟaikaḷ teruppakkam uḷḷaṉa.  ceṅkaṟkaḷāl taḷavaricai iṭappaṭṭu aṟaikaḷ cuttamāka uḷḷaṉa.  kaḻivu nīr ōṭa vaṭikālkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  vaṭikāl teruvil uḷḷa mūṭu cākkaṭaiyuṭaṉ poruntiyuḷḷatu.  nīrāṭumaṟaiyiṉ taraimaṭṭam caṟṟu carintu veḷiyē nīr celvataṟku ēṟṟavāṟu amaintuḷḷatu.
camaiyal aṟai
ovvoru vīṭṭilum taṉiyē camaiyal aṟai iruntatu.  aṅku viṟaku vaikkavum piṟa, camaiyaṟ paṇṭaṅkaḷai vaikkavum taṉi iṭam iruntatu eṉṟālum camaiyal muṟṟattiṉ aṇmaiyil ceyvatum uṇṭu.  camaiyal aṟaiyil periyatāḻikaḷ patippikkap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  camaiyal aṟaiyil tāḻikaḷ patippikkappaṭṭa aṭaiyāḷaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ivai nīraic cēmittu vaippataṟkāka iruntirukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu. camaiyalukkuriya cāmāṉkaḷ vaikkap palamaṇ cāṭikaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭaṉa.  inta vaḻakkam iṉṟum mokañcatārōvaic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa kirāmattā riṭam nilavukiṉṟatu.  ovvoru vīṭṭilum camaiyal aṟaiyil aṭuppukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  cila vīṭukaḷil aṭuppukaḷ kāṇappaṭāviṭi ṉum aṭuppukaḷ iruntataṟkuriya aṭaiyāḷaṅkaḷ terikiṉṟaṉa.  inta aṭuppukaḷ mecapottāmiyāvil uḷḷa aṭuppukaḷaip pōṉṟavaikaḷāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.
kōyil
mokañcatārō cintu veḷi akaḻ āyvil arappāviṟku aṭutta toṉmaiyāṉa nakaram.  āṉāl arappāvai viṭa nalla nilaiyil aḻivuṟāta nilaiyil irukkiṟatu eṉṟu akaḻ āyvil īṭupaṭṭa ār.ṭi. pāṉarcci avarkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār. mokañcatārōvil maṭṭumalla cintu veḷiyilē eṇṇaṟṟa civa liṅkaṅkaḷum, tāyt teyva uruvaṅkaḷum, civaperumāṉ tiru uruvam tīṭṭap peṟṟa muttiraikaḷum, nanti(kāḷai) uruvam tīṭṭappaṭṭa muttiraikaḷum, tāyattukaḷum kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa.  oru naṭarācar uruvam kūṭa kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa.   iḵtaṉṟi pala nīrt teyvam, nilat teyvam, marat teyvam, mīṉ teyvam pōṉṟa eṇṇaṟṟa teyva uruvaṅkaḷ kiṭaittaṉa. civaliṅkaṅkaḷum, civaṉār uruvam, avaratu kāḷai vākaṉamākiya nanti uruvamum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu tirāviṭa moḻipayiṉṟa, caiva neṟiyait  taḻuviya vēḷāḷar paṇpāṭu eṉpatai uṟutippaṭutta oppaṟṟa mutal tarac cāṉṟāka iruntaṉa.  cintu veḷi nākarikam āriya nākarikam eṉṟu varalāṟṟaip poyp paṭutta muṉvanta cila cātiveṟiyum, camaya veṟiyum koṇṭa aṟiñarkaḷ muyaṟci muṟiyaṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.  avarkaḷ iṟutiyāka cintu veḷi muttirai
kaḷil poṟikkappaṭṭa ōviya eḻuttukkaḷai vaṭa moḻic cārpāṉatu eṉṟu nilai nāṭṭa muyaṉṟaṉar.  anta iṟuti muyaṟciyum ulāntāviṉ talainakarāṉa kōpaṉ hēkaṉ, kāṇṭi nēviyaṉ, āciyar ārāycci nilaiyam, mākō, leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalaik kaḻakaṅkaḷiṉ palvēṟu tuṟaikaḷilumuḷḷa aṟiñarkaḷiṉ kuḻuvum cērntu cintu veḷi muttiraikaḷilum, tāyattukaḷilum kāṇappaṭum ōviya eḻuttu kaḷukku maṟaikuṟi eḻuttup poruḷ viḷakkam (Deceipherment)  ceyya muyaṉṟu, tamiḻ aṟiñar, tirāviṭa moḻikaḷiṉ ārāycci vallunar tuṇai koṇṭum mika nuṇṇiya kaṇita miṉ aṇuk karuviyiṉ (Computer)  tuṇai koṇṭum uṟutiyāka cintu veḷi ōviya eḻuttukkaḷ tirāviṭa moḻi eḻuttukkaḷē eṉṟu ulakiṟku uṇarttiyuḷḷaṉar.
cintu veḷiyiṉ akaḻ āyvil kōyilkaḷē kāṇappaṭa villai eṉṟu cilar karutukiṉṟaṉar.  atu tavaṟu cintu veḷiyil kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa eṉṟu ṭākṭar mekkē avarkaḷ tiṭṭa
vaṭṭamāka eṭuttukkāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  ataṉai car cāṇmārcal, car mārṭṭimar uyilar pōṉṟavarkaḷ ātarittuḷḷaṉar.  cintu veḷiyil ki.mu. 3000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ eḻunta paṇpāṭu, oru perum nākarikattaip paṭaitta makkaḷuṭaiyatu eṉpatu pulaṉāyiṟṟu.  ataṉai tāmira nākarikak kālam eṉṟu varalāṟṟu āciriyarkaḷ kūṟukiṟārkaḷ.  iṅku āḻamāka akaḻntu pārtta poḻutu  cevvaiyāka amaikkappeṟṟa kōyilkaḷum vīṭukaḷum kāṇappeṟṟaṉa. kōyilkaḷil    ciṟu aṟaikaḷ kaṉamāṉa cuvarkaḷai uṭaiyaṉavāy iruntaṉa.  ataṉāl aṟaikaḷukku mēl vimāṉam pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ iruntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu terikiṟatu.  anta aṟaikaḷaic cuṟṟi vicālamāṉa muṟṟamum ammuṟṟattiṉ nāṉku puṟaṅkaḷilum ciṟu māṭaṅkaḷum kāṇap
paṭṭaṉa.  naṭuvil uḷḷa aṟai tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyāka (mūlatāṉamāka) irukkalām.  malaiyāḷattuk kōyil amaippu ataṉai yottatu pōlum.  caṅkut taṭṭukaḷ, nīla vaḷaiyalkaḷ, tōṇṭi yeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  cila muttiraikaḷil aracamaram, māṉ kompu, puli, yāṉai, kāṇṭāmirukam mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ vaṭivaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  kutiraivaṭivam kāṇappaṭa villai eṉṟu tiru.kā.cuppiramaṇiya piḷḷai avarkaḷ mika viḷakkamākat tam nūlil eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.   iṅku kōyilkaḷ iruntaṉa.  kōyilkaḷiṉ tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ tamiḻakattaip pōla iliṅkaṅkaḷ iruntaṉa eṉpatai mutalil kaṇṭavar car.cāṇmārcal avarkaḷēyākum.  avartam nūlil itaip paṟṟi virivāka eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
aṅku kaṇṭa inta vicālamāṉatum, nuṭpamāṉa periya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cila taṉippaṭṭa celvarkaḷiṉ conta māḷikaiyāka yirukkalām.  allatu avaikaḷiṟ cila tirukkōyilkaḷāka irukkalām eṉṟu teḷivāka āyntu muṭivu ceyya muṭiya villai.  mecapottāmiyāvil teyvam uṟaiyum tiruk kōyilkaḷ vaḻipāṭṭu nērvuk kuṟikkōḷ uḷḷatāyum, viḷakkamāṉa kuṟikkōḷaik koṇṭatāyumuḷḷa maṉṉarkaḷiṉ māḷikaiyākavum irukkum-atāvatu uṇavai uṇṭu nīrai aruntum kaṭavuḷiṉ kuṭiyiruppu iṭaṅkaḷākavum, maraṇam aṭaiyak kūṭiya ētāvatu ōr iḷavaracaṉ kaḷikoḷḷac cey
vikkappaṭṭatākavum irukkum.  taṉṉuṭaiya camayac caṭaṅkaḷ ceyyum peṇ pūcāriyiṉ tirumaṇa vaipavaṅkaḷukkākavum irukkalām.  atē nōkkattōṭu mokañcatārōvil amaikkap paṭṭa pērillamākavum irukkalām eṉṟu eṇṇalām.  ivai
kaḷil cila vitivilakkāka periya vicālamāṉa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cila kaṭavuḷkaḷukkāka kaṭṭappaṭṭa illaṅkaḷāka irukkalām.  mutalāvatu, iraṇṭāvatu aintāvatu āṟāvatu eṇṇuḷḷa mēlē kaṇṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ ciṟappāka vaḻipāṭṭiṟkuriya tirukkōyilukku eṉṟu otukkivaikkappaṭṭa iṭamāka irukkum eṉṟu karutalām.  iṉṉum pala iṭaṅkaḷil kiṭaittuḷḷa taṉicciṟappumikka āvuṭaiyār vaṭivaṅkaḷ (ringstones)  pōṉṟa poruḷ camayak kōṭpāṭṭu muṟaiyil vaḻipaṭupavaikaḷāka irukkalām eṉṟu nampuvataṟkup pōtiya kāraṇaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ivaikaḷai yellām āyntu pārkkum poḻutu cintu veḷimakkaḷ kirīṭtīviluḷḷa miṉōvarkaḷ pōṉṟu potuvāṉa vaḻipaṭu iṭaṅkaḷ amaikkāmal iruntirukkalām eṉṟum karuta iṭamuṇṭu.  appaṭiyē avarkaḷ kōyil amaittiruntālum iṉṟaiya intiyak kōyil pōlaṉṟi cātāraṇamāka makkaḷ vāḻum illaṅkaḷ pōṉṟu kōyilkaḷ amaittirukkalām eṉṟu karuta muṭiyum.1
ēṉaiya kōyil amaippukaḷ
mokañcatārōvil uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ palavaṟṟil pala vaṟṟiṉ upayōkam nammāl tiṭṭa vaṭṭamāka nirṇayikkap paṭavillai.  avaikaḷil cila tirukkōyilkaḷāka irukkalām; allatu vēṟākavum irukkalām. cila pakutikaḷil uḷḷa ciṟiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cila iraṇṭu aṟai vīṭukaḷil oṉṟu peritākavum maṟṟoṉṟu pakkattē pirakāram pōl ciṟitākavum uḷḷaṉa.  atē iṭattil 5-āvatu piḷāk oru periya amaippu periya maiya araiyai uḷ kūṟākak koṇṭirukkiṟatu.  iraṇṭu aṟai
kaḷukkum iṭaiyēyuḷḷa naṭaik kūṭam ataṉ mēṟkup puṟattilum teṟkup puṟattilum oru cuvarum iraṇṭu ciṟu aṟaikaḷum ataṉ teṟkup pakutiyil cila periya aṟaikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ataṉ vaṭakku puṟattil kaṭṭiṭattiṉ mūlappakuti teḷivaṟṟatāy aṭippakuti piṉṉar eḻuntatākak kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  iṭatu pakuti aḻivuṟṟuḷḷatu; aṭippaṭai maṭṭum uḷḷatu.  itu vaḻakkattiṟku māṟākat tiṇmaiyāka 10-aṭi āḻattil karaṭumuraṭāṉa ceṅkallāl aṭippaṭaiyiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu itu aḻakāka mēlkaṭṭumāṉam uḷḷatāy mikunta akkaṟaiyōṭu  maiyappakutiyil mēlē oru cikara amaippai uṇṭupaṇṇi irukkiṟatu.
atē pōṉṟu maṟṟoru  kaṭṭiṭam nīṇṭa caturam uḷḷatāka irukkiṟatu.  teṉpuṟam oru ciṟiya oṭukkamāṉa aṟaiyum mēṟkuppuṟam iraṇṭu vēṟu ciṟu aṟaikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  ivai eṇ 1-il piḷāk 4, cekcaṉ vi.e parappil uḷḷatu.  itil uḷḷa mūṉṟāvatu aṟai oṉṟil kaṇicamāṉa aḷavu maṉita elumpukaḷum, cāmpalum, maṭpāṇṭaṅkaḷum pāttiraṅkaḷum ēṉaiya poruḷkaḷum iruntatu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭatu.  intak kaṭṭiṭam oru taṉip
paṭṭa maṉitaṉuṭaiya kuṭi iruppu iṭamāka eṇṇuvataṟkillai.  itu oru potu iṭamākavō, puṉita illamākavō, vaḻipaṭum iṭamākavō karutattakkatākum.  iṟutiyāy oru kuṉṟup pakutiyiṉ oru ciṟiya aḻipāṭu kāṇappaṭṭatu.  atu ṭikē parappil 2-vatu piḷākkil ē.cekcaṉil kāṇappaṭum inta aḻipāṭukaḷ tiru tīkcitar avarkaḷāl akaḻ āyvu ceytu ōr uṟutiyāṉa oru puṉita kōyilāka irukkiṟatu eṉṟu muṭiviṟku vantār.
iṅku kōyilkaḷ pōl pala kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ akaḻ āyvil kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.  āṉāl avaikaḷil teyva uruvaṅkaḷō pūcaikkuriya  poruḷkaḷō kiṭaikkavillai.  āṉāl uṟutiyāka cintu veḷi makkaḷ civaṉ, cakti mutaliya teyva vaḻipāṭṭuk kārarkaḷ.  uruvaṅkaḷai vaittu vaḻipaṭṭuvantaṉar eṉpataṟkum aiyam illai.  iṉṟaiya teṉ intiyat tirāviṭarkaḷaip pōl tirukkōyil kaṭṭi cilaikaḷ amaittu vaḻipaṭavillai.  Ändht®(Minoar)  pōṉṟu makkaḷ vāḻum illattilum araṇmaṉaiyilum teyva uruvaṅkaḷai vaittu vaḻipaṭ ṭirukkalām eṉṟē cilar karutukiṟārkaḷ.  kālkaḷaik kuṟukkāka vaittuk koṇṭirukkum (āṭavallāṉ) teyva vaṭivam, pāmpu, tēvi, liṅkam mutaliyaṉa kōyilkaḷil kāṇappaṭṭaṉa.  civaliṅkaṅkaḷ ērāḷamākak kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭaṉa. kālattāṟ piṟpaṭṭa iṭaṅkaḷil pirētaṅkaḷaip putaippatu māttira mallāmal avaṟṟaic cuṭṭeritta cāmpalaiyum elumpaiyum periya maṇpāṇṭattil vaittu putaippatum avaṟṟiṉ mēl ceṅkalliṉāl camāti pōṉṟa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ amaippatum pulaṉāyiṉa.  putaiyal, nilaṅkaḷil kāṇappaṭṭa muttiraiyil uḷḷa eḻuttukkaḷ mutalil paṭa eḻuttāyiruntu piṉ olikaḷaik kuṟippaṉalāyiṉa avaṟṟai āynta hīrā aṭikaḷ avai tamiḻ eḻuttukkaḷiṉ mūlavaṭivukaḷāy iruttal kūṭum eṉṟār. cintu nākarikam ekiptiya nākarikattiṉiṉṟum, cumēriyā nākarikatti ṉiṉṟum vantatu eṉṟu cilar kūṟiṉar.  āṉāl karṉal ālkāṭ ekiptiya nākarikamē pāṇṭiya nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu (paṇṭu nāṭṭi ṉiṉṟu) vantatu eṉṟum intiya nākarikattōṭu oppuvamai kāṭṭi yuḷḷār.1
ciṟappu vāynta ceykuḷam
cintu veḷiyiṉ kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyaip paṟṟi nūl eḻutum evarum mokañcatārōvil uḷḷa ciṟappumikka ceykuḷam (Great Bath)  paṟṟi eḻutāmal viṭṭuviṭuvārāyiṉ atu oru niṟaivāṉa nulāka eṇṇappaṭattakka taṉṟu.  annūl  aṟiñarkaḷāl ciṟappāṉatu eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷ matikka māṭṭārkaḷ.  kuḷattil nīr niṟkum iṭam 39 aṭi nīḷamum 23 aṭi akalamum 8 aṭi āḻamum uḷḷatu.  itaṉ veḷippuṟaccuvar 7 allatu 8 aṭi akalamuḷḷatu.  iṉṟaiyap perum nakaril uḷḷa nīccal kuḷaṅkaḷaip pōl vacatiyum, cokucum eḻilum ēṟṟamum uṭaiyatu.  kuḷattil aṇmaiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭu uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅ kaḷaiyellām cērttuk kaṇakkiṭṭāl 180-aṭi nīḷamum 108-aṭiyum uḷḷa oru pōtiya nilap parappil ikkuḷam kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.1  ikkuḷattiṉ nīr niṟkum pakutiyaic cuṟṟi nāṟpuṟamum naṭaipātaikaḷ uḷḷaṉa. naṭaipātai uṭpuṟam uyarntu veḷippuṟam cāyntu maṭṭam vaittuk kaṭṭap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  maḻai peytāl naṭaiyil viḻum nīr oru coṭṭum uḷḷēyuḷḷa kuḷattu nīril kalakkātu veḷiyē ceṉṟu viṭum kuḷattiṟku aṭutta naṭai pātaiyiṉ viḷimpil nāṟpuṟamum kaipiṭiccuvarkaḷ eḻuppap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  naṭaipātaiyiṉ ovvoru muṉaiyilum uyaramāṉa mēṭai oṉṟu uḷḷatu.  ammēṭaikkuc cella pala paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  ippātaiyai aṭuttup periya cuvar uḷḷatu.  ataṉ mītum naṭaipātai uṇṭu.
ipperuṅkuḷattiṉ aṭippakuti-nīr niṟkum iṭam nalla vaḻavaḻappāṉa ceṅkaṟkaḷāl maṇṇum cuṇṇamum kalanta cāntum koṇṭu kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  ataṉ mītu oru vitat tār (kīl) pūcappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  kuḷattiṉ aṭippākam varai celvataṟku vaṭapuṟamum teṉpuṟamum varicaiyākap paṭikkaṭṭukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  
6 ½ aṭi uyarattil kaḻivu nīrai veḷiyē akaṟṟi viṭṭu putiya nīrai uḷḷē koṇṭuvara nalla matakum uṇṭu.  
ikkuḷattil mūṉṟu puṟaṅkaḷilum tāḻvāraṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  tāḻvāraṅkaḷil curaṅkap pātaiyum muṭiyil eṭṭu māṭiyuḷḷa aṟaikaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  aṟaikaḷ ikkuḷattil kuḷikkum camaya kurukkaḷ evarum aṟiyāvaṇṇam vantu kuḷittu viṭṭu aṟaikaḷukkuc ceṉṟu uṭaimāṟṟam ceyvataṟkāka amaikkap paṭṭirukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.  civaṉ kōyilil pūcai ceyyum camaya kurumārkaḷ āṟukālap pūcaikkum āṟumuṟai kuḷikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu tamiḻ nāṭṭup pūcārikaḷiṉ vaḻiyil  ivarkaḷum āṟukāl kuḷippai (nāṉattai) viṭātu piṉpaṟṟi irukkalām eṉṟu karutappaṭukiṟatu.
intak kuḷattiṟku nīrai nirappuvataṟkuk kuḷattiṉ ciṟitu tolaivil mūṉṟu periya kiṇaṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avaikaḷiṉiṉṟē nīrai iṟaittu ciṟu kālvāy mūlam nīrai vārttu nirappukiṟārkaḷ.
ikkuḷattiṉ aṭippakutiyil uḷḷa taḷattil pūcappaṭṭiruk kum nilakkīl intiyāvil kiṭaippatillai.  itu ayal nāṭṭiliruntē koṇṭuvarappaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum.  inta nilakkīl cumēriyāvil uṇṭu.  cumēriyar tam kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷai   inta nilakkīl mūlamē aḻakum uṟutiyum ceytu vantaṉar.  eṉavē cintu veḷi vaṇikarkaḷ intak kīlai cumēriyariṭamiruntu peṟṟiruttal vēṇṭum.
cintu veḷi nākarikamum tamiḻakamum
1922-il cintu veḷi akaḻ āyvu ceyyappaṭṭu, akaḻ āyvuttuṟaiyiṉ talaivarum intiya maiya araciṉ tolporuḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉ iyakkunar talaivar car cāṇ mārcal cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭiṉ mūlakarttarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷ eṉṟu uṟutiyāka 1931-il ulakiṟku uṇarttiyuḷḷār.  avarukkup piṉṉar intiya maiya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvu iyakkunar kaḷiṉ taḷapatiyāka vanta car mārṭṭimar uyilarum mokañcatārō akaḻ āyvai poruppuṭaṉ naṭattiya pērāciriyar ār.ṭi. pāṉarcciyum, pērāciriyar ṭākṭar kōrṭaṉ cailṭu ṭākṭar ji.ār.haṇṭar, ṭākṭar eyc.ār. hāl - pērāciriyar lāṅṭaṉ, e-ē-vāṭal aṟiñar eyc.hirā aṭikaḷ, ṭākṭar akōpārpōlā, ṭākṭar koṉaracōv pōṉṟa eṇṇaṟṟa aṟiñarkaḷ cintu veḷippaṇpāṭu tirāviṭap paṇpāṭu eṉṟu eṇṇaṟṟa nūṟkaḷ mūlam uṟutippaṭuttiyuḷḷār.
eṉṟālum āriyap paṇṭitarkaḷ cilarum āccārikaḷum pairākikaḷum, paṇṭāraṅkaḷum lampāṭikaḷum cintu veḷip paṇpāṭu āriyappaṇpāṭu eṉṟu ataṟṟippitaṟṟit tirivatai iṉṉum niṟuttavillai. cintuveḷip paṇpāṭu āriyappaṇpāṭu eṉṟāl cintu veḷiyiṉ vīḻccikkup piṉ āriyarkaḷ cintu veḷi nakaraṅkaḷaip pōṉṟa nakaraṅkaḷai kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷai niṟuviṉar eṉṟu oru ciṟu cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyumā?  muṭiyātu.  āṉāl cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭai viṭa cīriya paṇpāṭu ilaṅkaiyil iruntatāka vāṉmīki kūṟiyuḷḷār.  cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭai viṭa cīriya paṇpāṭṭai ciṟanta nakarai, vāṉ aḷāviya māṭa māḷikaikaḷai, tirukkōyilkaḷai eṭuppittaṉar eṉṟutamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ cāṉṟu pakarkiṉṟaṉa iṉṟu kūṭa tamiḻnāṭṭut tirukkōyilkaḷai vaṭa nāṭṭil kāṇa muṭiyavillai eṉpatu maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmai.

tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭakkalai - 
ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷ
tamiḻ nāṭṭil cumār pattāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē makkaḷ naṉku vāḻa muṟpaṭṭuviṭṭaṉar.  nāṭum nakarum pēr ūrum ciṟṟūrum eḻat toṭaṅkiviṭṭaṉa.  aracum muracum, paṭaiyum kuṭaiyum, araṇum, tiṟaṉum, akamum, pukaḻum, kōyilum, kōṭṭamum, māḷikaikaḷum, maṉaikaḷum, māṭaṅkaḷum kūṭaṅkaḷum, maṇṭapaṅkaḷum eḻuntu viṭṭaṉa.
aṉṟu, iṉṟu pōl kaṟṟaḷikaḷō, ceṅkaṟkaḷum, cuṇṇaccāntum vaittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷō kaṭṭap peṟātatāl avai nīṇṭa nāḷ aḻiyātu nilaittu niṟka muṭiyavillai.  mēlum aṭuttaṭuttut tamiḻakattil eḻunta pala kaṭaṟ kōḷkaḷ, aṉaittaiyum koḷḷai koṇṭu pōy viṭṭaṉa. perumpālāṉa ēṭukaḷ kūṭa aḻintu pōy viṭṭaṉa.  eṉṟālum eñciya oru cila ēṭukaḷ iṉṟum pīṭutarum cāṉṟukaḷāka uḷḷaṉa.  atōṭu iṉṟu eḻuntuḷḷa aṟiviyal āyvu muṟaikaḷum ariya tuṟaikaḷum ki.mu 1000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉiruntu 10,000 -m āṇṭukaḷ varai teṉṉintiyāvaippaṟṟiyum aṅku vāḻnta makkaḷiṉ moḻi, vāḻkkai, kalai, paṇpāṭu, nākarikam, vīṭu, māḷikai, kōyil mutaliyavaṟṟai aṟiyattuṇai ceykiṉṟaṉa.
ki.mu. 3000 -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ cintu veḷiyil eḻunta tirāviṭa nākarikattiṉ ciṟappai M§»nya®-r®.jah‹ mārcal avarkaḷ talaimaiyil niṟuvap peṟṟa intiyat tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟai, cintu veḷiyil 5000 -m āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ putaiyuṇṭa paṇpāṭum, nakaraṅkaḷum tirāviṭa makkaḷukku uriyatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku uraittār.
paṇṭaikkāla makkaḷiṉ varalāṟṟaiyum moḻikaḷaiyum, ōviya eḻuttukkaḷaiyum aṟiviyal muṟaiyil āyvataṟkup payiṉṟa paṇpāḷarum kattōlikka camayakuruvum peyiṉ tēca nāṭṭiṟ piṟantavarum mētaku pulavarum pampāy cavēriyār kallūri varalāṟṟāciriyarum putiya aṟiviyal pāṅkil paṇṭaik kāla makkaḷ eḻutiya ōviya eḻuttuk kalaikaḷukku maṟaikuṟiyeḻuttu mūlattiṉ poruḷ viḷakkam (Decpher) kāṇum tuṟaiyiṉaip paḻutaṟap payiṉṟa pāvāṇarumāṉa heṇṭiri hirā aṭikaḷ cintu veḷi muttiraikaḷilum, tāyattukaḷilum kāṇappeṟṟa eḻuttukkaḷaip paṭittu atu tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷāl eḻutappaṭṭa eḻuttu eṉṟum cintu veḷi nākarikam tamiḻarkaḷiṉ muṉṉōrkaḷ uruvākkiya nākarikam eṉpatai ulakiṟku meyppittār.  ulāntā nāṭṭiṉ talainakarāṉa kōpaṉ hēkaṉiluḷḷa āciya ārāycciyiṉ kāṇṭi nēviyaṉ nilaiyam eṉṉum aṟiviyal kaḻakattiṉ kuḻuoṉṟu ṭākṭar akōpārpōlā avarkaḷ talaimaiyil āyntu aṟiñar hirā aṭikaḷ vaḻiyil āyntu vaṭamoḻi, tamiḻ moḻip pulavar ottuḻaippōṭum kaṇita nuṇ poṟi (computer)Æ‹ tuṇaiyōṭum mīṇṭum mīṇṭum naṉku āyntu cintu veḷi eḻuttu tirāviṭap paṇpāṭṭiṉiṉṟu eḻunta eḻuttē eṉpatai āmōtittaṉar.  iṟutiyāka cōviyat raciyāvil uḷḷa leṉiṉ kirāṭ palkalaik kaḻakattilum mākō palkalaik kaḻakattilumuḷḷa maṉita iṉapparappup paṟṟiya aṟiviyal viḷakka āyviyal aṟiñarkaḷ paṉ moḻippulavar tōḻar yū.koṉaracōv avarkaḷ talaimaiyil kālañceṉṟa ematu aṉpiṟkuriya tōḻar tamiḻaṟiñar caimaṉ ruṭiṉ tuṇai koṇṭum uyarnta kaṇita nuṇ poṟi iyantirat tuṇai koṇṭum āyntu cintu veḷi nākarikam tirāviṭa nākarikam eṉpatai eḵkup pōṉṟa acaikka muṭiyāta cāṉṟukaḷiṉ tuṇai koṇṭu araṇ ceytuḷḷaṉar.  atōṭu cintu veḷip paṇpāṭum tirāviṭa makkaḷum ayal nāṭṭiliruntu varappaṭṭaṉa eṉpatai maṟuttu teṉ intiyāvil-ciṟappāka maṟaintu pōṉa oḷi (kumari) nāṭṭiliruntu (lemūriyāviliruntu)  cumēriyā, ekiptu, kākasa, cintu veḷi mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkup paraviṉa eṉṟa uṇmai āyvu ceyyappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.  ataṉai uṟutippaṭutta intu mākkaṭaliṉ aṭittaḷam ellām aṟiviyal muṟaiyil ārāyappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
sōviyat uruciyap pēraṟiñarum tirāviṭa iṉa makkaḷiṉ, varalāṟṟuk kālattiṟku muntiya vāḻkkaiyaip paṟṟiyum teṉ intiyāviṉiṉṟu tirāviṭa makkaḷ ekiptu, ellam  upaitiyā, cumēriyā, kākasa pakutikaḷil ellām kuṭiyēṟiyavarkaḷ eṉpataip paṟṟiyum aṟiya avarkaḷ moḻi iṉam paṇpāṭu mutaliyavaikaḷaip paṟṟiyellām naṉkāynta aṟiñar ē.konrāt tōv avarkaḷ,
toṉmai mikunta paṇpāṭṭaik koṇṭa tamiḻ makkaḷ pēcum moḻi  orē tirāviṭa moḻikkuṭumpattaic cērnta ēṉaiya cakōtara moḻikaḷuṭaṉ toṭarpuṭaiya moḻiyākum.  tirāviṭarkaḷ, intiyāviṉ toṉmaimikka maṉita iṉap pirivaic cērntavarkaḷ.  avarkaḷ irukku vētattil kūṟappeṟṟuḷḷa pōr veṟikoṇṭa āriyarkaḷ inta viyattakum ariya nāṭṭiṟku varuvataṟku veku kālattiṟku muṉpē iṅku vāḻntu varupavarkaḷ āvar.  ippoḻutu tirāviṭa moḻi teṉ intiyāvil paravi yuḷḷaṉa.  āṉāl oru kālattil maiya intiyāvilum-ēṉ?  vaṭa intiyāvilum kūṭap paravi iruntatu.  mēlum āyirakkaṇakkāṉa āṇṭukaḷukku muṉṉar, paluccitāṉattilum, īrāṉiṉ teṉ pakutiyilum kūṭa tirāviṭa moḻikaḷaip pēci varum makkaḷ vāḻntu vantaṉar.  mecapottāmiyāvil mutaṉ mutalāka nilaiyāṉa vāḻkkaiyaip peṟṟu talaiyāka vāḻnta makkaḷ avarkaḷākavē irukkak kūṭum.  avarkaḷē namatu ulakil mikat toṉmaiyāṉa nākarikattaip peṟṟirunta cumēriyarkaḷiṉ (Sumerians)  muṉṉōrkaḷākavum irukkalām eṉpataṟkāṉa cāṉṟukaḷ pala uḷḷaṉa.1  eṉṟu cōviyat nāṭu eṉṟu cōviyat araciṉ intiyat tūtariṉ nilaiyattiṉiṉṟu veḷivarum tiṅkaḷukku irumuṟai varum veḷiyīṭṭil eḻutiyuḷḷār.  mēlum tirāviṭarkaḷ, upaitiyā, ellam (kujitāṉ- teṟku īrāṉ), cumēriyā, mecapottāmiya nākarikattai tōṟṟuvittavarkaḷ tirāviṭarkaḷē eṉṟu teḷivāka veḷippaṭuttiyuḷḷār.  tirāviṭarkaḷ ellam nāṭṭiṉ tantaiyarkaḷ eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  ellam nāṭṭiṉ talai nakar ūr. iṅkutāṉ kiṟitunātar kuṭumpattiṉ āti pitā īcākkum, ilāmiya camaya tūtar mukammat napiyiṉ muṉṉōṉumāṉa imāyilum piṟantaṉar.
iṟṟaikku 5000-m āṇṭukaṭku muṉ ellam ekiptu, mecapottāmiyā, kirīṭ, teṉ amerikkāvil uḷḷa peru, mekcikkō, īṭā tīvu acīriyā, cālṭiyā pōṉṟa palvēṟu nāṭukaḷil teṉ intiyāviliruntu ceṉṟa tirāviṭa makkaḷ tuḷirkkac ceyta cīriya paṇpāṭēyākum eṉṟu aṟiñar makkaḷiṉ, car tāma hōlṭic, pērāciriyar lāṅṭaṉ, ṭākṭar ci.ār.haṇṭar ṭākṭar eyc.ār. hāl pōṉṟa aṟiñarkaḷ karutukiṉṟaṉar.
teṉ intiyak kōyilkaḷiṉ amaippum acīriyariṉ kaṭṭiṭa amaippum orē vakaiyāka uḷḷaṉa eṉṟu kalōṉiyal tāma hōlṭic kūṟiyuḷḷār.  heraṭṭōṭṭa eṉṉum varalāṟṟāciriyar tam nūlil ki.mu.4000 - āṇṭiṟku muṉ teṉ intiyarkaḷ ekiptil intu matattai nilai nāṭṭiṉar eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  pāpilōṉ nāṭṭilum, atai aṭutta akkēṭiyā, ciriyā mutaliya nāṭukaḷil eḻunta cikkurāt eṉṉum kōyilkaḷum teyvaṅkaḷum teṉ intiyāvil uḷḷa kōyil aṭippaṭaiyiliruntu arumpiyavaikaḷēyākum.1
ulakil ki.mu.3000 āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ ulakam muḻuvatum uḷḷa kaṭṭiṭak kalaikku vittiṭṭa tirāviṭa nāṭṭil iṉṟu kiṟittava ūḻikku muṉpuḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ kāṇappaṭavillai eṉpatālē akaḻ āyvil ituvarai kiṟittuva ūḻikku muṉ kaṭṭappaṭṭa kaṭṭiṭattiṉ aṭippaṭai etuvum kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭātatāl tamiḻarkaḷukku kiṟittuva  ūḻikkumuṉ kaṭṭiṭak kalai teriyātu eṉṟu kūṟuvatu piḻaiyākum.  varalāṟṟup pukaḻpeṟṟa pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ tuṟaimukap paṭṭiṉamum talainakarum, caṅkam maruviya mūtūrum yavaṉa nāṭukaḷuṭaṉum, kiḻakkāciya nāṭukaḷuṭa ṉum, maiyak kaṭaṟkarai nāṭukaḷōṭum  kaṭal vaṇikam vaḷartta koṟkaiyil ki.mu785-ām āṇṭil ceyyappaṭṭa maṭpāṇṭaṅ kaḷai tamiḻaka araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉar  1970-ām āṇṭu akaḻntu kaṇṭaṉar.  āṉāl koṟkai eṉum kō-nakar itu tāṉ eṉṟu kūṟa oru kaṭṭiṭam kūṭa akaḻntu kāṇappaṭavillai.   koṟkaiyiṉ araṇum ataṉ poṟkatavu kaḷum vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇattil irāmaṉ aṉumāṉiṭam kuṟippiṭṭup pēciyatākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  atē pōl vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇam ki.mu.1000 -m āṇṭiṟku muṉ irāvaṇaṉ vāṉ aḷāviya araṇmaṉaiyil pavaḷattūṇkaḷum, poṟkaṭṭilum iruntatākak kūṟappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  āṉāl ilaṅkaiyil kiṟittuva ūḻikku muṉ uḷḷa oru ciṟu vīṭṭaiyum, kōṭṭaiyum akaḻntu kāṇamuṭiyavillai.  ātitta nallūr akaḻ āyvil pāṉai caṭṭikaḷum eḵku  āytaṅkaḷum maṇṭai ōṭukaḷum kiṭaittaṉa.  kaṭṭiṭam oṉṟaiyum akaḻ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉar kaṇṭupiṭittaṉar.
tamiḻakattil iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ periya nakarkaḷum paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷum araṇmaṉaikaḷum 8 māṭaṅkaḷum māḷikaikaḷum iruntaṉa eṉpataṟku eṇṇaṟṟa ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  avai aṭiyil varumāṟākum.
maturaiyum māṭaṅkaḷum
iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ tamiḻarkaḷ kaṭṭiya nakaram maturai.  ammaturai ulakilē ōr oppaṟṟa nakar amaippāka iṉṟum matikkappaṭukiṟatu.  nakar naṭuvē, tirukkōyilum kōyiliṉ nāṟpuṟamum māṭavītiyum atai aṭuttu caturam caturamāka amaikkappaṭṭa maturai mānakar, tāmarai malariṉ naṭuvē pokuṭṭum atai aṭuttu varicai varicaiyāka pū itaḻkaḷum iruppatu pōṉṟu kāṇappaṭukiṟatu eṉṟu tamiḻp pulavarkaḷ viyantu pāṭiyuḷḷaṉar.  appāṭal aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
māyōṉ koppūḻ malarnta tāmaraip
pūvoṭu puraiyuñ cīrūr pūviṉ
itaḻakat taṉaiya teruvam itaḻakattu
arum per kuṭṭaṉaittē aṇṇal kōyil
tātiṉ aṉaiyar taṇṭamiḻk kuṭikaḷ
tātuṇ paṟavai aṉaiyar paricil vāḻnar
pūviṉuṭ piṟantōṉ nāviṉuṭ piṟanta
nāṉ maṟaik kēḷvi navil kural eṭuppa

vāḻiya vañciyum kōḻiyum pōlak
kōḻiyiṉ eḻātem pērūr tuyilē		- paripāṭal
itaṉ poruḷ, maturai mānakariṉ tōṟṟam oru tāmarai malaraip pōṉṟiruntatu.  tāmarai malariṉ aka itaḻkaḷaip pōṉṟu terukkaḷ aṭukkaṭukkāy aḻakuṟa amaintiruntaṉa.  avvitaḻkaḷiṉ naṭuvē  uḷḷa pokuṭṭaip pōṉṟu maturai naṭuvil aṇṇal akanāḻikai amaintuḷḷatu malariṉkaṇ uḷḷa makarantat tūḷaip pōlat taṇṭamiḻk kuṭikaḷ vāḻkiṉṟaṉar.  antat tātuṇṇum vaṇṭu kūṭṭattaip pōṉṟu iravalar kūṭṭam nāṭi varukiṉṟatu.  cērar kōnakarāṉa vañciyil vāḻvōrum cōḻar talainakarāṉa uṟantaiyil vāḻvōrum kālaiyil kōḻiyiṉ kūkkural kēṭṭē tuyil eḻuvar. āṉāl maturaiyil vāḻum makkaḷ kōḻikūvi eḻuntilar.   nāḷtōṟum atikālaiyil maṟaikaḷai muḻakkuvōriṉ iṉiya oli kēṭṭut tuyil eḻuvar eṉpatākum.
inta mānakar maturaiyil uḷḷa maṉaikaḷum, māḷikaikaḷum, araṇmaṉaikaḷum pala māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāy viḷaṅkiṉa.  atikamāka nāṉku māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya māḷikaikaḷ iruntatāl inta nakar māṭak kūṭal eṉṟum nāṉmāṭakkūṭam eṉṟum peyar peṟṟatu.
māṭamali maṟukiṟ kūṭal 	    - (tirumurukāṟṟup paṭai) 
eṉpatu nakkīrar tiruvākku.
nāṉmāṭak kūṭal makaḷirum maintarum - (kalittokai) eṉṟu kalittokai nāṉku māṭiyuḷḷa māḷikaiyil vāḻum maturai makaḷiraiyum makkaḷaiyum pōṟṟukiṉṟatu.
teṉṉavaṉ nāṉmāṭak kūṭal nakar - (paripāṭal) eṉṟu paripāṭal pāṇṭiyaṉiṉ nāṉkumāṭamuḷḷa perunakar eṉṟu pukaḻkiṟatu. iṅku eḻunilaimāṭaṅkaḷuṭaiya araṇmaṉaikaḷum iruntaṉa eṉṟu tiruviḷaiyāṭaṟpurāṇam kūṟukiṟatu.
terukkaḷ
ciṟṟūrkaḷum, pērūrkaḷum, paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷum kōnakarkaḷum paṭippaṭiyāy vaḷarntaṉa. ciṟṟūrkaḷil maṉaimuṉṟil, maṉaip puḻakkaṭai ivaṟṟai uḷḷaṭakki vēlikaḷiṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  pērūril makkaḷ tokai perukikkoṇṭē iruntamaiyāl iṭanerukkaṭi eḻuntatu.  eṉavē makkaḷ tam maṉaiyil, māṭaṅkaḷ amaittu kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷai eḻuppiṉar.  māṭaṅkaḷ oṉṟu iraṇṭu, mūṉṟu, nāṉku, ēḻu eṉa uyarntu koṇṭē ceṉṟaṉa.  pērūrkaḷil neṭunilai māṭaṅkaḷ niṟaintu uyarntu niṉṟaṉa.  nakaraṅkaḷum paṭṭiṉaṅkaḷum nīṇṭu akaṉṟa terukkaḷaiyum, kuṟunterukkaḷaiyum uṭaiyaṉavāy iruntaṉa.  aṉṟu nīṇṭa terukkaḷiṉ irumaruṅkiṉum vāṉṟōy māṭaṅkaḷ aṇi aṇiyāy aḻakuṟa amaintiruntaṉa.  cal cal eṉṟu oli eḻuppi akaṉṟu ōṭum āṟṟu veḷḷam veḷiyē cellavoṭṭātu niṟkum karaikaḷ pōṉṟu mānakariṉ terukkaḷiṉ irupuṟaṅkaḷilum māṭaṅkaḷ uyarntu kāṭci aḷittatu itaṉaic caṅka ilakkiyaṅkaḷ naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa;
māṭamōṅkiya mallaṉ mūtūr
āṟu kiṭantaṉṉa vakal neṭun teruvil   - neṭunal 29-30
eṉṟu aḻakuṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭuvatu ārāyattakkatākum.

cittiramāṭam
muṟkālattil palavita māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya māḷikaikaḷai maṉṉarkaḷum celvarkaḷum peṟṟiruntaṉar maṉṉarkaḷ cittira
māṭam eṉṉum māḷikaiyaittaṉiyē amaittiruntaṉar.  pāṇṭiyaṉ naṉmāṟaṉ, avaṉatu cittiramāṭattil uyir tuṟantāṉ.  eṉavē, avaṉ, cittiramāṭattut tuñciya naṉmāṟaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭāṉ.  pāṇṭiyaṉuṭaiya cittiramāṭam veṇmaiyāṉa cuvarkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāy iruntatu.  atil pala vaṇṇa ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  tūṇkaḷ karumaiyāy paḷiṅkupōl viḷaṅkiṉa.  cila cuvarkaḷ cempupōl vaṇṇantīṭṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  cila araṇmaṉaic cuvarkaḷiṉ āṟṟalaic cīvakacintāmaṇi eṉṉum kāppiyam aṭiyil varumāṟu aḻakuṟa eṭuttukāṭṭukiṟatu1 peruṅkatai māḷikaiyiṉ cuvarkaḷil kaṇṭamāṉmaṟi ceṭi koṭikaḷaip pāṅkuṟac cittarittuḷḷatu.2
maturaip pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ kōnakar.  atupāṇṭiya maṉṉar kaḷiṉ iṟutik kālam varai talainakarāy viḷaṅkiyatu.  iṉṟum annakar māṇpuṭaṉ talainimirntu niṟkiṟatu.  anta nakariṉ amaippum, māḷikaikaḷiṉ uyaramum aḻakum uṟutiyum tamiḻarkaḷiṉ nakar amaipputtiṟaṉukkum kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ciṟappiṟkum ēṟṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭāka ilaṅkukiṟatu.  ammā nakariṉ māḷikaiyiṉ māṭaṅkaḷ viṇmuṭṭa eḻuntu niṉṟaṉa.  māḷikaiyiṉ mēṟṟaḷattil mēkaṅkaḷ tavaḻntaṉa; māṭaṅkaḷ malaiyeṉa uyarntu niṉṟaṉa eṉṟellām tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷil eṭuttukkāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  mēṉmāṭikaḷ, āyirampēr amaintu virun
tuṇṇak kūṭiyatāka iruntatu.  ivaikaḷai yellām eṭuttuk kūṟum tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷai naṉku payiṉṟa yāḻppāṇattaic cērnta tamiḻ aṟiñar, paḻaṅkāla yāḻppāṇam eṉṉum nūlil aṭiyil varumāṟu eṭuttukkāṭṭi yuḷḷār.1
cāḷaraṅkaḷ (caṉṉalkaḷ)
mānakaraṅkaḷil māḷikaikaḷum, araṇmaṉaikaḷum, illaṅkaḷum nallakāṟṟum oḷiyum pukumāṟu periya aḻakiya cāḷaraṅkaḷ (palakaṇikaḷ) amaikkap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  itaṉai, maturaik kāñci, 
vakaipeṟu eḻuntu vāṉam mūḻki
cil kāṟṟu icaikkum palpuḻai nalil    - maturai 357-358 
eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
cōḻa nāṭṭu iḷavaracaṉ utayakumāraṉiṉ naṇpaṉ eṭṭiyiṉ makaṉ pukār paṭṭiṉattiluḷḷa parattaiyar teruvil, poṟṟakaṭu pōrttiya māḷikaiyiṉ uyarnta māṭattil, kaṭṭilil paṭuttuk koṇṭu cāḷaraṅkaḷiṉ vaḻiyāka varum teṉṟaṟ kāṟṟiṉ poṉṟā iṉpattai naṉṟāka nukarntavāṟē teruvil nikaḻum kāṭciyaik kaṇṭukaḷittāṉ eṉṟu tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭu kiṉṟaṉa.

tamiḻ vēntarkaḷāṉa cērar, cōḻar, pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ talainakarkaḷāṉa, vañci, pukār, koṟkai maturai, uṟaiyūr mutaliya nakaraṅkaḷil māḷikaikaḷ malaiyeṉa uyarntu niṉṟaṉa.  makkaḷ māṭattil mēṉilaiyil kūtir kālattē ciṟitu poḻutu celaviṭuvar.  perum poḻutai iṭainilaikaḷil kaḻippar.  iravu kālaṅkaḷil tuyila māṭaṅkaḷ ēṟṟa iṭamāka iruntatu.  pakaṟpoḻutil māṭaṅkaḷil neruppuc caṭṭiyaivaittu atil neruppaiyiṭṭu atil kaṭṭaikaḷai ataṉ mēliṭṭu naṟumaṇap pukai eḻuppi atai nukarntu makiḻvar; kūtir kāyvar

araṇmaṉaikaḷ
makkaḷ vāḻum iṭam illam, vīṭu akam eṉappaṭṭatu. aracar vāḻum aḻakiya maṉai araṇmaṉai eṉa aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.  aracaṉ vāḻum iṭam kōyil eṉṟum aḻaikkappaṭum.  maṉṉarkaḷ vāḻnta māḷikaikaḷ cuṟṟu matilkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāyum, uyarnta vāyilaiyum, vāyilil uyarnta kōpuram vāyntatāyum, vaṇṇaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭa cuvar ōviyaṅkaḷ niṟaintatāyum tikaḻntatu.  maṉṉaṉ māḷikaikaḷ pala māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāyum aḻaku niṟaintatāyum amaintiruntaṉa.  itaṉai aṭiyil varum paintamiḻ nūṟkaḷ pāṅkuṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa:
nalvaḻi yeḻutiya nalaṅkiḷar vāyilum
veḷḷi veṇcutai yiḻukiya māṭat

irumpuk katavukaḷ
vāṉ aḷāviya vaṇṇa māṭaṅkaḷaic cuṟṟi amaikkap peṟṟa matilkaḷum, vāyilkaḷ mītuḷḷa kōpuraṅkaḷum, vāyiṟ katavukaḷum pāṅkuṟat tikaḻntaṉa.  avvāyil katavuḷ irumput takaṭukaḷ poruttap peṟṟatāy eḵku āṇikaḷāl taraiyap paṭṭatāyk kāṇap peṟṟatu.  irumpuk katavukaḷum eḵku āṇikaḷum turu ēṟā vaṇṇam civanta ney vaṇṇam tīṭṭap peṟṟiruntatu. itaṉaic caṅkamaruviya taṅka ēṭāṉa neṭunal vāṭai,
oruṅkuṭaṉ vaḷaii yōṅkunilai varaippiṟ

māḷikaiyiṉ māṇpu
aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉai talainakariṉ naṭuvē talai nimirntu niṉṟatu.  atu, makkaḷ vāḻum maṉaikaḷum, vaṇikar vāḻum māḷikaikaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷ vāḻum neṭiya māṭat terukkaḷum, amaiccarkaḷ, paṭait talaivarkaḷ vāḻum araṇpōṉṟa terukkaḷum nāṟpuṟamum nilava naṭuvē uyarntu niṉṟatu.

tamaṉiya māḷikai		           - cilap  naṭunaṟ 47-50
araṇmaṉaikaḷ, makkaḷ uṟaiyum maṉaikaḷaip pōl aṭuttu vīṭukaḷ kaṭṭi vāḻvatu kāṇappaṭuvatillai.
nakariṉ naṭuvē nāṟpuṟamum uyarnta matil cūḻa amainta akaṉṟa nilattil naṟumaṇam vīcum poḻilukku naṭuvē pala mēṉilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya pāṅkāṉa vaṇṇa māḷikaiyāy eḻil peṟṟilaṅkum.  araṇmaṉaiyaic cuṟṟi aḻakuṟa amaikkap peṟṟa iṉiya poḻilil, vēṇṭum poḻutu vēṇṭum aḷavu nīrai iṟaikkavum, nīraip pōkkavum valla, iyantirap poṟikaḷ amainta poykaik karaiyil amaikkap peṟṟiruntatu.  
itaṉāl aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉai ilavantikai māṭam eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.  intak kuḷirtaru māṭattiṉ maruṅkē kāṟṟu vacatiyum nīrvacatiyum poruntumāṟu amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷa maṇṭapam oṉṟu iruntatu.  atu nīrāḷi maṇṭapam eṉa aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.  araṇmaṉaiyil makaḷir taṅkum antappuram taṉiyē amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu.  aṅku āṇkaḷ uṭ cella muṭiyātu.  maṉṉar vāḻum iṭam akaṉṟu nīṇṭa aḻakiya aṟaikaḷ pala uḷḷatāy amaikkappaṭṭirukkum.  araṇmaṉai yil aracaṉ tuyilumiṭam taṉiyē amaikka peṟṟirukkum.  avaṟṟil aḻakiya kaṭṭilum, ciṟṟuṇṭikaḷum, nalla naṟumaṇap poruḷkaḷum niṟaintirukkum.
mānīr vēlik kaṭam peṟantu imayattu
vāṉavar maruḷa malaiviṟ pūṭṭiya
vāṉavar tōṉṟal vāyvāṭ kōtai

nīrāḻi maṇṭapam
nīrāḻi maṇṭapam nīrāvi maṇṭapam eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  kuḷaṅkaḷiṉ naṭuvē amaintuḷḷa maṇṭapam nīrāḻi maṇṭapam eṉappaṭum tāmarai cūḻnta nīrāvi maṇṭapam eṉṟu cīvaka cintāmaṇi 2800-ṉ uraiyil kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
araṇmaṉaiyiṉ amaippu
araṇmaṉai, uṟutiyāy, uyaramāy upparikkaikaḷai yuṭaiyatāy oḷirntatu.  araṇmaṉai cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭap peṟṟu mēlē kal cuṇṇac cāntum, cippic cuṇṇac cāntum pūcappeṟṟu naṉṟākap paḷapaḷappāṉa kallāl tēykkap peṟṟup paḷiṅkuc cuvar pōl viḷaṅka mēlē ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  pala māḷikaikaḷil veḷḷit takaṭukaḷ potiyap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  cila māḷikaikaḷ cempoṉṉāṟ ceyta ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟiruntatu.  pavaḷat tūṇkaḷum, paimpoṉ tūṇkaḷum araṇmaṉaiyai aḻaku peṟac ceytatu.  araṇmaṉai tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷāl maṭṭum kaṭṭap paṭuvatillai.  yavaṉa nāṭṭut taccarum; avanti nāṭṭuk kollarum; marāṭṭira nāṭṭuk kammiyar; makata nāṭṭu kottarkaḷum, kūṭik kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  palvēṟu nāṭṭiluḷḷa poṉ, maṇi, pavaḷam, muttu, paṭṭu, tantam mutaliya poruḷkaḷāl araṇmaṉai aṇi ceyyap peṟṟiruntatu.  mukkālikaḷ nāṟkālikaḷ, kaṭṭilkaḷ, vicuppalakaikaḷ niṟain tirukkum.

māṭattil pantāṭṭam
maṉṉarkaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷum, vaṇikarkaḷum pala nilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya māṭa māḷikaikaḷaik kaṭṭiyiruntaṉar.  maṉṉarkaḷiṉ peṇmakkaḷum nilakkiḻārkaḷiṉ iḷam peṇkaḷum vaṇikarkaḷiṉ peṇmakkaḷum mālai vēḷaikaḷil tattam māṭattiṉ mēṟṟaḷattil, kāṟcilampukaḷ kaṇīr kaṇīr eṉṟu olikkak kaḷikoṇṭu pantāṭiṉar.  itu māmalaiyil mayilkaḷ tam aḻakiya tōkaikaḷai virittu āṭi makiḻvatu pōl māṭaṅkaḷ mītu mati muka maṅkaiyarkaḷ pantāṭiya kāṭci iruntatu.  itaṉai caṅka maruviya taṅka ēṭukaḷil pīṭuṟa eṅkaḷ perum pulavarkaḷ eḻil tikaḻa eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.
mālvarai cilampiṉ makiḻ ciṟantu ālum
pīli maññaiyiṉ iyalik kāla 
tamaṉiyap poṟ cilampu olippa uyarnilai
vāṉtōy māṭattu varippantu acaii    perum 330-333
maturai, pukār nakarkaḷil, paṇṭaikkāla māḷikaikaḷilum, māṭaṅkaḷilum nila muṟṟamamaittiruntaṉar. nilā muṟṟam vēṉiṟkālattum kuḷirkālattum iravu nilāk kālattum, kālaiyilum makaḷirum maintarkaḷum oruṅkukūṭi,  āṭippāṭip poḻutu pōkkum iṭamāka iruntatu. itaṉaic cilappatikāram,  eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
nilā muṟṟam
māḷikaikaḷil vāḻnta makkaḷ iravil-nilāk kālattil tiṅkaḷiṉ payaṉai naṉku payaṉpaṭutti vantaṉar.  māḷikaikaḷil taṇṇoḷi tarum veṇmatiyiṉ payaṉai nukarvataṟ keṉṟē neṭu nilā muṟṟam amaikkappaṭṭatupōl karutappaṭṭatu.  nilavu tarum iṉṉoḷi iṉpam eḻuppum; teṉṟaliṉ iṉimai kaḷiyūṭṭum; kātal vaḷarkkum.  iṉpam eḻuppum vēṉiṟ paḷḷiyum kūtir kālattu vāṭai pukāta kūtir paḷḷiyum naṉku amaittu paruva nilaikaḷukkēṟṟa uṟaiyuḷum uṇavum uṭaiyum piṟavum amaittu illattai iṉpalōkamākki vāḻntu vantaṉar.
veppam mikutiyāka irukkum vēṉiṟkālattil nilā muṟṟattai aṭuttuk kīḻē irukkum maṉaiyil pavaḻa  illattil katiravaṉiṉ veppam pukātu iṉitu vāḻntaṉar avarkaḷ veḷiyē pukātu vīṭṭiṉuḷḷē iruppar.  avviṭam mēṉ māṭiyaip pōliṉṟi nāṟpuṟamum cuṟṟuc cuvarkaḷum mēṟṟaḷamum peṟṟiruppatāl aṅku veppam tākkātu; veppak kāṟṟup pukātu.  vēṉiṟ kālattu vīcum teṉṟal tavaḻntu varum vaṇṇam cuvaril palakaṇikaḷ amaintiruntaṉa.
vāṉuṟa nivanta mēṉilai maruṅkiṉ
vēṉiṟ paḷḷit teṉvaḷi tarūum
nērvāyk kaṭṭaḷait tiriyātu tiṇṇilai -neṭunal 62-64
nilā muṟṟam vēṉiṟ kālattum kūtirkālattum payaṉpaṭum.  kuḷir kālattu kālaik kuḷir pōkavum uṭalukku ūkkamum uramum ūṭṭum.  ñāyiṟṟiṉ oḷiyiṉaip peṟavum etir nōkki, kūtir kālattil atikālaiyil makkaḷoṭu māntarum nilā muṟṟattil ciṟitu nēram iruppatuṇṭu.  itaṉai,

araṇmaṉaiyil pāvai viḷakku
tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷiṉ araṇmaṉaiyil makaḷir vāḻum antappuram taṉiyē iruntatu.  aṅku aracaṉuṭaiya maṉaiviyum-atāvatu paṭṭattaraciyum maṟumaṉaiyāṭṭikaḷum avarkaḷiṉ paṇip peṇkaḷum iruppar.  aṅku aracaṉ allatu ayalār evarum aṇuka muṭiyātu.  palamāṉa kāval uṇṭu.  pāṇṭiya maṉṉarkaḷum cōḻar, ciṅkaḷavar, cērar, kaṉṉaṭar, āntirar mutaliya nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷōṭu peṇ eṭuttum koṭuttum uḷḷaṉar.  urōm nāṭṭup peṇkaḷ meykkāvalarkaḷaip pāṇṭiyarkaḷ antappurattil iṭam peṟṟiruntaṉar. cōḻar pāṇṭiyar, cāḷukkiyar, āntirar, kaliṅkar, kaṭāra nāṭṭiṉar, (malēciyar) mutaliya nāṭṭiluḷḷa araciḷaṅkumarikaḷai maṇantum peṇ koṭuttum uḷḷaṉar.  araṇmaṉai ayalnāṭṭu poruḷkaḷāl alaṅkarikkap peṟṟiruntatu.  pāṇṭiyar araṇmaṉaiyil yavaṉanāṭṭup pāvai viḷakku aṇipeṟat tikaḻntatu.  itaṉai neṭunalvāṭai
yavaṉar iyaṟṟiya viṉaimāṇ pāvai
kaiyēntu akala niṟai ney corintu
parūuttiri koḷīiya kurūuttalai nimir eri 
						    -neṭunal 101-104   
kūṟuvataṉ mūlam naṉkaṟiyalām. 
aṉṉam vaitta viḷakku
 iḵtaṉṟi aṉṉam pōṉṟa pāvaikaḷ uruvil ceyyappaṭṭu vanta viḷakkum pāṇṭiyarkaḷ araṇmaṉaiyil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭu vantaṉaveṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai eṉṉum paḻaiya tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ mūlam aṟikiṉṟōm:
----------------------  yavaṉar
ōtima viḷakkiṉ uyarmicai koṇṭa
vaikuṟu maṉīṟ paiyakat tōṉṟu
nīrp peyaṟ ṟellai 		      -perumpāṇ 11:316-19
tamiḻakam pōnta yavaṉarkaḷiṉ marakkalaṅkaḷil uḷḷa kūmpukaḷil aṉṉam uruvamuḷḷa ciṟpavēlaippāṭamainta aḻakiya viḷakkukaḷ iruntaṉa.  avaikaḷ tamiḻaka aracarkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷilum civaṉār, tirumāl kōyilkaḷilum nantā viḷakku eṉṉum peyaril iṭam peṟṟaṉa eṉṟu terikiṟatu.  aṉṉam tamiḻ nāṭṭup paṟavaiyalla.  anta aṉṉa viḷakkukaḷai ātiyil urōmarkaḷ tamiḻ nāṭṭiṟku aḷittaṉar eṉpatu varalāṟṟup pāṅkāṉa uṇmai.
araṇmaṉaiyil eḻiṟ pūṅkā
iyaṟkai iṉpattai iṉituṇarnta tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷ tam araṇmaṉaiyil ceyaṟkaik kuṉṟukaḷ, iyantira  vāvikaḷ kālvāy amaittu uyarnta maraṅkaḷaiyum, pūñceṭikaḷaiyum, pūmaraṅkaḷaiyum, paḻa maraṅkaḷaiyum amaittu eḻil peṟac ceytiruntaṉar.  aṅku mayilkaḷ āṭiṉa.  kuyilkaḷ pāṭiṉa.  kiḷḷaikaḷum pūvaiyum maḻalai miḻaṟṟiṉa.  māṉkaḷ tuḷḷik kutittu viḷaiyāṭiṉa.  iṅku araciḷaṅ kāḷaikaḷum, araciḷaṅ kumarikaḷum āṭippāṭi iṉpuṟṟu vantaṉar.  itaṉai neṭunal
vāṭai, naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
