vāṉam kīḻē viḻātapaṭi muṭṭuk kālāka ūṉṟivaitta oru paṟṟuk kōl pōla viṇṇait tīṇṭumpaṭi uyarntatum ēṇi cāttiyum ēṟaṟkariya talaiyiṉaiyuṭaiyatum, kaṟṟai mutaliya vaṟṟāl vēyāṟu cāntiṭṭa aramiyattaiyuṭaiyatumākiya māṭattu ucciyilē iraviṉkaṇ ēṟṟiya viḷakku nivantu ticai tappip peruṅkaṭal parappilē ōṭāniṉṟa marakkalaṅkaḷai aḻaiyā niṉṟa nīrppāyttuṟaimukam piṉṉē irukkiṟatu vā eṉṟu kalaṅkaraiviḷakku kalaṅkaḷai aḻaippatu pōl niṉṟatu eṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai kūṟiyuḷḷatu.

cittiramāṭam
muṟkālattil palavita māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya māḷikaikaḷai maṉṉarkaḷum celvarkaḷum peṟṟiruntaṉar maṉṉarkaḷ cittira
māṭam eṉṉum māḷikaiyaittaṉiyē amaittiruntaṉar.  pāṇṭiyaṉ naṉmāṟaṉ, avaṉatu cittiramāṭattil uyir tuṟantāṉ.  eṉavē, avaṉ, cittiramāṭattut tuñciya naṉmāṟaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭṭāṉ.  pāṇṭiyaṉuṭaiya cittiramāṭam veṇmaiyāṉa cuvarkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāy iruntatu.  atil pala vaṇṇa ōviyaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭiruntaṉa.  tūṇkaḷ karumaiyāy paḷiṅkupōl viḷaṅkiṉa.  cila cuvarkaḷ cempupōl vaṇṇantīṭṭap paṭṭiruntaṉa.  cila araṇmaṉaic cuvarkaḷiṉ āṟṟalaic cīvakacintāmaṇi eṉṉum kāppiyam aṭiyil varumāṟu aḻakuṟa eṭuttukāṭṭukiṟatu1 peruṅkatai māḷikaiyiṉ cuvarkaḷil kaṇṭamāṉmaṟi ceṭi koṭikaḷaip pāṅkuṟac cittarittuḷḷatu.2
maturaip pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ kōnakar.  atupāṇṭiya maṉṉar kaḷiṉ iṟutik kālam varai talainakarāy viḷaṅkiyatu.  iṉṟum annakar māṇpuṭaṉ talainimirntu niṟkiṟatu.  anta nakariṉ amaippum, māḷikaikaḷiṉ uyaramum aḻakum uṟutiyum tamiḻarkaḷiṉ nakar amaipputtiṟaṉukkum kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ciṟappiṟkum ēṟṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭāka ilaṅkukiṟatu.  ammā nakariṉ māḷikaiyiṉ māṭaṅkaḷ viṇmuṭṭa eḻuntu niṉṟaṉa.  māḷikaiyiṉ mēṟṟaḷattil mēkaṅkaḷ tavaḻntaṉa; māṭaṅkaḷ malaiyeṉa uyarntu niṉṟaṉa eṉṟellām tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷil eṭuttukkāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  mēṉmāṭikaḷ, āyirampēr amaintu virun
tuṇṇak kūṭiyatāka iruntatu.  ivaikaḷai yellām eṭuttuk kūṟum tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷai naṉku payiṉṟa yāḻppāṇattaic cērnta tamiḻ aṟiñar, paḻaṅkāla yāḻppāṇam eṉṉum nūlil aṭiyil varumāṟu eṭuttukkāṭṭi yuḷḷār.1
cāḷaraṅkaḷ (caṉṉalkaḷ)
mānakaraṅkaḷil māḷikaikaḷum, araṇmaṉaikaḷum, illaṅkaḷum nallakāṟṟum oḷiyum pukumāṟu periya aḻakiya cāḷaraṅkaḷ (palakaṇikaḷ) amaikkap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  itaṉai, maturaik kāñci, 
vakaipeṟu eḻuntu vāṉam mūḻki
cil kāṟṟu icaikkum palpuḻai nalil    - maturai 357-358 
eṉṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
cōḻa nāṭṭu iḷavaracaṉ utayakumāraṉiṉ naṇpaṉ eṭṭiyiṉ makaṉ pukār paṭṭiṉattiluḷḷa parattaiyar teruvil, poṟṟakaṭu pōrttiya māḷikaiyiṉ uyarnta māṭattil, kaṭṭilil paṭuttuk koṇṭu cāḷaraṅkaḷiṉ vaḻiyāka varum teṉṟaṟ kāṟṟiṉ poṉṟā iṉpattai naṉṟāka nukarntavāṟē teruvil nikaḻum kāṭciyaik kaṇṭukaḷittāṉ eṉṟu tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ eṭuttuk kāṭṭu kiṉṟaṉa.

malaiyeṉa uyarnta māḷikai
tamiḻ vēntarkaḷāṉa cērar, cōḻar, pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ talainakarkaḷāṉa, vañci, pukār, koṟkai maturai, uṟaiyūr mutaliya nakaraṅkaḷil māḷikaikaḷ malaiyeṉa uyarntu niṉṟaṉa.  makkaḷ māṭattil mēṉilaiyil kūtir kālattē ciṟitu poḻutu celaviṭuvar.  perum poḻutai iṭainilaikaḷil kaḻippar.  iravu kālaṅkaḷil tuyila māṭaṅkaḷ ēṟṟa iṭamāka iruntatu.  pakaṟpoḻutil māṭaṅkaḷil neruppuc caṭṭiyaivaittu atil neruppaiyiṭṭu atil kaṭṭaikaḷai ataṉ mēliṭṭu naṟumaṇap pukai eḻuppi atai nukarntu makiḻvar; kūtir kāyvar

araṇmaṉaikaḷ
makkaḷ vāḻum iṭam illam, vīṭu akam eṉappaṭṭatu. aracar vāḻum aḻakiya maṉai araṇmaṉai eṉa aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.  aracaṉ vāḻum iṭam kōyil eṉṟum aḻaikkappaṭum.  maṉṉarkaḷ vāḻnta māḷikaikaḷ cuṟṟu matilkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāyum, uyarnta vāyilaiyum, vāyilil uyarnta kōpuram vāyntatāyum, vaṇṇaṅkaḷ tīṭṭappaṭṭa cuvar ōviyaṅkaḷ niṟaintatāyum tikaḻntatu.  maṉṉaṉ māḷikaikaḷ pala māṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiyatāyum aḻaku niṟaintatāyum amaintiruntaṉa.  itaṉai aṭiyil varum paintamiḻ nūṟkaḷ pāṅkuṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa:
nalvaḻi yeḻutiya nalaṅkiḷar vāyilum
veḷḷi veṇcutai yiḻukiya māṭat
tuḷḷuru veḻutā veḷḷiṭai vāyilum

irumpuk katavukaḷ
vāṉ aḷāviya vaṇṇa māṭaṅkaḷaic cuṟṟi amaikkap peṟṟa matilkaḷum, vāyilkaḷ mītuḷḷa kōpuraṅkaḷum, vāyiṟ katavukaḷum pāṅkuṟat tikaḻntaṉa.  avvāyil katavuḷ irumput takaṭukaḷ poruttap peṟṟatāy eḵku āṇikaḷāl taraiyap paṭṭatāyk kāṇap peṟṟatu.  irumpuk katavukaḷum eḵku āṇikaḷum turu ēṟā vaṇṇam civanta ney vaṇṇam tīṭṭap peṟṟiruntatu. itaṉaic caṅkamaruviya taṅka ēṭāṉa neṭunal vāṭai,
oruṅkuṭaṉ vaḷaii yōṅkunilai varaippiṟ
paruvirumpu piṇaittuc celvarak kurīit
tuṇai māṇ katavam porunti yiṇaimāṇṭu

pōtaviḻ kuvaḷaip putuppiṭi kālamaittut

taiyavi yappiya neyyaṇi neṭunilai

māḷikaiyiṉ māṇpu
aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉai talainakariṉ naṭuvē talai nimirntu niṉṟatu.  atu, makkaḷ vāḻum maṉaikaḷum, vaṇikar vāḻum māḷikaikaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷ vāḻum neṭiya māṭat terukkaḷum, amaiccarkaḷ, paṭait talaivarkaḷ vāḻum araṇpōṉṟa terukkaḷum nāṟpuṟamum nilava naṭuvē uyarntu niṉṟatu.

tamaṉiya māḷikai		           - cilap  naṭunaṟ 47-50
araṇmaṉaikaḷ, makkaḷ uṟaiyum maṉaikaḷaip pōl aṭuttu vīṭukaḷ kaṭṭi vāḻvatu kāṇappaṭuvatillai.
nakariṉ naṭuvē nāṟpuṟamum uyarnta matil cūḻa amainta akaṉṟa nilattil naṟumaṇam vīcum poḻilukku naṭuvē pala mēṉilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya pāṅkāṉa vaṇṇa māḷikaiyāy eḻil peṟṟilaṅkum.  araṇmaṉaiyaic cuṟṟi aḻakuṟa amaikkap peṟṟa iṉiya poḻilil, vēṇṭum poḻutu vēṇṭum aḷavu nīrai iṟaikkavum, nīraip pōkkavum valla, iyantirap poṟikaḷ amainta poykaik karaiyil amaikkap peṟṟiruntatu.  
itaṉāl aracaṉ vāḻum araṇmaṉai ilavantikai māṭam eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.  intak kuḷirtaru māṭattiṉ maruṅkē kāṟṟu vacatiyum nīrvacatiyum poruntumāṟu amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷa maṇṭapam oṉṟu iruntatu.  atu nīrāḷi maṇṭapam eṉa aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.  araṇmaṉaiyil makaḷir taṅkum antappuram taṉiyē amaikkappaṭṭiruntatu.  aṅku āṇkaḷ uṭ cella muṭiyātu.  maṉṉar vāḻum iṭam akaṉṟu nīṇṭa aḻakiya aṟaikaḷ pala uḷḷatāy amaikkappaṭṭirukkum.  araṇmaṉai yil aracaṉ tuyilumiṭam taṉiyē amaikka peṟṟirukkum.  avaṟṟil aḻakiya kaṭṭilum, ciṟṟuṇṭikaḷum, nalla naṟumaṇap poruḷkaḷum niṟaintirukkum.
mānīr vēlik kaṭam peṟantu imayattu

nīrāḻi maṇṭapam
nīrāḻi maṇṭapam nīrāvi maṇṭapam eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  kuḷaṅkaḷiṉ naṭuvē amaintuḷḷa maṇṭapam nīrāḻi maṇṭapam eṉappaṭum tāmarai cūḻnta nīrāvi maṇṭapam eṉṟu cīvaka cintāmaṇi 2800-ṉ uraiyil kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
araṇmaṉaiyiṉ amaippu
araṇmaṉai, uṟutiyāy, uyaramāy upparikkaikaḷai yuṭaiyatāy oḷirntatu.  araṇmaṉai cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭap peṟṟu mēlē kal cuṇṇac cāntum, cippic cuṇṇac cāntum pūcappeṟṟu naṉṟākap paḷapaḷappāṉa kallāl tēykkap peṟṟup paḷiṅkuc cuvar pōl viḷaṅka mēlē ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  pala māḷikaikaḷil veḷḷit takaṭukaḷ potiyap peṟṟiruntaṉa.  cila māḷikaikaḷ cempoṉṉāṟ ceyta ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟiruntatu.  pavaḷat tūṇkaḷum, paimpoṉ tūṇkaḷum araṇmaṉaiyai aḻaku peṟac ceytatu.  araṇmaṉai tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷāl maṭṭum kaṭṭap paṭuvatillai.  yavaṉa nāṭṭut taccarum; avanti nāṭṭuk kollarum; marāṭṭira nāṭṭuk kammiyar; makata nāṭṭu kottarkaḷum, kūṭik kaṭṭappaṭṭatu.  palvēṟu nāṭṭiluḷḷa poṉ, maṇi, pavaḷam, muttu, paṭṭu, tantam mutaliya poruḷkaḷāl araṇmaṉai aṇi ceyyap peṟṟiruntatu.  mukkālikaḷ nāṟkālikaḷ, kaṭṭilkaḷ, vicuppalakaikaḷ niṟain tirukkum.

māṭattil pantāṭṭam
maṉṉarkaḷum, nilakkiḻārkaḷum, vaṇikarkaḷum pala nilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya māṭa māḷikaikaḷaik kaṭṭiyiruntaṉar.  maṉṉarkaḷiṉ peṇmakkaḷum nilakkiḻārkaḷiṉ iḷam peṇkaḷum vaṇikarkaḷiṉ peṇmakkaḷum mālai vēḷaikaḷil tattam māṭattiṉ mēṟṟaḷattil, kāṟcilampukaḷ kaṇīr kaṇīr eṉṟu olikkak kaḷikoṇṭu pantāṭiṉar.  itu māmalaiyil mayilkaḷ tam aḻakiya tōkaikaḷai virittu āṭi makiḻvatu pōl māṭaṅkaḷ mītu mati muka maṅkaiyarkaḷ pantāṭiya kāṭci iruntatu.  itaṉai caṅka maruviya taṅka ēṭukaḷil pīṭuṟa eṅkaḷ perum pulavarkaḷ eḻil tikaḻa eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.
mālvarai cilampiṉ makiḻ ciṟantu ālum
pīli maññaiyiṉ iyalik kāla 
tamaṉiyap poṟ cilampu olippa uyarnilai
vāṉtōy māṭattu varippantu acaii    perum 330-333
maturai, pukār nakarkaḷil, paṇṭaikkāla māḷikaikaḷilum, māṭaṅkaḷilum nila muṟṟamamaittiruntaṉar. nilā muṟṟam vēṉiṟkālattum kuḷirkālattum iravu nilāk kālattum, kālaiyilum makaḷirum maintarkaḷum oruṅkukūṭi,  āṭippāṭip poḻutu pōkkum iṭamāka iruntatu. itaṉaic cilappatikāram,  eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
nilā muṟṟam
māḷikaikaḷil vāḻnta makkaḷ iravil-nilāk kālattil tiṅkaḷiṉ payaṉai naṉku payaṉpaṭutti vantaṉar.  māḷikaikaḷil taṇṇoḷi tarum veṇmatiyiṉ payaṉai nukarvataṟ keṉṟē neṭu nilā muṟṟam amaikkappaṭṭatupōl karutappaṭṭatu.  nilavu tarum iṉṉoḷi iṉpam eḻuppum; teṉṟaliṉ iṉimai kaḷiyūṭṭum; kātal vaḷarkkum.  iṉpam eḻuppum vēṉiṟ paḷḷiyum kūtir kālattu vāṭai pukāta kūtir paḷḷiyum naṉku amaittu paruva nilaikaḷukkēṟṟa uṟaiyuḷum uṇavum uṭaiyum piṟavum amaittu illattai iṉpalōkamākki vāḻntu vantaṉar.
veppam mikutiyāka irukkum vēṉiṟkālattil nilā muṟṟattai aṭuttuk kīḻē irukkum maṉaiyil pavaḻa  illattil katiravaṉiṉ veppam pukātu iṉitu vāḻntaṉar avarkaḷ veḷiyē pukātu vīṭṭiṉuḷḷē iruppar.  avviṭam mēṉ māṭiyaip pōliṉṟi nāṟpuṟamum cuṟṟuc cuvarkaḷum mēṟṟaḷamum peṟṟiruppatāl aṅku veppam tākkātu; veppak kāṟṟup pukātu.  vēṉiṟ kālattu vīcum teṉṟal tavaḻntu varum vaṇṇam cuvaril palakaṇikaḷ amaintiruntaṉa.
vāṉuṟa nivanta mēṉilai maruṅkiṉ
vēṉiṟ paḷḷit teṉvaḷi tarūum
nērvāyk kaṭṭaḷait tiriyātu tiṇṇilai -neṭunal 62-64

vaḷamaṉai makaḷirum maintarum virumpi

araṇmaṉaiyil pāvai viḷakku
tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷiṉ araṇmaṉaiyil makaḷir vāḻum antappuram taṉiyē iruntatu.  aṅku aracaṉuṭaiya maṉaiviyum-atāvatu paṭṭattaraciyum maṟumaṉaiyāṭṭikaḷum avarkaḷiṉ paṇip peṇkaḷum iruppar.  aṅku aracaṉ allatu ayalār evarum aṇuka muṭiyātu.  palamāṉa kāval uṇṭu.  pāṇṭiya maṉṉarkaḷum cōḻar, ciṅkaḷavar, cērar, kaṉṉaṭar, āntirar mutaliya nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷōṭu peṇ eṭuttum koṭuttum uḷḷaṉar.  urōm nāṭṭup peṇkaḷ meykkāvalarkaḷaip pāṇṭiyarkaḷ antappurattil iṭam peṟṟiruntaṉar. cōḻar pāṇṭiyar, cāḷukkiyar, āntirar, kaliṅkar, kaṭāra nāṭṭiṉar, (malēciyar) mutaliya nāṭṭiluḷḷa araciḷaṅkumarikaḷai maṇantum peṇ koṭuttum uḷḷaṉar.  araṇmaṉai ayalnāṭṭu poruḷkaḷāl alaṅkarikkap peṟṟiruntatu.  pāṇṭiyar araṇmaṉaiyil yavaṉanāṭṭup pāvai viḷakku aṇipeṟat tikaḻntatu.  itaṉai neṭunalvāṭai
yavaṉar iyaṟṟiya viṉaimāṇ pāvai
kaiyēntu akala niṟai ney corintu
parūuttiri koḷīiya kurūuttalai nimir eri 
						    -neṭunal 101-104   
kūṟuvataṉ mūlam naṉkaṟiyalām. 
aṉṉam vaitta viḷakku
 iḵtaṉṟi aṉṉam pōṉṟa pāvaikaḷ uruvil ceyyappaṭṭu vanta viḷakkum pāṇṭiyarkaḷ araṇmaṉaiyil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭṭu vantaṉaveṉṟu perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai eṉṉum paḻaiya tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ mūlam aṟikiṉṟōm:
----------------------  yavaṉar
ōtima viḷakkiṉ uyarmicai koṇṭa
vaikuṟu maṉīṟ paiyakat tōṉṟu
nīrp peyaṟ ṟellai 		      -perumpāṇ 11:316-19
tamiḻakam pōnta yavaṉarkaḷiṉ marakkalaṅkaḷil uḷḷa kūmpukaḷil aṉṉam uruvamuḷḷa ciṟpavēlaippāṭamainta aḻakiya viḷakkukaḷ iruntaṉa.  avaikaḷ tamiḻaka aracarkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷilum civaṉār, tirumāl kōyilkaḷilum nantā viḷakku eṉṉum peyaril iṭam peṟṟaṉa eṉṟu terikiṟatu.  aṉṉam tamiḻ nāṭṭup paṟavaiyalla.  anta aṉṉa viḷakkukaḷai ātiyil urōmarkaḷ tamiḻ nāṭṭiṟku aḷittaṉar eṉpatu varalāṟṟup pāṅkāṉa uṇmai.
araṇmaṉaiyil eḻiṟ pūṅkā
iyaṟkai iṉpattai iṉituṇarnta tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷ tam araṇmaṉaiyil ceyaṟkaik kuṉṟukaḷ, iyantira  vāvikaḷ kālvāy amaittu uyarnta maraṅkaḷaiyum, pūñceṭikaḷaiyum, pūmaraṅkaḷaiyum, paḻa maraṅkaḷaiyum amaittu eḻil peṟac ceytiruntaṉar.  aṅku mayilkaḷ āṭiṉa.  kuyilkaḷ pāṭiṉa.  kiḷḷaikaḷum pūvaiyum maḻalai miḻaṟṟiṉa.  māṉkaḷ tuḷḷik kutittu viḷaiyāṭiṉa.  iṅku araciḷaṅ kāḷaikaḷum, araciḷaṅ kumarikaḷum āṭippāṭi iṉpuṟṟu vantaṉar.  itaṉai neṭunal
vāṭai, naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.
nerumayir ekiṉat tūniṟa ēṟṟai
kuṟuṅkāl aṉṉamoṭu ukaḷum muṉkaṭai
						        neṭunal 91-92
aracaṉ vāḻum kōyilil nilā muṟṟattil orupakutiyil mīṉ vaṭivam pōṟ ceyyappaṭṭa akaṉṟai vāyaiyuṭaiya nīrt tūmpiṉiṉṟu eppoḻutum nīr poṅki eḻuntu koṇṭē iruntatu.  maṟṟoru pakkam anta aruvi nīr kaṇṭum ataṉ oli kēṭkum māmayil makiḻntu tōkaiyai virittu āṭi akavum. mayilum aruviyum amaintayiṭam malaik kāṭciyaik kāṭṭilum iṉitē tikaḻntatu.  itaṉai neṭunalvāṭaiyil mika aḻakāṉa ōviyamākat tīṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  atu aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
nilavum payaṉ koḷḷum neṭuveṇ muṟṟattu
kimpurip pakuvāy ampaṇam niṟaiyak
kaluḻntu vīḻ aruvip pāṭuviṟan tayala
oli neṭum pīli olka mel liyal
kaḷimayal akavum vayir maruḷ iṉṉicai
naḷimalaic cilamayil cilampuṅ kōyil  -neṭunal 95-100
vīṭukaḷ
muṟkālattil tamiḻakattil vīṭukaḷiṉ amaippukaḷ paranta tāyum nāṉku puṟamum kāliyāṉa nilapparappukaḷ uḷḷatāyum vīṭṭiṉ piṉpuṟattil kiṇaṟum pūmaraṅkaḷum kāykaṉikaḷ tarum maraṅkaḷ uḷḷatāyum iruntaṉa.  vīṭukaḷ pala aṟaikaḷuḷḷatāyum aḻakuḷḷatāyum amaintiruntatu.  iṟaiyaṉār akapporuḷ eṉṉum nūliṉ urai paṇṭaik kālat tamiḻmakkaḷiṉ maṉai amaippu evvāṟu iruntatu eṉpatai naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṟatu.1 atu aṭiyil varumāṟu:
aṭṭil (aṭukkaḷai), koṭṭakāram(paṇṭaṅkaḷ vaikkumiṭam), paṇṭa cālai (aṇikaḷ mutaliyaṉa vaikkum iṭam) kūṭa kāraṅkaḷ (mēṉmāṭam) paḷḷiyampalam (tuyilum iṭam) kūttap paḷḷi (nāṭaka maṉṟam) eṉa ivaṟṟuḷ nīkki  ceykuṉṟum iḷamarakkāvum, pūmpantarum viḷaiyāṭum iṭamum ivaṟṟaic cārntaṉavaṟṟuḷḷum piṟavaṟṟuḷḷumāka eṉṟavāṟu.  eṉak kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  itu maṉṉaṉ maṉaiyā, periya nilak kiḻār maṉaiyā eṉṟu aiyappaṭum aḷavil amaintuḷḷatu.
itukāṟu eṭuttuk kāṭṭiya cāṉṟukaḷ caṅka kālattilum-kiṟittava ūḻikku muṉṉar tamiḻnāṭṭil eḻuntuḷḷa kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ēṟṟattai oruvāṟu uṇara muṭiyum.  ataṟku muṉṉuḷḷa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaip paṟṟi nām aṟivataṟku tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ oṉṟum kiṭṭavillai.  kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ etuvum ituvaraik kaṇṭu piṭikkappaṭavillai.
akaḻ āyvil cintu veḷiyil kiṭaittatu pōl nakaraṅkaḷō, kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷō kiṭaikkavillai, atōṭu tamiḻ nāṭṭil akkaraiyōṭu akaḻ āyvil iṟaṅkac ceyya aracu muyaṟci etuvum ceyyavillai.
ciṟitu kālattiṟku muṉ intiya maiya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉar ceyta akaḻ āyvil paḻaṅkaṟkāla makkaḷ payaṉpaṭuttiya karuvikaḷ ceṅkaṟpaṭṭu māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa kōttalaiyāṟṟup pakutikaḷil kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi atirām pākkam pūṇṭi mutaliya iṭaṅkaḷilum cila paḻaṅkaṟkāla makkaḷiṉ kaṟkālak karuvikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭaṉa.  tirunelvēli māvaṭṭattil naṭattiya akaḻ āyvil pala putiya kaṟkālak karuvikaḷ kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.
1867-lum 1904-lum tirunelvēli māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa akaḻ āyvil palavitamāṉa maṇcaṭṭikaḷ pāṉaikaḷ kalayaṅkaḷōṭu, irumpiṉāl ceyta īṭṭittalai, uḷi, mūvilai vēl, īṭṭi, irupuṟamum kūrāṉavāḷ, kuttuvāḷ, vēl, vācci katti, maṇ veṭṭi, kōṭari, eṟi vēl pōṉṟa āyutaṅkaḷ pala kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  pala veṇkala pāttiraṅkaḷum ciṟuvarkaḷiṉ viḷaiyāṭṭup poruḷkaḷum poṉ aṇikalaṉ kaḷum kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa.
1970-ām āṇṭaiyoṭṭi ceṉṉait tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉar koṟkaiyil naṭattiya akaḻ āyvil pala ariya pāṉai caṭṭikaḷum piṟa poruḷkaḷum kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa.  ivaikaḷ ki.mu.785 āṇṭil uḷḷavai eṉṟu kūṟappeṟṟuḷḷatu.
1965-ām āṇṭaiyoṭṭi intiya maiya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉar naṭattiya akaḻ āyvil pala pāṉai caṭṭikaḷ, āyutaṅkaḷ uṭainta cilaikaḷ pōṉṟa pala ariya poruḷkaḷum vīṭukaḷiṉ aṭippaṭaikaḷum kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  aṅku pala paḻaiya kōyilkaḷiṉ aḻipāṭukaḷum kiṭaittaṉa.
ivaṟṟiṟku muṉ 1945-ām āṇṭil putuc cēriyaic cērnta arikkaṉ mēṭu eṉṉum pakutiyai piriṭṭiṣ āṭciyāḷarkaḷ muyaṟciyāl intiyat tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉ muyaṟciyāl aṟiñar mārṭṭimārṭṭimā uyilar (Director general) talaimaiyil āyntu aṅku ki.mu200-ām āṇṭil nilaviya tuṟaimukam, yavaṉac cēri, cuṭumaṇ ceṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa paṇṭakac cālaikaḷum akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkap paṭṭaṉa.  kaṇṇāṭi, paḷiṅku, NJgts«(Carnelian) mutaliyavai kaḷil kaṭainta maṇikaḷum, pala patakkaṅkaḷum poṉmaṇikaḷum kiṭaittuḷḷaṉa.  iṅku tāṉ yavaṉar virumpiya mika melliya maliṉ tuṇikaḷukkuc cāyam ēṟṟappaṭṭatu.  iṅku urōmar ittāliyar nakarattuk kuyavarkaḷ ceyta pala aḻakiya uyarntavakai ariṭṭaikaḷum (Arretine)  maṭkalaṉkaḷum kaṇṭeṭukkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  mēlum pala kaṇṇāṭik kōppaikaḷum, matuccāṭikaḷum, kiṟittuva ūḻikku muṉ nām yavaṉa nāṭukaḷuṭaṉ ceyta kaṭal vaṇikattai uṟutippaṭuttuvatāy uḷḷaṉa.  ki.mu.1400-ām āṇṭil naṭaipeṟṟatākak karutappaṭum irāmaṉ varalāṟṟil (vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇattil) kūṟum irāvaṇaṉuṭaiya pala māṭikaḷaiyuṭaiya  uparikkaikaḷaiyuṭaiya araṇ maṉaiyum, pāṇṭiyaṉiṉ talainakarāṉa kapāṭa purattil pāṇṭiyap pēraraciṉ kōṭṭai vāyiliṉ poṟṟakaṭu pōrtta katavukaḷiṉ ciṟappaiyum inta akaḻ āyvu meyppikkiṟatu.
inta akaḻ āyviṟ kaṇṭa poruḷkaḷum, tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ kūṟum araṇmaṉaikaḷum, māḷikaikaḷum, kōyil kaḷum caṅka kālattil tiṭīreṉṟu muḷaittu viṭṭatu eṉṟu evarum kūṟa muṭiyātu.  tamiḻ ilakkiyaṅkaḷ kūṟum kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ēṟṟattai eytuvataṟku tamiḻ makkaḷum tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷum, kottarkaḷum 5000 - āṇṭukaḷākap paṇpaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum eṉpatu aṟivuṭaiyār evarum maṟukka muṭiyāta uṇmaiyākum.
eṉavē cintu veḷi nākarikam eḻuvataṟku pallāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tamiḻnāṭu cintu veḷi nākarikattai viṭac ciṟappuṟṟu  viḷaṅkiyatu eṉṟa uṇmai uṇarappaṭukiṟatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil 8000 -māṇṭukaḷukku muṉ uyarnta kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷai eḻuppip paṇpaṭṭa karaṅkaḷē upaitiyā, ellam, cumēriyā, kirīṭ cintu veḷip paṇpāṭṭai eḻuppi ulakilē oppaṟṟa nākarikam eṉṟu ulakam viyakkumāṟu ceytaṉa.
cintu veḷi nākarikam makkaḷiṉ varalāṟṟiṟkum puttoḷi tantu putiyatoru poliviṉai aḷittirukkiṟatu intiya varalāṟṟiṉ iruṇṭa kālattai eḻil mikka poṟkālameṉa iyampukiṟatu.  intiya nākarikattiṉ aṭip paṇpukaḷāka viḷaṅkuvaṉa yāvum cintu veḷi nākarikattiṉ ciṟappiyalpukaḷē eṉṉum varalāṟṟiṉ kuralaik kēṭṭu ulakam viyakkum vaṇṇam ceytuḷḷatu.  cintu veḷi nākarikam intiyāviṉ oru aḷavu kōl; intiyap paṇpāṭṭiṟkuḷ ciṟappiṟku ōr uraikal eṉṉum ariya uṇmaiyai uṇarttukiṟatu  eṉṟu pēraṟiñar pērāciriyar ka.ta.tirunāvukkaracu avarkaḷ kūṟiyatu mikap poruḷ ceṟinta poṉ moḻiyākum.1

kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ 
tōṟṟamum vaḷarcciyum

ki.mu.4000-āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tamiḻakattilum vicuvakarmā mayaṉ pōṉṟa teyva kammiyarkaḷ vāḻntu vantaṉar.  viṇmuṭṭum vīṭukaḷaiyum mukil tavaḻum māṭaṅkaḷaiyum eḵkuk kōṭṭai kaḷaiyum eṭuppittu tamiḻakattiṟkup pērum perumaiyum aḷittaṉar.
iṟaivaṉai imaippoḻutum maṟavāta irāvaṇaṉ, mātēvar malaraṭiyait toḻum maṇṭōtari ulakil tirunīṟu aṇintavarkaḷukku ilakkaṇamākat tikaḻntavarākiya irāvaṇaṉ maṉaiviyum pārulakil uḷḷa pattuk kaṟparacikaḷil oru ciṟu mācum kūṟa muṭiyāta irāvaṇaṉ maṉaivi maṇṭōtariyiṉ tantai vicuvakarmāvāka iruntāṉ
eṉavē taṉ marumakaṉ irāvaṇaṉukku eḻunilai māṭaṅ kaḷaiyum eḵku pōṉṟa araṇkaḷaiyum ciṟanta āyutaṅkaḷaiyum ceytu koṭuttāṉ. irāvaṇaṉ araṇmaṉai oru yōcaṉai nīḷam uḷḷatāy mukiḻ tavaḻum māṭam uḷḷatāy uyarntu viḷaṅkiyatu.  pavaḷat tuṇkaḷum paḷiṅkup paṭikaḷum, poṟkaṭṭilum maṇikaḷ iḻaitta araca kaṭṭilum aṅku iruntaṉa.  navamaṇikaḷ iḻaitta poṉ aṇikalaṉkaḷ eṇṇilātu kāṇappaṭṭaṉa.  tarai cantaṉak kuḻampāl meḻukappaṭṭu aḻakuṟap polintaṉa.  eṅkum vilaiyuyarnta virippukaḷ kāṇappaṭṭaṉa.  naṟumaṇa vācaṉai iṉpamūṭṭiṉa.  iravil eṇṇilā viḷakkukaḷ araṇmaṉaiyil paṭṭap pakaleṉa oḷivīcac ceytaṉa. aṅkuḷḷa   pūṅkākkaḷum, aṅku vāḻum mayilum,  kuyilum, kiḷiyum, kiṉṉarappaṟavaikaḷum, paratīcup paṟavaikaḷum, māṉkaḷ, kutiraikaḷ, āṭu māṭukaḷ mutaliyavaikaḷellām araṇmaṉaiyai aḻaku ceyvatu pōl polivuṟṟiruntaṉa eṉṟu eḻil peṟa eṭuttukkāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  itu aiyāyiram āṇṭukaṭku muṉ teṉ intiyāvil irunta kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ciṟappai eṭuttuk kāṭṭuvatāy uḷḷatu.
ki.mu. mutal nūṟṟāṇṭiṉiṉṟu irupatām nuṟṟāṇṭu varai nilaviyatākak karutappaṭum ātitta nallūr nākarikattil irunta irumpu āyutaṅkaḷum veṅkala pāttiraṅkaḷum maṭpāṇṭaṅ kaḷum, viḷaiyāṭṭup poruḷkaḷum tamiḻakattil uyarnta kaṭṭiṭak kalai nilavi iruntatu eṉpatai ūkikka iṭam tarukiṟatu.  āṉāl ātitta nallūr nākarikam paraviya nakaram itu varai namakkuk kiṭaikkavillai.  ātitta nallūr nākarikam arappā nākari kattōṭu caṅkilit toṭar pōla piṇaintuḷḷatu.  eṉṟār ār.ṭi.pāṉarji.
ki.mu. mūvāyiram āṇṭaḷavil pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ talai
nakarāyum, tuṟaimukap paṭṭiṉamāyum viḷaṅkiya koṟkai camīpattil akaḻ āyvu ceyyappaṭṭatu.  āṉāl nakaramō, vīṭukaḷaiyō akaḻntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭavillai.  āṉāl 
ki.mu.800 āṇṭil pala uṭaintu pōṉa pāṉai caṭṭikaḷum uṭainta cāṭikaḷum piṟavum kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  iṉṉum koṟkaiyil niṟaivāṉa akaḻ āyvu ceyyap peṟṟāl ki.mu.2000 -m āṇṭaḷavil tamiḻakam peṟṟirunta kaṭṭiṭakkalaiyiṉ ciṟappai meyppikka mutal taramāṉa cāṉṟukaḷ kiṭaikkak kūṭum.
ki.mu. iraṇṭāyiram āṇṭiṟku muṉṉuḷḷa tamiḻ nāṭṭu maṉṉarkaḷiṉ talai nakaraṅkaḷum, araṇkaḷum araṇmaṉaikaḷum aḻintu paṭṭaṉa.  piṟkālat tamiḻ aracarkaḷ vāḻnta koṟkaiyum, vañciyum, pūmpukārum kūṭa niṟaivāṉa akaḻ āyvu ceyyappaṭavillai.  āyvu ceyyap peṟṟāl namatu paḻamperum kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ cīrum ciṟappum veḷivarum.
piṟkālap pāṇṭiyarkaḷiṉ talainakarāka viḷaṅkiyatu iṉṟaiya maturai.  itu ālavāy eṉṟum nāṉmāṭakkūṭal eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  kiṟittuva ūḻi kiḷarnteḻuvataṟku muṉ maturai nāṉku māṭi
kaḷaiyuṭaiya pala araṇmaṉaikaḷaiyum, araṇkaḷaiyum, māḷikaikaḷaiyum vīṭukaḷaiyum kōyilkaḷai yum peṟṟiruntaṉa.  intak kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ciṟappai āyntōr tamiḻarkaḷ, aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē cīrāṉa kaṭṭiṭakkalaiyiṉ aṟivaiyum, nakar amaippiṉ tiṟaṉaiyum peṟṟiruntāltāṉ inta maturaiyai nirmāṇittirukka muṭiyum eṉṟu navilkiṉṟaṉar.  tamiḻar kaṭṭiṭak kalai taṉic ciṟappu vāyntavai.  piṟa iṉattavariṉiṉṟu kaṭaṉ vāṅkiyavai allatu-maturai mānakariṉ nakar amaippu tiṟaṉ pāṇṭiya nāṭṭu ciṟpikaḷiṉ paṭṭaṟiviṟkum, kaivaṇṇattiṟkum ciṟpa aṟiviṟkum nalla eṭuttuk kāṭṭākum. maturai nakar amaipput tiṟaṉ ulakiṟkōr putumai.  viyattaku peṟṟi vāyntatu.
makāpāratattilum irāmāyaṇattilum piṉ ki.mu.4-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil muṟpakutiyil vāḻnta cantira kuptariṉ aracavaiyil kirēkka tūtaṉāka irunta mekataṉi kūṟṟilum ki.mu.300 -m āṇṭiṉ acōkaṉ kalveṭṭilum ki.pi.77-ām āṇṭil intiyā pōnta piḷiṉi eṉṉum ayal nāṭṭaṟiñarum ki.pi.77-il maturai mānakar ulakiṟperiya paṇṭaka cālai eṉṟu kūṟip pōntār.  varalāṟṟup pukaḻ peṟṟa tālami eṉṟa aṟiñar ki.pi.140-ām āṇṭil maturaip pāṇṭiyariṉ māṇpai eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyatiliruntum pāṇṭiyap pēraracarkaḷ urōma cakkaravartti akaṭar aracavaikku amaiccarkaḷai aṉuppi araca tūtuvar
kaḷaip parimāṟṟam ceytu koṇṭatum, piṉṉar pāracīkap payaṇiyum, cīṉavaḻip pōkkaṉum, mārkkō pōlō eṉṉum ittāliya vaṇikaṉ eḻuti vaitta kuṟippukaḷum maturai nakariṉ paṇpāṭṭaiyum kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyiṉ ciṟappaiyum naṉku pulap paṭuttukiṉṟaṉa.
mikat toṉmaiyāṉa kālattilēyē namatu tamiḻnāṭṭil kaṭṭiṭak kalai eḻuntuḷḷatu.  āṉāl aṉṟu maṇṇālum marattālum amaikkappaṭṭaṉa.  appāl ceṅkalliṉālum cuṇṇāmpiṉālum cuvarkaḷ eḻuppiyum kūraikaḷ vēyntum kaṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. vīṭukaḷ, araṇmaṉaikaḷ, araṇkaḷ maṇṭapaṅkaḷ aṉaittum ivvāṟē amaikkappaṭṭaṉa.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil maṇṇālē amaikkappaṭṭa araṇkaḷum vīṭukaḷum iṉṟum uḷḷaṉa.  ciṟṟūrkaḷil kāḷi,kūḷi,māri, māṭatti, icakki piṭāri vaṇṭi malaicci pōṉṟa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷiṉ kōyilkaḷ nāṟpuṟamum maṇcuvar eḻuppi mēlē paṉai ōlai vēyntum marakkatavukaḷ pōṭṭum iruntu varukiṉṟaṉa.  kōyiliṉṟi kāṟṟaiyum, veyyilaiyum, maḻaiyaiyum poruṭpaṭuttātu veṟum pīṭattiṉ mītu niṟkum maṇṇālāṉa teyva uruvaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa. iṉṟu perumpālāṉa tāyt teyvaṅkaḷil nāṟpuṟam ceṅkallum cuṇṇāmpum vaittuk kaṭṭi mēlē maṭṭappāy iṭṭu cuṇṇāmpu allatu cimiṇṭāl mēṟpūccup pūcap peṟṟu irumpuk kampikaḷālāṉa kataviṭṭu pūṭṭap peṟṟirukkum kōyilkaḷē atikam uḷḷaṉa.  makkaḷiṉ poruḷātāra nilai uyara uyara kōyilkaḷum ciṟappuṟṟu eḻuntuḷḷaṉa.  ki.pi.āṟām nuṟṟāṇṭiṟkup piṉ tamiḻakattil kukaik kōyilkaḷum, kuṭai varaik kōyilum kaṟṟaḷikaḷumākap palakōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  kallum cuṇṇāmpum kalantu aṭippaṭaiyiṭṭu karuṅkaṟ pāḷaṅkaḷai oṉṟiṉ mītu oṉṟāka varicaiyāka aṭukki vaittu kaṭṭum kōyilē kaṟṟaḷikaḷ eṉappaṭum.
caṅka kālak kōyilkaḷ
caṅka kālattilē-atāvatu iraṇṭām caṅkam nilaviya kālattilē atāvatu ki.mu.300-mutal ki.mu.100-varaiyuḷḷa kālattilē tamiḻakattil kaṭṭiṭak kalai ciṟappuṟṟiruntatu.  kōyilkaḷ pala kaṭṭap peṟṟaṉa.  āṉāl avaikaḷ maṇṇālum ceṅkallālum marattālum kaṭṭap peṟṟiruntatāl nāṭṭil eḻunta koṭiya taṭpa veppa nilaikaḷait tāṅka muṭiyāmal aḻintu viṭṭaṉa.  paḻaṅkaṟkālan toṭṭu, putiya kaṟkālam-ulōka
kālam varalāṟṟuk kālam varai tamiḻ makkaḷ iṅku vāḻntu varukiṟārkaḷ. 1 caṅkam niṟuviyuḷḷārkaḷ.  ilakkiyaṅkaḷ iyaṟṟiyuḷḷaṉar.  eṇṇaṟ kariya kalaikaḷaip paṭaittuḷḷaṉar. āḻkaṭal kaṭakkum kalaṅkaḷaik kaṭṭi ilaṅkai, ciṅkappūr, kaṭāram, malaiyam cāvakam mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkuc ceṉṟuḷḷaṉarkaḷ.  aṅku taṅkaḷ camayattai nilai nāṭṭiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  ekiptu, ellam, cumēriyā, kirīṭ mutaliya nāṭukaḷukkum pōyk kuṭiyēṟi aṅku taṅkaḷ camayattaiyum paṇpāṭṭaiyum nilai nāṭṭiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  cintu veḷiyiṟ kuṭiyēṟi ki.mu.3000 ām āṇṭiṟku muṉpu oppaṟṟa uyariya kalaikaḷai uruvākkiyuḷḷārkaḷ.  iṉṟaikku aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ ulakil enta iṉamum kaṇṭum kēṭṭum irāta cātaṉaikaḷaic cātittuḷḷārkaḷ.  arappā mokañcatārō, caṅkutārō nakar amaippum uyariya kaṭṭiṭa amaippum ulakam kaṇṭum  viyakkum peṟṟiyai uṭaiyaṉa allavā?  ittakaiya naṉiciṟanta nākarika makkaḷ caṅka kālattil kaṭṭiṭak kalaiyil ciṟantu viḷaṅki iruntaṉarā eṉpatil ciṟitum aiyappaṭa vēṇṭiya
tillai.  cilar ki.mu.3000 āmāṇṭil cintu veḷiyil ciṟanta nākarikattaip paṭaitta makkaḷ cumēriya nāṭṭiṉiṉṟu kuṭiyēṟiyavarkaḷ.  avarkaḷ āriyarkaḷāl  teṉ intiyāviṟkut taḷḷappaṭṭu kiṟittava ūḻiyai oṭṭi aṅku kuṭiyēṟi irukkalām. eṉavē aṅku avarkaḷāl periya kaṭṭiṭakkalaiyai uruvākki irukka muṭiyātu eṉṟu eṇṇukiṟārkaḷ.  itu tavaṟāṉa muṭipākum.  ki.mu.10000 ām āṇṭiṟku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ teṉ intiyāvil vāḻntu varukiṉṟārkaḷ.  avarkaḷ paḻaṅkaṟkālam putuk kaṟkālam, ulōka kālam aṉaittaiyum paṭaittavarkaḷ.  avarkaḷiṟ cilar cumēriyāviṟkuṭiyēṟi, appāl cintu veḷikku vantu āriyarkaḷāl veruṭṭappaṭṭup piṉ teṟku nōkki vantu taṅkaḷ tāy iṉattōṭu vantu kalantu irukkalām eṉṟu karutukiṟēṉ.  teṉ intiyat tirāviṭa makkaḷ vaṭa intiyāvil kuṭiyēṟi irukkalām.  itu varalāṟṟu āciriyar vi.ār irāmac cantira aiyar pērāciriyar lāṅṭaṉ, ṭākṭar haṇṭar ṭākṭar eyc.ār.hāl pōṉṟavarkaḷ karuttumākum.
caṅka kālattilē tamiḻar kaṭṭiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷaik kāṭṭa muṭiyāviṭṭālum eṇṇaṟṟa ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷaik kāṭṭa muṭiyum.
kiṟittava ūḻikku muṉpē mutaṟcaṅkamum, tamiḻarum, tamiḻ moḻiyum tamiḻnāṭum, tamiḻ nākarikamum nilavi irunta pakuti kaṭaṟkōḷāl maṟaintu pōṉatai innāṭṭil vāḻum cila pulluruvi varkkam pōtiya cāṉṟu illai eṉṟu otukkit taḷḷi viṭukiṉṟaṉar.  mūvāyiram āṇṭukaṭku ivarkaḷ vētaṅkaḷum teyvaṅkaḷum, tēvarkaḷiṉ caṇṭaiyum kiḷiyum, kaḻutaiyum, kutiraiyum, ciṅkamum, puliyum, yāṉaiyum makkaḷaip peṟṟa mākkataikaḷum purāṇap poymūṭṭaikaṭkum cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭikiṟatu eṉṟu varuttattuṭaṉ kūṟa vēṇṭiyavaṉāka iruk
kiṉṟēṉ.
kumari muṉaikku teṟkē, tamiḻnāṭu, kumari nāṭu, oḷi nāṭu eṉṉum peyarāl oru perum nilapparappu iruntatu eṉṟum aṅku pāṇṭiya maṉṉar āṭcipurintaṉar eṉṟum avarkaḷ niṟuviya mutaṟcaṅkamum caṅkattil uṟup peṟṟa uṟuppiṉarkaḷ peyarkaḷum aṅku araṅkēṟṟiya nūṟkaḷum akkālattil uḷḷa nāṭukaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum avarkaḷāl tōṟṟuvikkappaṭṭa vīṭukaḷum, araṇmaṉaikaḷum, araṇkaḷum kōyilkaḷum uḷḷaṉa eṉpatu maṟukkaṟ pālataṉṟu.
naṭukalliṉ tōṟṟam
ātikālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭil tāy iṟantatum avaḷiṉ niṉaivākavum, avaḷatu vaḻipāṭṭiṟkākavum naṭukal naṭappaṭṭatu.  appāl ciṟanta vīrarkaḷukkum naṭukal nāṭṭuvatum avarkaḷukku vaḻipāṭu ceyvatum eḻuntatu.  kaṟpuṭaiya makaḷirkkum catikkal naṭuvatum pattiṉip paṭimam nāṭṭuvatum vaḻipaṭuvatum uṇṭu
kāṭci kālkōḷ nīrppaṭai naṭukal
cīrtta marapiṟ perumpaṭai vāḻtal
ṟirumūṉṟu vakaiyiṟ kalloṭu puṇara -(tol.poruḷ 60)
eṉpatākum.
kōyilum vāḻkaiyum
tamiḻarkaḷ kōyilait tam uyirāka eṇṇupavarkaḷ.  kōyilai uṭal amaippilē uruvākkiyuḷḷaṉar.  uṭampil uyirum, kōyilil iṟaivaṉum iruppatāka makkaḷ eṇṇuvar.  makkaḷ eṅku kuṭiyēṟiṉum aṅku mutalil amaippatu kōyilāka iruntatu.  kōyil illā ūril kuṭiyirukka vēṇṭām eṉpatu avarkaḷ kaṇṭa mutumoḻi.  itu avarkaḷ kaṇṭa mantiramum ākum.  tamiḻ makkaḷ kōyil illāta ūr tiruvuṭaiya ūr ākā eṉṟu eṇṇiṉar.  oru ūr amaippiṟkuk kōyilai maiyamāka (kēntiramāka)t tamiḻar koṇṭaṉar.  kōyilai ūr naṭuvil amaittu  ataṉ nāṉku puṟamum caturamāka nāṉku terukkaḷai amaittu avaikaḷai māṭa vīti eṉṟu aḻaittaṉar.  ataṟku appāl nāṉku periya terukkaḷai amaittu tērōṭum teru (ētavīti) eṉṟu aḻaittaṉar.  ivvāṟu kōyilai maiyamāka amaittu caturam caturamāka terukkaḷai amaippatu paṇṭaik
kāla makkaḷiṉ nalla nakariṉ amaippu muṟaiyāka iruntatu.  maturai mānakar inta amaippu muṟaiyai aṭuttē amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.
kōyil illāta ūrkaḷ nalla nakar ākā.  atu koṭiya vilaṅkukaḷ vāḻum kāṭṭiṟkuc camam ākum.  kōyil illā ūrkaḷil vāḻum makkaḷ naṟpaṇpukaḷaiyum nalla paḻakka vaḻakkaṅkaḷaiyum peṟa muṭiyātu eṉṟu nampiṉar.
tiruk kōyil illāta tiruvilūrum
    tiruveṇṇī raṇiyāta tiruvilūrum
paruk kōṭip pattimaiyāṟ pāṭā vūrum
    pāṅkiṉoṭu palatuḷikaḷ illāvūrum
virup pōṭu veṇ caṅkam ūtā vūrum
    vimāṉamum veṇkoṭiyum illā vūrum
aruppōṭu malarpaṟit tiṭṭuṇṇā vūrum
    avai yellām ūralla aṭavi kāṭē
eṉṟu kūṟum tiruttāṇṭakam namatu karuttai valiyuṟuttuvatāka miḷirkiṉṟatu.
tamiḻ makkaḷ
tirukkōyilkaḷai, mikat toṉmaiyāṉa kālattilē iyaṟkai eḻil iyainta kuṉṟukaḷilum kuṉṟiṉ aṭi vārattilum, kuḷakkaraiyilum, āṟṟaṅkaraiyilum kaṭaṟkaraiyilum, cōlai kaḷiṉ naṭuvilum, amaittaṉar.  kōyil makkaḷ aṉaivarum  oṉṟu kūṭum iṭamāka amaikkappaṭṭatu.  kōyilkaḷil āṟukālap pūcai naṭaipeṟṟatu.  makkaḷ tavaṟātu pūcaikkuc celvar.
makkaḷ kālai mālai uṭaṟṟūymai ceyyavum kōyilkaḷiṉ uṭpukum poḻutu kaikāl, mukam mutaliya uṟuppukaḷai kaḻuvic cellavum  kōyilkaḷōṭu kuḷamum amaittiruntaṉar.
 kōyilkaḷil makkaḷukkup piracātam eṉṉum peyarāl uṇavu vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.  kuṟainta celavil atika aḷavu cōṟum viṟkappaṭṭatu.  carkkaraip poṅkal, puḷiyōtarai, tayirc cātam, tōcai, vaṭai, atiracam pōṉṟavaikaḷ aṉaivarukkum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭatu.  iṉṟum viṟkappaṭṭu varukiṟatu.  cukku vennīr, pāṉakkāram pōṉṟa kuṭinīrkaḷum pālum vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  tīrttam eṉṉum peyarāl taṇṇīrum aḷikkappaṭṭatu.  cantaṉam, paṉṉīr vaḻaṅkappaṭṭaṉa.  cāmpirāṇi, kaṟpūram mutaliya naṟumaṇap pukaikaḷum kāṭṭappaṭṭaṉa. 
kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭiṭak kalaikkum, cilai, paṭimam, ōviyam ākiya kalaikaḷukkum nalla ūṟṟāka iruntatu.  āṭaikaḷ aṇikaḷ, maṇikaḷ mutaliyavaikaḷaip pēṇip pātukākkum tāyakamāy amaintaṉa.  icaiyum nāṭṭiyamum vaḷarkkum māmaṉṟamākak kāṭci nalkiyatu.  aṅku yāḻ, vīṇai, muḻavu, nātacuram, vīṇai, tavil, uṭukkai pāṇi, takkai mutaliya karuvikaḷ mīṭṭappaṭṭu vantaṉa.  potumakkaḷukku kōyilkaḷ kalaik karuvūlamāka eḻuntaṉa.  araṇmaṉaiyai viṭa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷattil aṉpum, aruḷum, amaitiyum, iṉpamum, eḻucciyum aḷikkum iṉpa puriyāy viḷaṅkiṉa.
tamiḻakattilē kaṟkālattiṟku muṉpē teyva vaḻipāṭu tuḷirttuḷḷatu.  ātiyil makkaḷ tāyai vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.  tāy iṟanta piṉ avaḷ putaikkappaṭṭa iṭattil oru marattuṇṭaiyō kallaiyō naṭṭu vaḻipaṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.
kaṟkālam toṭaṅku muṉpē, makkaḷ mutirāp paṇpuṭaiya mutumakkaḷāy vāḻum poḻutē iṭi,miṉṉal, kāṟṟu, neruppu mutaliyavaṟṟaik kaṇṭañciṉar.  avaṟṟait toḻutaṉar.  appāl ñāyiṟu, tiṅkaḷ, cevvāy mutaliya kōḷkaḷai vaḻipaṭṭaṉar.  piṉ iravilum, iruṭṭilum, kārkālaṅkaḷilum tī, viḷakku ñāyiṟu pōṉṟa muccuṭar vaḻipāṭṭait toṭaṅkiṉar.  muttī vaḻipāṭṭiliruntutāṉ kantu vaḻipāṭum iliṅka vaḻipāṭum tōṟṟam peṟṟaṉa.
makkaḷ nākarika vaḷarcciyil vīṭukaḷum araṇmaṉaikaḷum amaitta kālattil iṟaivaṉ uṟaiviṭam eṉṟu kōyilkaḷ amaikka muṟpaṭṭaṉar 
	(māṇikka vācakar kālamum varalāṟum-maṟaimalai aṭikaḷ)
viṇṇil uḷḷa kōḷkaḷai maṇṇil vaḻipaṭa makkaḷ mutalil neruppu, viḷakku mutaliyavaikaḷaip payaṉpaṭuttiṉar.  appāl avaṟṟiṟku tiruuruvam amaittu vaḻipaṭalāyiṉar.
tamiḻar kaṇṭa oḷi vaḻipāṭu ulaka meṅkum paraviyatu.  ellā camayattiṟkum oḷi vaḻipāṭu mūlavaḻipāṭāy uyarntatu.  makkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷarcciyil ataṟkup periya tattuvap poruḷkaḷ kūṟappaṭṭaṉa.  makkaḷiṉ aṟivu vaḷara vaḷara teyvaṅkaḷiṉ taṉmaiyum ciṟappum uyarntaṉa.
caṅka kālattilē tamiḻakattil kaṟkōyilkaḷē illai.  ceṅkaṟkaḷālum cuṇṇāmpiṉālum kaṭṭappaṭṭa kūraik kōyilkaḷē iruntaṉa.  antac ceṅkaṟ kaṭṭiṭak kōyilkaḷ kūṭi appoḻutu eḻunta taṭpa veppa nilaikaḷait tāṅka muṭiyātu carintaṉa.  makkaḷāl ceppaṉiṭa muṭiyavillai.  avaikaḷaik kaṇṇuṟṟa caṅka kālap pulavar uruttiraṅ kaṇṇār iṭintu citaintu vīḻntu kiṭakkum tirukkōyilaik kaṇṭu maṉam poṟātu,
iṭṭikai neṭuñcuvar viṭṭam vīḻnteṉa
maṇippuṟāt tuṟanta marañcēr māṭattu,
eḻutaṇi kaṭavuḷ pōka viṟ pulleṉṟu
oḻuku pali maṟanta meḻukāp puṉṟiṇai
eṉṟu pāṭip pulampiyuḷḷār.
itaṟkappālum ki.pi.6 ām nūṟṟāṇṭu varai kōc ceṅkeṭ cōḻaṉ pōṉṟa paktarkaḷ civa perumāṉukkum tirumālukkum eḻupatu kōyilkaḷaik kaṭṭiyuḷḷāṉ.  appāl cilar civaperumāṉukkuc cila vakai kōyilkaḷaik kaṭṭi
uḷḷaṉar.
ivaikaḷ ellām ceṅkaṟkaḷāl cuṇṇac cāntu koṇṭu pūcik kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷēyākum.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil iṉṟu peritum kaṟ kōyilkaḷākavē māṟi varukiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl kalkaḷ ērāḷamāka kiṭaikkum kēraḷattil, annāṭṭu makkaḷ itai marapu vaḻakkākak koṇṭu kūraik kōyilkaḷaiyum kaṟkaḷāl maṭṭap
pāy pōṭṭa caturam,vaṭṭam, araivaṭṭam pōṉṟa vaṭivil kaṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar. 
kūraik kōyilkaḷ
caṅka kālattil tamiḻakattil kaṭṭap peṟṟa kōyilkaḷ oṉṟaik kūṭap pārppatu aritāy viṭṭatu.  āṉāl kēraḷattil caṅka kālakkōyilkaḷ cilavaṟṟaik kāṇa muṭiyum eṉṟu cilar kūṟukiṉṟaṉar.  kēraḷattila pala kūraik kōyilkaḷ iṉṟum uḷḷaṉa.  avaikaḷai caṅka kālak kōyil eṉṟu nīṅkaḷ ēṟkāviṭiṉum caṅka kālattil nilaviya kōyilkaḷiṉ mātirik kōyilkaḷ eṉpatai uṟutiyāka ēṟṟuk koḷḷalām.
caṅka kālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭil kaṟkōyilkaḷē kiṭaiyātu.  perumpālum kūraik kōyilkaḷē uḷḷaṉa.  caṅka kālattil kōyilkaḷ nāṟ puṟamum maṇcuvar eḻuppi, mēlē marak kaṭṭaikaḷum caṭṭaṅkaḷum vaittuk  kaṭṭi maṭṭaikaḷāl kaṭṭaikaḷ mītu paṭṭiyal pōl paṉai nārkaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭu mēlē paṉai
yōlai, teṉṉai ōlai, taṭṭai cukku nāri pul mutaliyavaikaḷ vēyap peṟṟa kūraik kōyilē eṅkum iṭam peṟṟiruntaṉa.
appāl nāṟpuṟamum marakkālkaḷai nāṭṭi, mēlē palakaikaḷ vaittu āṇi aṭittuṭṭu mēlē palakaikaḷaik koṇṭu kūraiyāka vēynta kōyilkaḷ eṭuppikkappaṭṭaṉa.
caṅka kālattilē nalla nākarikam eḻunta piṉ nāṟpuṟamum ceṅkaṟkaḷ vaittu cuṇṇac cāntu iṭai iṭaiyē vaittuk kaṭṭi mēlē marac caṭṭaṅkaḷum, viṭṭaṅkaḷum, malkaikaḷum paṭṭiyalkaḷum, palakaikaḷum aṭikkappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ eḻuntaṉa.  cuvarkaḷ mītu cuṇṇac cāntu pūcap paṭṭatu.  mēlē pala kōyilkaḷil palakaikaḷ mītu ceṅkaṟtuṇṭukaḷum cuṇṇac cāntukaḷum viravi virikkappaṭṭu mēlē kaṉamāṉa cuṇṇac cāntu koṇṭu meḻuki veyyilukkum maḻaikkum tāṅkumvaṇṇam ceyyappaṭṭatu.
iṟutiyāka, caṭṭamum, viṭṭamum pala kaikaḷum vaittu irumpu āṇi aṭittu paṭṭiyalkaḷ iṇaittu mēlē ōṭu pōṭum nilai eḻuntatu.  iṉṟum pala kukkirāmaṅkaḷil ōṭu pōṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  keṭṭup pōṉālum aṭikkaṭi paḻutu pārkkappaṭṭu varukiṉṟaṉa.
tamiḻakattil caṅkakālattil nilaviya kōyilkaḷaip pōṉṟa kūraik kōyilkaḷ iṉṟum kēraḷa nāṭṭil pala uḷḷaṉa.  ciṟcila amaippukaḷ vēṟupaṭṭatāka iruntālum potuvāka oru amaippuṭaiyatāka iruntirukka vēṇṭum eṉṟu eṇṇap
paṭukiṟatu.  iṉṟu tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷai itu pāṇṭiya nāṭṭup pāṇi, itu cōḻa nāṭṭup pāṇi, itu pallavar nāṭṭup pāṇi, itu nāyakkar nāṭṭup pāṇi, eṉṟu kūṟuvatu pōl paṇṭaik kālattil cērar nāṭṭup pāṇi eṉṟu cila putiya amaippukaḷaiyum alaṅkāraṅkaḷaiyum cēra nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷ peṟṟirukkalām.
mēlum, makkaḷiṉ perukkamum, cūḻnilaikaḷum poruḷātārac 
ceḻippum cōḻa, pāṇṭiya, toṇṭai nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷil cēra nāṭṭuk kōyilkaḷai viṭa pala putiya amaippukaḷai eḻuppiyuḷḷaṉa. uyarnta matilkaḷ, vāṉ aḷāviya kōpuraṅkaḷ, kār mukilkaḷ tavaḻum uyariya vimāṉaṅkaḷ maṇi maṇṭapam, makā maṇṭapam, maṇa maṇṭapam, vacanta maṇṭapam, 108 kāl maṇṭapam, 1008 kāl maṇṭapaṅkaḷ, teppak kuḷaṅkaḷ, pōṉṟa pala māṟṟaṅ
kaḷai eḻuppiyuḷḷaṉa.
iṅku kāṭṭappaṭṭa tiruccūr kōyil pōṉṟa oṉṟiraṇṭu kōyilkaḷ tāṉ paṇṭaiyac caṅka kālak kōyilkaḷōṭu oppiṭṭu nōkkalām.  iḵtaṉṟi viḻiñam eṉṉum iṭattiluḷḷa 9-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭap paṭṭa kōyil cōḻar pāṇiyil tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyum muka maṇṭapamum uṭaiyatāy uḷḷatu.  10-ām nuṟṟāṇṭil kaṉṉiyākumariyil eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kukanāta cuvāmi kōyilum 9-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil eḻuppap peṟṟa pārttiva cēkarapuram kōyilum, 16 -ām nūṟṟāṇṭil uruppaṭuttappaṭṭa cucīntiram kōyilum 13 -ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa tiruvallam arai vaṭṭak kōyilākiya paracurāmar kōyilum, 14-ām nūṟṟāṇṭil kaṭṭappaṭṭa nirmaṅkarāvil uḷḷa vaṭṭa vaṭivilāṉa kōyilum 16- ām nūṟṟāṇṭil valiya utaiyāticca puram kōyilum ivaikaḷ pōṉṟu cilavum tamiḻ nāṭṭilum, maicūr mānilattilum uḷḷa iṉṟaiyak kōyilkaḷiṉ pāṇiyil uḷḷaṉa.
kēraḷāvil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ ellām tirāviṭap pāṇiyil kaṭṭappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷēyākum.  aṅku tiru uṇṇāḻikai (karuvaṟai) cirikōyil eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  aṅkuḷḷa kōyilkaḷiṉ karuvaṟai perumpālum catura vaṭivilē uḷḷaṉa.  arai vaṭṭam, vaṭṭam, caturam nīṇṭa catura vaṭivil iruntālum marakkaṭṭaikaḷāl kaṭṭappaṭṭu irumal kaṭṭaikaḷ kūmpiya vaṭivil aṭukkaṭukkāy vaittu paṭṭiyalkaḷ vaittu aṭittu mēlē ōṭukaḷ vēyap peṟṟirukkum kūraikaḷ mukkōṇa vaṭivil irukkum.  cirikōyiliṉ (tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ)  mēṟ kūraiyiṉ tōṟṟam akaṉṟa kūmpiya vaṭivil irukkum.  ataṉ aṇmaiyil uḷḷa iṭaṅkaḷiṉ (Halls) kūraikaḷ mukkōṇa vaṭivil nīḷ catura vaṭivil irukkum.  maḻait taṇṇīr uṭpukātu eḷitil veḷiyē celvataṟku ēṟṟatāka amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  
kēraḷāvil uḷḷa kūraikkōyil cila tamiḻ nāṭṭil uḷḷa cātāraṇa vīṭukaḷ pōl uḷḷaṉa.  cila-atāvatu eṭṭamaṉūr kōyil muṉpuṟam ōṭu pōṭṭa tāḻvāramum appāl uyaramāṉa oru taṭṭuḷḷa kūraiyum uḷḷaṉa.  itai vimāṉam eṉṟu kūṟukiṟārkaḷ.  oṉṟiṉ mēl oṉṟāka iraṇṭu kōppuḷḷa kōyilai iraṇṭu vimāṉam allatu iraṇṭu māṭik kōyil eṉkiṉṟaṉar.  tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ muṉ uḷḷa paṭik kaṭṭukaḷ cōpāṉam eṉappaṭum.  kēraḷak kōyiliṉ muṉ, namakāra maṇṭapamum atai aṭuttu nālampalam eṉṉum uṟuppum ataṉai aṭuttu palikkal (palipīṭam) koṭi maram ākiya pākaṅkaḷ amaintirukkum.  koṭi marattiṉ arukē yāṉaik koṭṭilkaḷ iṭam peṟṟirukkum.  kōyilkaḷ aṉaittum tirāviṭa ciṟpa muṟaiyil kaṭṭap
paṭṭatēyākum.1
marakkōyilkaḷ
muṟkālattil tamiḻ nāṭṭil eṅkum marattiṉāl kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa.  maṇkōyilai viṭa marakkōyil ciṟappuṭaiyatāy iruntaṉa.  maṇṇai viṭa ōlaiyai viṭa maram uṟuti vāyntatāyum maḻai veyyil kāṟṟu mutaliyavaikaḷai nīṇṭakālam tāṅkum cakti vāyntatāyum iruntatu.  atōṭu maṇṇai viṭa atika uṟutiyāṉa aḻakiya nuṇṇiya ciṟpa  vaṭivaṅkaḷai marattiṉāl ceyvatu eḷitāka iruntatu.  kallaip pōṉṟa karuṅkāli marattiṉāl ceyyappaṭṭa tiru uruvaṅkaḷum tēkkiṉāl ceyyap
paṭṭa tiru uruvaṅkaḷum  nīṇṭa nāḷ keṭātiruntu vantaṉa.  5000 ām āṇṭiṟku muṉ maṇṇil putaintuḷḷa intiya tēkku marattuṇṭu cumēriya nāṭṭil kaṇṭeṭukkappaṭṭu iṉṟum poṉṟātu iruntu varuvatu kaṇṭu ulakam viyappil āḻntuḷḷatu.  iṉṟaiyak kēraḷa nāṭṭil muṟkālattil marattāl kaṭṭap peṟṟa kōyilkaḷai eṅkum kāṇalām.  citamparattil uḷḷaāṭa vallāṉ capānātar maṇṭapam marattiṉālē ceyyappaṭṭatu.  iṉṟum appaṭiyē kāṭci aḷikkiṟatu.  citamparattilē uḷḷa ūrttuva
tāṇṭava mūrttiyiṉ kōyil ātiyilē marattiṉālē kaṭṭap peṟṟiruntatu.  appāl atu karuṅkallāl kaṭṭappaṭṭatu eṉṟālum ataṉ tūṇkaḷum, kūrai mutaliya amaippukaḷ marattiṉālē amaikkappaṭṭatāy iruppatu atu paḻaiya marakkōyil eṉpatai meyppippatāyk kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  citamparam āṭavallāṉ kōyiliṉ paḻaiya kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ aṉaittum ātiyil marattiṉālum amaikkap paṭṭiruntatu eṉpatil aṇuvaḷavum aiyam illai.  muṟkālattil eṅkum marakkōyilkaḷē nilaviṉa eṉpataṟku itu ēṟṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭākum.  piṟkālattil kōyilkaḷ karuṅkallil amaikkap paṭṭaṉa eṉṟālum, marattaic cetukki amaikkappaṭṭatu pōṉṟa amaippukaḷai kaṟkōyililē kāṇappaṭuvatu namatu karuttai araṇ ceyvatāka amaintuḷḷatu.  
marak kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ taṭpa veppa nilaiyiṉāl tākkuṇṭu viraivil paḻutuṇṭu aḻintu viṭum.  intat tākkutalāl mukkiyamāka marattiṉālāṉa mēṟkūraiyē peritum tāṅki aḻiyum.  ākavē marak kūrai eḷitil paḻutuṟāta vaṇṇam kūraiyiṉ mītu muṟkāla makkaḷ cemput takaṭukaḷai vēyntu vantaṉar. cemput takaṭu marattai viṭa nīṇṭa kālam maḻai veyyil kāṟṟu mutaliyavaikaḷait tāṅki paḻutuṟātu iruntu vantaṉa.
āṭa vallāṉ kōyilil mikap paḻamaiyāṉatu tiru nelvēliyil uḷḷa muṉitāṇṭava mūrttiyiṉ ampalamēyākum.  ittāṇṭava mūrtti paṭaipput toḻilaik kāṭṭum kāḷi kātāṇṭava mūrtti eṉṟum kūṟuvar.  intat tāṇṭava mūrtti āṭiya nirutta capai cempu ampalam allatu ceppaṟai eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  ātiyil makkaḷ poruḷātāra nilai kuṉṟiya kālattil eḻunta ampalamāka iruppatāl inta capai tūṇkaḷum, uttaraṅ
kaḷum, caṭṭaṅkaḷum, viṭṭaṅkaḷum, malkaikaḷum paṭṭiyalkaḷum marattiṉāl ceytu mēṟ kūrai marattiṉāl amaittu mēlē cemput takaṭṭai vēyntaṉar.  ataṉāl inta nirutta capai tāmpira capai eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭṭatu.
tamiḻnāṭṭil āṭavallāṉ āṭiya capaikaḷ aintu tōṉṟiyatu. (1) nellaiyil uḷḷa tāmpira capai, (2) maturaiyil uḷḷa iracita capai (veḷḷiyampalam) (3) tirukkuṟṟālattil uḷḷa cittira capai (4)tiruvālaṅkāṭṭil uḷḷa irattiṉa capai (5) tillaiyil uḷḷa poṉṉampalam eṉpar.  nellaiyai aṭuttu ellā ampalaṅkaḷum ātiyil marattiṉālē amaikkappaṭṭu appāl aracarkaḷāl kūraikaḷ veḷḷit takaṭukaḷum, poṉ takaṭukaḷum vēyappaṭṭaṉa.
ceṅkal kaṭṭiṭam
maraṅkaḷ oru cila āṇṭukaḷilum maḻaiyālum veyyilā lum kāṟṟālum paḻutaṭaivatai eṇṇiyum eḷitil tīppiṭittuk koḷvatai uṇarntum iṟaivaṉ uṟaiyum illam uṟuti uṭaiyatāy irukka vēṇṭum eṉpataik karuti ceṅkalliṉālum cuṇṇāmpiṉālum kōyilkaḷ kaṭṭat toṭaṅkiṉar.  ceṅkaṟ kōyilkaḷ maṇkōyilkaḷai viṭa, marak kōyilkaḷē neṭunāḷ uṟutiyāka iruntaṉa.  āṉālum ceṅkaṟ kōyilkaḷ taṭpa veppaṅkaḷai oru nūṟṟāṇṭiṟku mēl tāṅkak kūṭiyatāka illai.  ceṅkallāl kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷ muṉṉūṟu nāṉūṟu āṇṭukaḷukku mēl eṅkum nīṭittu niṟkavillai.  ki.pi.600-kku mēl tamiḻ nāṭṭil eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kōyilkaḷ aṉaittum ceṅkaṟkaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷēyākum.  avaikaḷ aṭikkaṭi paḻutu pārkka vēṇṭivaikaḷāka iruntaṉa.  paḻutu pārttu vantālum āṟu nūṟṟāṇṭiṟku mēl avaṟṟāl nilaittu niṟka muṭiya villai.  kallaip pōl cuṭumaṇ ceṅkalkaḷ taṭpa veppa nilaikaḷai etirttu niṟka muṭiyavillai.  kaṭaṟkaraikaḷil uḷḷa kōyil cuvariṉ uppuk kāṟṟiṉāl poṭippaṭiyāki utirntu viḻuntu kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷ cāyntuḷḷaṉa.
iṉṟu tiruccentūril uḷḷa murukaṉ kōyil eṉṟu kūṟappaṭuvatu ātiyil civaṉ kōyilāka iruntatu.  tiruccentūr cācaṉaṅkaḷ ikkōyilai uṭaiyavar (civaṉ) kōyil eṉṟē kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  civaṉ kōyilil irunta iliṅkattai oru puṟam (iṉṟaiya murukaṉ kōyil tiru uṇṇāḻikaikkup piṉpuṟam, otukki vaittu viṭṭu inta murukaṉ kōyilaip putitāy eḻuppiyuḷḷaṉar.  kaṭal arukē iruppatāl kaṭaliṉ uppuk kāṟṟāl paḻaiya kōyiliṉ kaṟkaḷ kūṭa uvar paṭṭu kal tūḷ tūḷāka utirntu tēyntu pōṉataik kāṇa muṭiyum.	
kōyil amaippum uṟuppum
namatu kaṭṭiṭak kalai iṉṟu, nēṟṟu ēṟpaṭṭa oru kalai alla.  aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ tōṉṟi paṭṭaṟivāl uṟutiyum uyarvum aḻakum, vacatiyum uḷḷatāy amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  namatu kōyil kaṭṭiṭak kalai ākamaṅkaḷai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭatu.  civākamaṅkaḷ irupatteṭṭu.   ivai muṟaiyē (1) kāmi (2) yōkacam (3) cintiyam (4) kāraṇam (5) acitam (6) tīpattam (7) cūkkumam (8) cattiram (9) añcumāṉ (10) cuppirapētakam (11) vicayam (12) vicuvācam (13) cuvāyam puvam (14) aṉalam (15) vīram (16) irauparam (17) makuṭam (18) vimalam (19) cantira ñāṉam (20) vimapam (21) purōṟ kītam (22) ilaḷitam (23) cittam (24) cantāṉa caruvōttam (25) pāramēccuram (26) kīraṇam (27) pētam (28) vātuḷam eṉappaṭum.
iḵtaṉṟi pañcarātrā ākamaṅkaḷum, cākta ākamaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.
namatu tirukkōyilkaḷ ākamaṅkaḷiṉ aṭippaṭaiyilē, amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  pūcai muṟaikaḷum, mantiraṅkaḷum, ākama vitippaṭiyē ceyyap peṟṟu varukiṉṟaṉa.  civa neṟikkum caivarkaḷukkum ākamamē muṭivāṉa caṭṭa nūl.  ataṟku muraṇāka etuvum naṭai peṟuvatu muṟai kēṭāṉatu.
uṟuppukaḷ
namatu civākamaṅkaḷum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷum kōyil kaṭṭuvataṟku nilam eppaṭi irukka vēṇṭum, eppaṭik kaṭṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu virivāka eṭuttuk kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  avaikaḷaip paṟṟi iṅku virivāka viḷakka innūl iṭantarātatāl curukkamāka āṉāl teḷivāka iṅku āyvōm.
kōyil kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷai ākamaṅkaḷ āṟu pirivākap pirikkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avai 1 atirṣṭāṉam 2 pātam 3 mañcam 4 kaṇṭam 5 paṇṭikai 6 tūpi eṉappaṭum.  ivaikaḷait tamiḻil, 1 aṭi, 2 uṭal 3 tōḷ 4 kaḻuttu 5 talai eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.
1. atirṣṭāṉam
itaṟku aṭi, nilam, talam, pūmi ātāram, macūkam pōṉṟa peyarkaḷ uṇṭu.
2. pātam
itaṟku uṭal, uṇṇāḻikai (aka nāḷikai) kāl, pātam, kampam tampam eṉṟa peyarkaḷ uṇṭu.  ippeyarkaḷ uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉaic cūḻntirukkum cuvarkaḷai kuṟikkiṉṟaṉa.
3. mañcam
itu tōḷ, taḷavaricai piratāram, kapōtam pōṉṟa peyarkaḷai uṭaiyatu.
4. kaṇṭam
itu kaḻuttu, karṇam, mutaliya peyarkaḷaip peṟṟuḷḷatu.
5. paṇṭikai
itu talai, kūrai, ciram, cikaram, paṇṭikai, matakam pōṉṟa peyarkaḷāl aḻaikkap peṟum. 
6. tūpi
itu muṭi, tūpi, kalacam(kalayam), cikai, cūḷam, ucci mutaliya peyarkaḷāl aḻaikkappaṭum.
tirukkōyil kaṭṭiṭattil irukkavēṇṭiya inta āṟu uṟuppukaḷum makkaḷ uṭalil kāṇappaṭum aṭi(pātam) uṭal, tōḷ, kaḻuttu, talai, muṭi (ucci) eṉṉum uṟuppukaḷai aṭippaṭaiyāka vaittē peyarkaḷ amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
maṉitaṉ, mēṟkē talai vaittu, kiḻakkē kāl nīṭṭi mallāntu paṭuttiruppataik kāṭṭuvatu namatu tirukkōyiliṉ tiru uṇṇāḻikai (mūlatāṉam) mutal vāyil kōpuram varaiyuḷḷa pakuti.  (paṭam 1 pārkka)  eṭṭuc cāṇ aḷavuḷḷa eḻil uṭampiṟkuc ciracē piratāṉam eṉpatu pōṉṟu namatu tirukkōyilkaḷukku tiru uṇṇāḻikai (karuvaṟai) mukam.  artta maṇṭapam kaḻuttu; tuvāra pālakarkaḷ (vāyiṟ kāvalarkaḷ niṟkum iṭaṅkaḷ makkaḷ uṭaliṉaik kāval puriyum iru tōḷkaḷ; koṭi maram (tuvajatampam) varaiyuḷḷa pakuti iṭuppiṟkum tōḷukkum iṭaiyēyuḷḷa uṭampākum; iṉi koṭi mara nilai kutāṉamākavum, koṭi maram mutukut taṇṭākavum, kuṭaivarai vāyiṟ kōpuram uyarntu niṟkum pātaṅkaḷ; eṉṟu civākamaṅkaḷ uruvakappaṭuttik kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉa.  uṭalai uṭampu aṉṉattai uṇṭu vaḷarntu nilai peṟṟiruppatāl aṉṉamaya kōcam aṉai uṭampu eṉappaṭum.  uṭal aimporuḷkaḷaik koṇṭu iyaṅkuvatāl tūla uṭampu eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.
civālayaṅkaḷ perumpālum kiḻakku nōkkiyē irukkum.  ataṟku, nāṉku ticaikaḷilum matil vāyilkaḷ iruppiṉum kōyil pukuntu vaḻipaṭac celpavar kiḻakku vāyil vaḻiyē celvatu muṟai.  kiḻakkiliruntu varupavaṉ mutalāvatu kāṇpatu paṭuttirup
pavaṉuṭaiya pātaṅkaḷēyām.  avaiyē paṭuttiruppavaṉ uṭampil kūṭutalāka uyarntirukkum uṟuppukaḷ.  ataṉāl muṉ kōpuraṅkaḷ kōvil caṟṟu uyaramākak kaṭṭappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  kōpurattai naṭuvil kaṭṭātu mukappil kaṭṭiyiruppatu intak karuttaik koṇṭēyākum.  mūlatāṉattiṟku mēl uḷḷa vimāṉam maṉitaṉuṭaiya pirammarantiram eṉṟa cakarārac cakkarattiṉ aṟikuṟiyāka irukkiṟatu.  accakkaram āyiram itaḻkaḷaiyuṭaiya iraṇṭaṭukkut tāmarai malar pōṉṟatu.  inta aṭippaṭaiyilē vimāṉaṅkaḷ amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  atika uyaramiṉṟi tāmarai malar vaṭivil periya kōyilkaḷ poṟṟa kaṭṭāl kūrai vēyappaṭṭu oḷi vīcuvatu, civaṉ muttaṉuṭaiya cakarāram pōṉṟu oḷi vīcum.  tirumūlar tamiḻakattiṉ talai ciṟanta cittar.  avar eḻutiya tirumantiram tamiḻ ākamam ākum.  atil uṭalil uyir vāḻvatum uyiriṉukkuyirāy uṭaiyavaṉ iruppataiyum uṇartta uṭampiṉ amaippil iṟai illam-tirukkōyil amaikkap peṟṟatu eṉṟu ulakiṟku uṇarttu kiṉṟār.
uṭampiṉai muṉṉam iḻukkeṉṟu iruntēṉ
uṭampiṉuk kuḷḷē uṟu poruḷ kaṇṭēṉ
uṭampuḷē uttamaṉ kōyil koṇṭāṉ eṉṟu
uṭampiṉai yāṉ iruntu ōmpukiṉṟēṉē - tirumantiram
uḷḷam peruṅkōyil ūṇ uṭampu ālayam
vaḷḷal pirāṉārkku vāykō puravācal
teḷḷat teḷintārkkuc civaṉ civaliṅkam
kaḷḷap pulaṉ aintum kāḷā maṇi viḷakkē 
						 - tirumantiram 1792
uṭampil uḷḷa uṟuppukaḷ oru aḷaviṟku uṭpaṭṭiruppatu pōl kōyilil uḷḷa uṟuppukaḷukkum aḷavukaḷ aḷikkap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  anta aḷavukaḷ namatu camayac cāṉṟōrkaḷāl mika uyariya tattuva muṟaippaṭi tērntu teḷintu tarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  avaikaḷ aṭiyil varumāṟākum;
1.  atirṣṭāṉam (aṭi) 	uyaram 1-paṅku
2.  pātam (uṭal)	uyaram 2 paṅku
3.  mañcam (tōḷ)	uyaram 1 paṅku
4.  kaṇṭam (kaḻuttu)	uyaram 1 paṅku
5.  paṇṭikai (talai)	uyaram 2 paṅku
6.  tūpi (muṭi)	uyaram 1 paṅku
inta aḷavukaḷ oru nilaiyai uṭaiya kōyilkaḷukku uriyaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi vēṟu aḷavaikaḷai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭu oru nilaik kōyil amaippatum uṇṭu.  cila ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil pala nilaikaḷaiyuṭaiya kōyilkaḷum palavita aḷavaikaḷum tarap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
amaippu
1.  iraṇṭu nilaik kōyilkaḷ piṉvarum amaippukaḷai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭu amaikkap peṟuvatākum 1) tarai 2) cuvar 3) taḷavaricai 4) cuvar 5) taḷavaricai 6) kaḻuttu 7) kūrai 8) kalayam
2. mūṉṟu nilaik kōyilkaḷ, aṭiyil varum amaippukaḷai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭu amaikkap peṟuvatākum: 1) tarai 2) cuvar 3) taḷavaricai 4) cuvar 5) taḷavaricai 6) cuvar 7) taḷavaricai 8) kaḻuttu 9) kūrai 10) kalacam.
iḵtaṉṟi iṉṉum pala amaippukaḷum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil eṭuttuk kāṭṭap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
kōyilkaḷ 1) cuttam 2) micuram 3) caṅkīraṇam eṉṟu mūṉṟu vakaiyāka kaṭṭap peṟukiṉṟaṉa.  1) cuttam muḻuvatum marattiṉālō ceṅkalliṉālō, kalliṉālō kaṭṭappaṭuvatu.  2) miciram, iraṇṭu poruḷkaḷaic cērttu kaṭṭappaṭuvatu.  3) iraṇṭiṟku mēṟpaṭṭa poruḷkaḷaic cērttuk kaṭṭappaṭuvatu  caṅkīraṇam
kōyil, vimāṉam 1) atirṣṭāṉam, 2) pātam, 3) mañcam, 4) kaṇṭam 5) paṇṭikai  6) tūpi eṉṟa āṟu uṟuppukaḷ iruppatu paṟṟi mēlē kūṟiyuḷḷōm.   inta āṟu uṟuppukaḷ ovvoṉṟum pala tuṇai uṟuppukaḷai uṭaiyatāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  avai aṭiyil varumāṟu;
1. atirṣṭāṉam (aṭi)
1) tuṇai uṟuppukaḷāvaṉa: 1) pirattāṉam 2) upāṉam 3) makāpatmam 4) palakai 5) atōpatmam 6) kumutam 7) kavōnta patmam 8) tukkōṭu 9) vētikai 10) kaṇṭap parappu 11) kaṇṭam 12) kaṇṭa vētikai 13) cekati
2. tampam (tiruuṇṇāḻikai)
1. vētikai 2. nāka pantam, 3. kāl, 4. kalacam, 5. kuṭam, 6. palakai - pōtikai (ivai tūṇiṉ uṟuppukaḷ)
3. piratāram (tōḷ)
1. uttiram 2. eḻutakam 3. kapōtakam 4. yāḷam eṉappaṭum.
4. kaṇṭam (kaḻuttu)
1. vētikai 2. kāl 3. pōtikai 4. paṇṭikai 5. kalacam itil pañcarak kūṭu maiyacālai, pañcaram karṇak kūṭu ākiyavaikaḷu muṇṭu.
5.  paṇṭikai (talai);
1. uttiram 2. eḻutakam 3. tūkkōṭu 4. mālait taṭṭu 5. patmam 6. mālaikkaṭṭu 7. iṭaikkaṭṭu 8. paṇṭikai 9. mālaikkaṭṭu 
10. kaṇṇāṭik kaṭṭam 11. mālaik kaṭṭu 12. makāpatmam eṉappaṭum.
6. tūpi (muṭi):
1. makāpatmam 2. makāpatram 3. kaṇṭam 4. araṭā 5. kaṇṭam 6. kaṇṭā 7. araṭā 8. alā 9. kirīvā 10. kāl mutaliya uṟuppukaḷai uṭaiyatu.
9. kaṇṭam 10. nakatalippū
kuṟippu:-  atirṣṭāṉattiṟku aṭiyil upapīṭam uḷḷatu.  atuvum kapōtam kāntam kumutam upāṉam pōṉṟa uṭpirivukaḷai uṭaiyatu.  muḻu niṟaivāṉa vimāṉattiṉ atirṣṭāṉam aintu varikaḷai (pañca varikaḷai)p peṟṟirukkum iṅku kuṟippiṭṭa vimāṉam
kōyil amaippu muṟai
tamiḻarkaḷiṉ kōyil amaippu muṟaikaḷ aṉaittum ākamaṅkaḷai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭē amaikkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  tamiḻil ākamaṅkaḷ iyaṟṟa vanta tirumūlar tām peṟṟa oṉpatu ākamaṅkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷaik kuṟippiṭum tarumattup pālil mutalāvatākak kāraṇam eṉṟa ākamattiṉ peyaraik kuṟippiṭu
kiṉṟār.  tirukkōyiliṉ amaippukaḷaip paṟṟi kāraṇam eṉṉum ākamam pala ariya viḷakkaṅkaḷai namakku aḷikkiṟatu.
iṭam
āṇṭavaṉ amarntu aruḷpuriyum illamāṉa kōyilkaḷ tūymaiyāṉa iṭattil irukka vēṇṭum.  nalla maṉaniṟaivu aḷikkum nilattil virivāṉa aṭippaṭaiyiṭṭuk kaṭṭa vēṇṭum.  puṉitamāṉa civālayaṅkaḷai eḻuppum iṭattiṉ kīḻ elumpukaḷ, nakaṅkaḷ, mayir mutaliya poruḷ irukkak kūṭātu.  tirukkōyilkaḷ eṭuppikkum iṭattiṉ kīḻē āḻamāka akaḻntu aruvaruppāṉa poruḷkaḷai akaṟṟiviṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu karcaṇaviti eṉṟa pakuti kūṟukiṟatu.
amaippu muṟai
tiruk kōyiliṉ mukkiyamāṉa pakuti tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyum (karppak kiruhamum) mēluḷḷa vimāṉamumēyākum.  tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyai mūlatāṉa eṉṟum moḻivārkaḷ.  itaṉuḷḷē mūlavarāṉa iṟaivaṉiṉ ciṉṉamāka iliṅkam amaikkap peṟṟatu.  uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ mēl amaikkappaṭṭa vimāṉattiṉ amaippaik koṇṭē kōyilkaḷiṉ vakaikaḷ pirikkappaṭṭaṉa.  tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyai mutalāvatāka vaittē artta maṇṭapam, makā maṇṭapam, kuḷippu maṇṭapam, alaṅkāra maṇṭapam, tirumaṇa maṇṭapam, vacanta maṇṭapam, nūṟṟeṭṭuk
kāl maṇṭapam, āyiraṅkāl maṇṭapam, āṭal maṇṭapam, nāṭaka maṇṭapam pōṉṟavaikaḷ amaikkappaṭṭaṉa.  appāl irāya kōpuraṅkaḷum valam varuvataṟkēṟṟa cuṟṟup pirakāraṅkaḷ oṉṟu iraṇṭu mūṉṟu ēḻu eṉṟu virivaṭaintum tirukkōyilkaḷiṉ tōṟṟam viriṭaintu vantatu.
mūvakai amaippu
tiruk kōyilkaḷukku uyir pōṉṟatu iliṅka vaṭivam iṭam peṟṟirukkum tiru uṇṇāḻikai.  inta uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ tōṟṟa amaippai ākamaṅkaḷ mūṉṟu  vakaiyākak kaṇṭuḷḷaṉa. atāvatu 1. tirāviṭam, 2. nākaram 3. vēcaram eṉappaṭum.
kāraṇam eṉṟum ākamam, tirāviṭam nākaram, vēcaram eṉa mūṉṟu kōyilkaḷ uṇṭu eṉṟu uraikkiṟatu.  1. nilattiṉ maṭṭattiliruntu tūpi varai nāṉku paṭṭamuḷḷa caturak kōyil nākaram eṉappaṭum.  2. vēti (mēṭai) yiliruntu eṇ kōṇa vaṭivamāka amaikkappaṭum kōyilukku tirāviṭam eṉappaṭum.  karṇa kūṭattiliruntu vaṭṭavaṭivamāka amaikkappaṭum kōyilukku vēcaram eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  caturam, eṇkōṇam, vaṭṭam ākiya mūvakait tōṟṟamuḷḷa kōyilkaḷ kūṟap paṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  inta mūvakait tōṟṟaṅkaḷaiyum muṟaiyē kōyiliṉ aṭittalat
tiṉiṉṟu cikaram varaik kāṇa vēṇṭum.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil pūmi maṭṭattiliruntu cikaram varai nāṉku mūlai paṭṭaiyuḷḷa nākaram eṉṟa kōyil amaippu muṟaiyaip peritum kāṇalām  vimāṉattil uḷḷa karṇa kūṭattiṟku mēl cikaram muṭiya vaṭṭa vaṭivamuḷḷa vēcam eṉṟa kōyil amaippaiyum eḷitākak kāṇalām.  mēṭaikku mēl eṇ kōṇa vaṭivamāka vimāṉa ucci varai amaintuḷḷa tirāviṭam eṉṟa kōyil amaippaik kāṇpatu mika aritu.

aka nāḻikai (karppak kirakam)
aka nāḻikai (karppak kirakam),  tirukkōyiliṉ iṉṟiyamai yāta pakuti.  muṟkālat tamiḻ makkaḷ aka nāḻikaiyaittāṉ kōyil eṉṟu aḻaittaṉar.  inta akanāḻikaiyai mūlattāṉam (mūlatāṉam) eṉṟum kūṟuvar.  iṅkutāṉ mūlavar iruppar.  atāvatu civaliṅkam irukkum.  ovvoru kōyilukkum uyar nilaiyāy iruppatu mūlatāṉa mūrttiyākiya aka nāḻikait tiru uruvam vāyil kōpuram pātamākavum aka nāḻikaiyaic ciracākavum matikkappaṭum.
aka nāḻikai, uṇṇāḻikai, karuvaṟai, (karppak kirukam) tiruvaṟai, puṉita uṟaiyuḷ, puṉita iṭam, teyvamaṉai vaḻipāṭṭiṭam eṉṟellām tamiḻar aḻaippar. vaṭa moḻiyāḷar karpakkirakam eṉṟu kūṟuvar.  āṅkilattil, cāṅṭam cāṅṭam (sanctum sanctum)  eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭum
tirukkōyiliṉ uṟuppukaḷai makāṅkam, aṅkam, upāṅkam pirattiyāṅkam eṉṟum nāṉku vakaiyākap pirikkappaṭum.  akanāḻikai makāṅkam eṉṟum artta maṇṭapam aṅka meṉṟum, makāmaṇṭapam mutalāṉavai upāṅkam eṉṟum pirakāraṅkaḷ pirattiyāṅkam eṉavum potuvāṉa aṅkam collappaṭukiṟatu.
aka nāḻikai (karppak kirakam) talaiyākavum, antarāḷam mukamākavum kaṇṭamākavum artta maṇṭapam mārpākavum, makā maṇṭapam vayirākavum pirakāraṅkaḷ muḻaṅkāl kaṇukkālākavum kōpurattuvāram pātamākavum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil kūṟappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.1
uṇṇāḻikai (aka nāḻikai) yiṉ - karuvaṟaiyiṉ vimāṉattai  tūlaliṅkam eṉṟum ataṉ uḷḷirukkum tiru uru cūṭcama liṅkam eṉṟum kūṟappaṭum.  vicuvakarmīyam eṉṟa ciṟpa nūl, vimāṉattai civaṉuru eṉṟum civaṉ uṭal eṉṟum civa perumāṉiṉ niṉṟa kōlattiṟku viḷakkam tarukiṟatu.  uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ mēluḷḷa eḻilārnta vaṭivattiṉ vēlaip pāṭukaḷum uṟuppukaḷum aṭukkukaḷum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil ciṟappittup pārāṭṭappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.  avaṟṟai aṭiyiliruntu 
1. upāṉam. 2. cekati 3. kumutam 4. kantaram 5. paṭṭikai 6. vētikai 7. tūṇ (tampam) 8. uttaram 9. kapōtam, 10. pirataram 11. hati vētikai 12. kirīvam 13. mañcam 14. makā nāci 15. pār cuva nāci 16. cantira maṇṭalam 17. pālikai 18. patmam 19. makā patmam 20. tūpi (cikaram) varai 20- uṟuppukaḷ āka vakuttu kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  ivaṟṟai civa vaṭivattiṉ pātam, keṇṭaik kāl, muḻaṅkāl toṭai, arai(mēṭram), nāpi, utaram, mārpu, tōḷ, puṣṭitam, kaḻuttu, rēkai, utaṭu, mūkku, kātu, kaṇ, neṟṟi, talai, ciracu, cikai mutaliya uṟuppukaḷākap pāvikkap peṟukiṉṟatu.
iḵtaṉṟi, uṇṇāḻikaiyaiyum (karuvaṟaiyaiyum) vimāṉattaiyum peṇ vaṭivam eṉṟum, ataṉ uḷḷirukkum tiru uruvai, utarattiluḷḷa karppam eṉṟum viḷakkam tarappaṭukiṟatu.  utarattil karppamākiya mūrtti amaikkap peṟṟiruppatālēyē uṇṇāḻikaik kaṭṭiṭattai karppak kirakam (karuvaṟai) eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭukiṟatu.  ikkaruttiṉai uḷattil koṇṭu mūla mūrtti vīṟṟirukkum kaṭṭiṭattaic ciṟpa nūl vallunarkaḷ kukkuṭāṇṭam- kōḻi muṭṭai vaṭivamākavum amaikkalām eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.  ittakaiya, kukkuṭāṇṭa vaṭivattil kōyilkaḷ amaippatum uṇṭu.  
civaperumāṉiṉ niṉṟa kōlattaiyum naṉṟākat tīṭṭappaṭṭa tiru uruvattai oru niṟaivāka uruvākkappeṟṟa vimāṉattaiyum arukarukē vaittu oppunōkkiṉāl uṇmai pulaṉākum.
makkaḷ uṭampiṉ uṟuppukaḷai aṅkam (uṟuppu), makāṅkam, upāṅkam, pirattiyāṅkam eṉṟu pirittuḷḷatu pōl iṟaivaṉiṉ tiru vaṭivamākak kaṟpikkap peṟṟa vimāṉattiṉ atirṣṭāṉam  (Basement) eṉṟa uṟuppai makāṅkam eṉṟum tampam allatu cuvarppakutiyai (Superstructure) aṅkam eṉṟum, piratārattai (Entablature) upāṅkam eṉṟum cikarattai (Doom or roof) pirattiyāṅkam eṉṟum ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil kūṟukiṉṟaṉa kōyil eṉṟu kūṟappaṭuvatu kuṟippāka - ēṉ? ciṟappāka uṇṇāḻikaiyaiyum ataṉmītuḷḷa vimāṉattaiyumē kuṟippiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.1
vimāṉam
vimāṉam eṉṟāl akanāḻikai mītuḷḷa tūpi eṉṟu akarātikaḷil poruḷ kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil vimāṉam eṉpataṟku, naṉṟāka aḷakkappaṭṭatu eṉṟu viḷakkantarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  vimāṉaṅkaḷaip paṟṟi atikāra pūrvamāka viḷakkan
tarum nūṟkaḷ ākamaṅkaḷ ākum.  tamiḻ ākamamākap pōṟṟap peṟum nūl tiru mantiram ākum.  atil
tūya vimāṉamum tūlama tākum - 1689eṉṟu kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  itaṟku viḷakkam, aka nāḻikai mītu amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷa mēṉ mūṭi- ucciyākiya vimāṉam tūymaiyum parumaiyum vāynta civak kuṟiyākum.  (civak kuṟi - civaliṅkam) vimāṉattiṉ kīḻ akattē aka nāḻikaiyil (karuvaṟaiyil) viḷaṅkum aruḷōṉ ākiya catācivaṉ nuṇṇiya civak kuṟiyāvaṉ eṉṟu kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.
potuvāka vimāṉam eṉpatu uyarnta māṭi eṉṟu poruḷ tantālum, ciṟappāka tirukkōyilil karuvaṟaiyiṉ mītuḷḷa uyarnta amaippaiyē kuṟippiṭukiṟatu eṉpatai evarum maṟukkār.  māṭam, eṉpatu māḷikaikaḷiṉ mītuḷḷa māṭikaḷaik kuṟippiṭum patamākum.  eṉṟālum tirukkōyilil uḷḷa uyarnta amaippukaḷē māṭam eṉṟu ciṟappākak kūṟappaṭukiṟatu.  kōyilkaḷiṉ vakaikaḷaik kuṟippiṭum poḻutu māṭak kōyil eṉṟē kuṟippiṭappaṭukiṟatu.  māṭam, upparikai, uparikai eṉṟum kūṟap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.
irukkilaṅku tiru moḻivāy eṇṭōḻīcaṟku
eḻil māṭam eḻupatucey tulaka māṇṭa
tirukkulattu vaḷac cōḻaṉ
eṉṟu cōḻaṉ ceṅkaṇāṉ civaperumāṉukkum, tirumālukkum āka eḻupatukku mēṟpaṭṭa vimāṉaṅkaḷai kaṭṭiṉāṉ eṉṟu tirumaṅkaiyāḻvār kūṟukiṉṟār.  mēlum avar,
tiru naṟaiyūr maṇi māṭam cērmiṉkaḷē 
eṉṟum kūṟukiṉṟār.
eṉṟālum, karuvaṟaiyiṉ mītuḷḷa uyarnta kaṭṭiṭa amaippiṟku vimāṉam eṉṟa peyarē poruttamāṉatākum.  māṭam eṉpatu vīṭu, māḷikai, araṇmaṉai pōṉṟavaikaḷiṉ uparikkaikaḷaik kuṟippiṭuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttik koḷvatu cālap poruttamāṉatākum.  karuvaṟaiyiṉ mītuḷḷa mēl aṭukkukaḷai, caiva camaya nāyaṉmārkaḷ pala iṭaṅkaḷil vimāṉam eṉṟē kuṟippiṭukiṉṟārkaḷ.

eṉṟu campantap piḷḷaiyār tam tēvārap patikattil kuṟippiṭuvatu cintikkattakkatu.
vimāṉam
vimāṉam eṉṟāl naṉṟāka aḷakkappaṭṭatu eṉpatu poruḷākum.  kōyilkaḷil tiru uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉuḷ tiru uruvam iṭam peṟṟirukkum.  ataṉ mītu uyaramāka vimāṉam amaikkappaṭum.  ayal ūrkaḷiliruntu varum makkaḷ tolaivil varum poḻutē vimāṉattaik kaṇṭatum iṟaivaṉ tirumuṭiyaik kaṇṭatāka eṇṇi vaḻipaṭuvar.  muṟkālattil kōyiliṉ uyarnta pakutiyāka vimāṉam irukkum.  vāyil kōpuraṅkaḷ uyaramāka amaippatillai.  kōpurattaik kaṇṭu iṟaivaṉ tiru muṭiyāka eṇṇi vaḻipaṭuvatu tamiḻar marapaṉṟu.  atu muṟaiyum aṉṟu.   vimāṉam oru nilaiyiṉiṉṟu patiṉāṉ nilai varai tamiḻ nāṭṭil iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟappaṭum.  tamiḻnāṭṭil araṇmaṉaikaḷum ēḻu nilaikaḷai uṭaiyatāy iruntaṉa eṉṟu caṅka nūlkaḷ cāṉṟu tarukiṉṟaṉa.  piṟkālattil tamiḻakattil eḻunta vimāṉaṅ kaḷil taṭcaṇāmūrtti, iliṅkōṟpa mūrtti, kāḷi tirumāl mutaliyavarkaḷiṉ tiru uruvaṅkaḷ iṭam peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.
civa perumāṉukku tirāviṭa muṟaiyilum, umātēvikku nākara muṟaiyilum, murukaṉukku tirāviṭa muṟaiyilum, piḷḷaiyārkku vēcara muṟaiyilum piṟkālattil kaṭṭappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu cila ciṟpa nūl vallunarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.  itu vaṭa moḻiyil uḷḷa ciṟpap pirivukaḷai aṭippaṭaiyākak koṇṭu eḻuntaṉa eṉṟu eṇṇappaṭukiṟatu.  tamiḻ nāṭṭil vēṟu cila ciṟpap pirivukaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  catura vaṭivilāṉa tiru uṇṇāḻikai, nīṇṭa catura vaṭivilāṉa tiru uṇṇāḻikai vaṭṭa vaṭivilāṉa tiru uṇṇāḻikai arai vaṭṭavaṭivilāṉa tiruuṇṇāḻikai pōṉṟa palvēṟu amaippuḷḷa tiru uṇṇāḻikaikaḷ kūṟappaṭṭālum eṅkum caturat tiru uṇṇāḻikaikaḷ tāṉ kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  āṉāl toṇṭai nāṭṭil arai vaṭṭattiru uṇṇāḻikaikaḷ mikutiyāka uḷḷaṉa.  tiru niṉṟa ūr, paṉaṅkāṭṭūr, maḻīcai, māṭam pākkam mutalāṉa iṭaṅkaḷiluḷḷa kōyilkaḷiṉ vimāṉaṅkaḷ arai vaṭṭak karuvaṟaikaḷaik koṇṭatākum.  karuvaṟaikaḷukku mēl  vimāṉam caturam, nellik kaṉi, vaṭṭam mutaliya uruvaṅkaḷil uḷḷaṉa.  arai vaṭṭak karuvaṟaiyiṉ mītu yāṉai mutukum pōl ceyyap
paṭṭirukkum.  tiruniṉṟaūr mutaliya kōyilkaḷil kāṇappaṭuvatu itu pōṉṟatēyākum.  tiruttaṇi nantiyāṟṟaṅ karaiyil yāṉai mutukum araivaṭṭa mukamum uṭaiya vimāṉam uṇṭu.  perumāḷ kōyilkaḷil mūṉṟu aṭukkuḷḷa aṣṭāṅka vimāṉam uṇṭu.  kāñci vaikuṇṭa nātar kōyililum tiruk kōṭṭiyūrk kōyililum inta aṣṭāṅka vimāṉam kāṭci aḷikkiṟatu.  tiru atikaiyil karppakirakattiṉ mītu eḻuppap peṟṟirukkum vimāṉattai tiripurat takaṉattērākak kaṭṭiya ciṟpikaḷiṉ tiṟamai pōṟṟattakkatu.
viruppoṭumāl vaḻipāṭu ceyya viḻi
vimāṉañ cēr miḻalai yāmē
eṉṟa tēvārap pāṭal vimāṉattiṉ ēṟṟattaik kuṟikkiṉṟatu.  karuvaṟaikaḷiṉ mēl. uḷḷē irukkum teyva uruvaṅkaḷukku makuṭam cūṭṭiṉāṟ pōṉṟu uyarnta oṟṟaik kōpuraṅkaḷ amaikkum vaḻakkam tamiḻakattil iruntatu eṉṟu kūṟap paṭuvataṟkuc cāṉṟāka iṉṟu tañcāvūril irācarācaṉ kaṭṭiya tirukkōyilum, kaṅkai koṇṭa cōḻapurattil irā cēntiraṉ kaṭṭiya kōyilum ciṟanta eṭuttuk kāṭṭāy ilaṅkukiṟatu.
ciṟpa nūṟkaḷil vimāṉaṅkaḷ amaippataip paṟṟi virivāṉa viḷakkam tarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  vimāṉattiṉ vakaikaḷ, peyarkaḷ,  uruvaṅkaḷ māṭikaḷ, vāyilkaḷ palakaṇikaḷ akalam, nīḷam, uyaram mutaliyaṉa aṉaittum teḷivākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  avai aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
1. mēru:   aṟu kōṇa uruvattil paṉṉiraṇṭu māṭikaḷai yuṭaiyatāy nāṉku vāyilkaḷum paṉṉiṟap palakaṇikaḷum pāṅkuṟa amaikkap peṟṟatāy irukkum itu muppattiraṇṭu muḻa akalam uṭaiyatu.
2. mantāram:   itu muppatu muḻam akalam uṭaiyatu.  pattu māṭikaḷum cikaraṅkaḷum uṭaiyatu.
3.  kailācam: itu eṭṭu māṭaṅkaḷaiyum 28 muḻam akalamum uṭaiyatu.
4.  vimāṉam:   itu irupattoru muḻam akalamum kirātikaḷaiyum pala kaṇikaḷaiyum 10 māṭikaḷaiyum uṭaiyatu.
5.  nantaṉam: itu āṟu māṭaṅkaḷaiyum patiṉāṟu kapālaṅ kaḷaiyum uṭaiyatu.  32 muḻam akalam uṭaiyatu.
6.  camukkam: itu vaṭṭamāṉa peṭṭi vaṭivil irukkum.
7.  patmam: itu tāmarai vaṭivil eṭṭu muḻa uyaramāṉa oru tūpiyaiyum oru māṭattaiyum uṭaiyatu.
8-9.  karuṭaṉ, nataṉam: ivai cūriyak kaḻuku pōṉṟa amaippil 24 muḻa akalamum ēḻu māṭaṅkaḷaiyum uṭaiyatu.  itil irupatu kapālaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa. 
10.  varttaṉā:   ..........................................................
11.  kuñcaram:  itu yāṉaiyiṉ mutuku pōṉṟatāka irukkum 16 muḻa nīḷam uṭaiyatāy aṭi akaṉṟatāyum irukkum.
12.  kuka rājaṉ:  ituvum kuñcaram pōṉṟu 16 aṭi muḻam akalamum atē pōṉṟa mēṟ kūṟaiyum mūṉṟu ceṅkuttāka untik koṇṭirukkum pala kaṇiyum peṟṟirukkum.
13.  iṭapam:  itu kāḷai  māṭṭiṉ vaṭivil oru māṭamum oru tūpiyum vaṭṭa vaṭivil 12 muḻa akalam uḷḷatu.
14.  amcam:  aṉṉap paṟavaiyiṉ vaṭivil aḻakāka amaintirukka vēṇṭum.
15.  kaṭam:  itu kuṭattiṉ vaṭivattiṉaip peṟṟirukkum 
8 - muḻa akalam irukkum.
16.  carvatōpattiram:  itu nāṉku vāyilkaḷai uṭaiyatu.  pala, ceṅkuttāka untik koṇṭirukkum palakaṇikaḷaiyum uṭaiyatu.  aintu māṭaṅkaḷ amaintatu 25 muḻam akalam vāyntatu.
17.  ciṉha:  itu ciṅkattiṉ tōṟṟam vāynta paṉṉiraṇṭu paṭṭaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiyatu.  25 muḻam akalam uṭaiyatu.
18-20. eñci niṟkum  rōṭṭuṇṭa, caturppuyam  eṇṭōḷ ākiya mūṉṟu māṭaṅkaḷum patiṉāṟupaṭṭaikaḷaiyumuṭaiyaṉa.  caturppuyam aintu kapōlaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiyatu maṟṟavai orē kapōlattai uṭaiyaṉa.
cintu veḷi akaḻ āyviṟ kaṇṭa kaṭṭiṭaṅkaḷiṉ mūlam 5000 - āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tirāviṭarkaḷ kaṭṭiṭak kalai amaippil vallunarāy viḷaṅkiṉar eṉpatu naṉku peṟappaṭum.  tamiḻarkaḷukku cintu veḷi makkaḷiṉ pārampariyattuvam uṇṭu eṉṟu car. cāṇ mārcal, cōviyō tuprayal hirā aṭikaḷ pōṉṟa pēraṟiñarkaḷ uṟutippaṭuttiyuḷḷaṉar.  kiṟittuva ūḻi arumpuvataṟku muṉpē tamiḻ nāṭṭil periya kōyilkaḷum, aḻakiya araṇmaṉaikaḷum, māperum māḷikaikaḷum, aḷappariya malaiyeṉṉa uyarnta māperum araṇkaḷum iruntaṉa.  viṇmuṭṭum eḻunilai māṭaṅkaḷum mukil tavaḻum nāṉ māṭak kūṭaṅkaḷum, pattukku mēṟpaṭṭa pala aṭukkukaḷai vimāṉak kōyilkaḷum, poṟ kōṭṭaikaḷum, kaṟkōṭṭaikaḷum, cempuk kōṭṭaikaḷum iruntaṉa eṉṟu namatu ilakkiyaṅkaḷum, ciṟpa nūlkaḷum, purāṇak kataikaḷum cāṉṟu tarukiṉṟaṉa.  āriyarkaḷ aiyāyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ aḻitta arappāviṉ aṉṟu uyarntu niṉṟu vīḻnta araṇai iṉṟu pākkitāṉ akaḻ āyvuttuṟai iyakkunarkaḷiṉ taḷapati car. kh®£ok® cÆy® mfœªJ f©L gl« ão¤J¡ fh£o., itu tāṉ āriyarkaḷ teyvamākiya intiraṉ aḷittatāka irukku vētam kūṟum āriyar allātāriṉ (tirāviṭarkaḷiṉ) kōṭṭai eṉṟu ulakiṟku eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.
kiṟittuva ūḻi arumpumuṉ tirāviṭa makkaḷ tamiḻakattil kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷum, kōpuraṅkaḷum, kōṭṭaikaḷum, māḷikai kaḷum, maṇṭapaṅkaḷum, ceṅkallālum, maṇṇālum kaṭṭap paṭṭatāl iyaṟkaiyiṉ cīṟṟattālum, pakaivarkaḷiṉ tākkutal kaḷiṉālum aḻikkappaṭṭu viṭṭaṉa.  iṉṟu namakku cāṉṟu kāṭṭa muṭiyavillai.  āṉāl ilakkiyac cāṉṟukaḷ pala uṇṭu.
iṅku nām ciṟappākac cintikkak kūṭiya ceytikaḷ cila uḷa.  puttar kālattiṟkup piṉṉarē vaṭa nāṭṭilum naṭu nāṭṭilum kōyilkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  akkōyilkaḷil kōpuraṅkaḷō, vimāṉaṅkaḷō amaikkap peṟavillai.  kuptarkaḷiṉ iṟutik kālattilē tāṉ vimāṉaṅkaḷ tōṉṟiṉa.  ki.mu. 1000-āṇṭiṟku muṉ naṭaipeṟṟatākak kūṟappaṭum irāma kātaiyil, irāmaṉ pāṇṭiya nāṭṭiṉ talainakarāṉa kapāṭapurattil uḷḷa pāṇṭiyaṉ talainakaraiyum, araṇaiyum ataṉ poṉṉālāṉa kōṭṭai vāyiṟ katavukaḷaiyum paṟṟik kūṟuvatu vāṉmīki irāmāyaṇattil kūṟap peṟṟuḷḷatu. atil irāvaṇaṉiṉ vāṉaḷāviya araṇ
kaḷaiyum, māperum aḻakiya māḷikai kaḷaiyum paṟṟi virivāṉa viḷakkam tarap peṟṟuḷḷatu.  ki.pi. iraṇṭām, mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭiṟku muṟpaṭṭa tamiḻ nūṟkaḷāṉavai tamiḻ nāṭṭil māḷikaikaḷum, māṭaṅkaḷum, kōyilkaḷum kōpuraṅkaḷum, vimāṉaṅkaḷum iruntaṉa eṉpataṟkuc cāṉṟu tarukiṉṟaṉa.  ki.pi. iraṇṭām mūṉṟām nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷil tamiḻakattil ceṅkaṟ
kaḷālum, cutaic cāntālum kaṭṭap peṟṟa kōyilkaḷ, kōpuraṅkaḷ, vimāṉaṅkaḷiruntavaiyāyiṉ ki.mu. nālām, aintām nūṟṟāṇṭil irunta vaṭa nāṭṭiṉar vimāṉaṅkaḷ amaikkum muṟaiyait tamiḻarkaḷiṭamiruntu aṟintu koṇṭiruntaṉar eṉṟu eṇṇuvatil tavaṟillai eṉka.
tamiḻ nāṭṭil vimāṉaṅkaḷ.
pallava maṉṉaṉ mutalām naracimmavarmaṉ (ki.pi 630-660)  māmallapurattil oṟṟaik kallil camaitta mātirik kōyilkaḷē tamiḻ nāṭṭil vimāṉaṅkaḷuṭaṉ mutaṉ mutalāka amaitta kaṟkōyil eṉpatu ciṟpa vallunarkaḷ karuttu.  intak kōyil
kaḷai muṉ mātiriyākak koṇṭē tamiḻakattil kōyilkaḷ, vimāṉaṅkaḷuṭaṉ amaikkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu cilar karutukiṉṟaṉar.  ikkaruttu nām muṉṉar, eṭuttukkāṭṭiya pattuppāṭṭu, cilappatikāram, maṇimēkalai, perumpāṇāṟṟup paṭai, neṭunal vāṭai mutaliya nūṟkaḷil uḷḷa naṟcāṉṟukku māṟāṉatākum.  iḵtaṉṟi ki.pi.6-ām nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ toṭakkattil vāḻnta appar aṭikaḷum, tiruñāṉa campantap piḷḷaiyārum,  avarkaḷ kālattiṟku muṟpaṭṭa citamparam, cīrkāḻi, peṇṇāṭakam, maturai, tirunelvēli, vaikal, tiruppātirip puliyūr mutaliya ūrkaḷil uḷḷa peruṅkōyil, karakkōyil, ñāḻaṟ kōyil, kokuṭik kōyil, tūṅkāṉai māṭak kōyil, iḷaṅkōyil, maṇik kōyil, māṭak kōyil pōṉṟa kōyilkaḷukkuc ceṉṟu aṅkuḷḷa teyvaṅkaḷai vaḻipaṭṭatu uḷḷaṅkai nellik kaṉi pōl naṉkaṟiyappaṭukiṉṟatu.  ki.pi. nāṉkām nūṟṟāṇṭilirunta kōcceṅkaṇṇāṉ eṉṉum cōḻa vēntaṉ eḻupatu māṭak kōyilkaḷaik kaṭṭiyatai campantarum, tirumaṅkaiyāḻvārum pāṭiya pākkaḷ maṟukkaṟpālataṉṟām.
makēntara varmaṉum, paramēcuvaravarmaṉum, ivarkaḷukkup 
piṉ vanta maṉṉarkaḷum, māmallapurattilum, kāñcipurattilum kaṭṭiya kōyilkaḷum, kōpuraṅkaḷum, vimāṉaṅkaḷum paṇṭaiyat tamiḻarkaḷ kaṇṭa vaḻiyil eṭuppitta kōyilkaḷ eṉpatil eḷḷaḷavum aiyamillai.1  kōyilkaḷ kōpuraṅkaḷ vimāṉaṅkaḷ amaikkum vaḻakkut tamiḻ nāṭṭil kiṟittava ūḻi eḻuvataṟku muṉpē iruntatākum.  pallavarkaḷ tamiḻar neṟiyākiya civaneṟiyait taḻuviya piṉ tamiḻar vaḻakkiṉaiyoṭṭi karuṅkaṟ kōyilkaḷait tamiḻakattil amaikkat toṭaṅkiṉar.  avarkaḷukku tamiḻar kaṇṭa ākamaṅkaḷum, ciṟpanūṟkaḷum 
tamiḻ nāṭṭuc ciṟpikaḷiṉ paṭṭaṟivum vaḻi kāṭṭiyāka iruntaṉa.  tamiḻarkaḷ caṅka kālattil ceṅkaṟkaḷālum, cāntiṉālum amaitta atika kōyilkaḷ appāl karuṅkaṟ kōpuramāka kōyilāka vimāṉamākap pariṇamittaṉa eṉṟu namatu kaṭṭiṭak kalai varalāṟu kūṟukiṉṟatu.  ikkālattilum pala vaṇṇaṅkaḷ tīṭṭap peṟṟa cutai uruvaṅkaḷaiyuṭaiya kōpuraṅkaḷum vimāṉaṅkaḷum tamiḻ nāṭṭil tāṉ uṇṭu.  kōpuraṅ
kaḷai māṭaṅkaḷaip pōl aṭukkaṭukkāy aḻakupeṟa, aṇitikaḻa, oḷiyuṟa amaikkum vaḻakku tirāviṭarkaḷ kaik koṇṭa uyariya muṟaiyākum.1  itaṉai perkūcaṉ, cōviyō
tuprayal, ṭellākiremariṣ pōṉṟa mēṉāṭṭuk kaṭṭiṭak kalai vallunarkaḷ naṉku eṭuttuk kāṭṭukiṉṟaṉar.
tirukkōyilil ciṟappāṉa pakuti aka nāḻikai (uṇṇāḻikai)  eṉṟu kūṟum karuvaṟaiyum ataṉ mēl eḻuppap peṟṟa vimāṉamum ākum.  tirumatilil uṭpuṟam cellum vāyiliṉ mēl eḻuppappeṟṟa mēl taḷam kōpuram eṉappaṭum.  itaṉ poruḷ yātā yiruppiṉum karuvaṟaiyiṉ mītu eḻuppap peṟṟa vimāṉattai uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ uḷḷē urup peṟṟirukkum teyva uruviṉ maṇi muṭiyāka eṇṇi makkaḷ tolaivil varum poḻutē vimāṉattaik kaṇṭatum iṟaivaṉ tiru uruvaik kaṇṭāṟ pōṉṟu paktiyuṭaṉ kaikuvittu vaḻipaṭuvar.  vāyiṟ kōpurattaik kaṇṭu evarum vaḻipaṭuvatillai.  atu ākama vitiyum illai tamiḻar marapum aṉṟu.
āṉāl cilar vimāṉattaik, kōpuram eṉṟum kōpurattai vimāṉam eṉṟum kūṟi iṭarppaṭukiṉṟaṉar.  atu camaya aṟivilār kūṟṟu eṉṟu kūṟiviṭalām.   āṉāl namatu nāṭṭut tirukkōyilkaḷai ciṟpa nūṟkaḷiṉ vitippaṭiyum civākama muṟaikku māṟupāṭiṉṟiyum amaittuttarum tapatikaḷ tam nūṟkaḷil vimāṉattaik kōpuram eṉṟu kūṟuvatōṭu kōpurak kaṭṭiṭa amaippum ataṉ peyarum eṉṟa talaippiṉ kīḻ 
oru tapati I- vaṭṭamāy irukkum kōpuraṅkaḷukku virutta vimāṉam  II-  caturamāy irukkum kōpuraṅkaḷukku catura vimāṉam eṉṟum kūṟi vimāṉaṅkaḷukku viḷakkam tantu koṇṭu pōkiṟār.  itu ciṟpa nūṟpayiṟci illāta potu makkaḷukkuk kuḻappantaruvatāy irukkiṟatu.  ittavaṟukaḷ tiruttap peṟa vēṇṭum.  
vimāṉak kaṭṭiṭa aḷavum peyarum.
1.  ēkapūma vimāṉam:
akalam irukkum aḷavu uyaram vaittuk kaṭṭiya vimāṉat tiṟku ēka taḷa vimāṉam allatu ēkapūma vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
2.  cāntīka vimāṉam:
akalam ēḻu paṅku ceytu uyaram pattup paṅku ceytuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa vimāṉam cāntīka vimāṉam eṉṟu aḻaikkappaṭum.
3.  pavuṣṭīka vimāṉam:
akalam oru paṅku uyaram 1 1/2  paṅku vaittuk kaṭṭiya vimāṉattiṟku pavuṣṭīka vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
4.  ceyṅkaḷa vimāṉam:
akalam oru paṅku uyaram 1 3/4 paṅku vaittuk kaṭṭappaṭṭa vimāṉattiṟku ceyṅkaḷa vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
5.  aṟputa vimāṉam:
akalam oru paṅku uyaram iraṇṭu paṅku vaittuk kaṭṭiya vimāṉattukku aṟputa vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.  eṉṟu ālaya vikkiraka nirmāṇa āyāti ciṟpa irakaciyam eṉṟa nūl aintu vita vimāṉaṅkaḷukku aḷavu tarukiṟatu.  itaṉ mūlam namatu muṉṉōrkaḷ kaṇṭa vimāṉaṅkaḷiṉ vakaikaḷum ataṉ aḷavukaḷum naṉku pulaṉākiṉṟaṉa.
vimāṉa amaippum ataṉ peyarum
ēka taḷa vimāṉam allatu vimāṉattiṉ mēl nilai kaḻuttaṭiyil iruntu paṇṭi makāpatmam varaiyil uḷḷatākum.
1.  virutta vimāṉam.
vaṭṭamāka irukkum vimāṉattiṟku virutta vimāṉam eṉṟu peyar.
2.  catura vimāṉam:
catura vaṭivil amaikkappaṭum vimāṉam catura vimāṉam eṉṟu cāṟṟappaṭum.
3.  caṭ kōṇa vimāṉam:
āṟu paṭṭaiyāy irukkum vimāṉam ṣaṭkōṇa vimāṉam eṉṟu collappaṭum.
4.  aṣṭa kōṇa vimāṉam:
eṭṭup paṭṭaiyāy amaikkappaṭṭirukkum vimāṉam aṣṭa kōṇa vimāṉam eṉappaṭum.
5.  tūṅkāṉai māṭa vimāṉam:
etirppuṟam mara māṭi pōlum iraṇṭu mūlaiyāy piṉṉāl yāṉai mutuku pōl amaikkappaṭum vimāṉaṅkaḷukku kajap piruṣṭa vimāṉam, atti puṣṭa vimāṉam, tūṅkāṉai māṭam eṉṟellām aḻaikkappaṭum.
6.  cakti niḷa vimāṉam:
iraṇṭu pakkam maramāṭiyum oṉṟukku mēṟpaṭṭa kalayaṅkaḷum irukkum vimāṉaṅkaḷukku cakti niḷam, makā tuvāra kōpuram, irāca kōpuram1 eṉṟellām aḻaikkappaṭum.2
aka nāḻikai
aka nāḻikai kōyiliṉ kēntira nilaiyamāka uyir nilai (jīva nāṭi) yāka viḷaṅkukiṟatu.  kōyiliṉ ciṟappellām uṇṇāḻikaiyilum, ataṉ mēluḷḷa vimāṉattilum aṭaṅki yuḷḷatu.  aka nāḻikaiyiṉ muṉpuṟam uḷḷa ciṟu maṇṭapattai iṭai nāḻikai (artta maṇṭapam) eṉṟu kūṟuvar.  aka nāḻikai perumpālum catura vaṭivāka irukkum.  cila iṭaṅkaḷil nīṇṭa catura vaṭivākavum amaikkap peṟṟirukkiṟatu.  cila aka nāḻikaikaḷ vaṭṭa vaṭivilum cila arai vaṭṭa vaṭivilum cila muṭṭai vaṭivilum - atāvatu nīḷ uruṇṭai vaṭivilum (Coval) uḷḷaṉa.  iḵtaṉṟi mukkōṇa vaṭivilō, aiṅkōṇa vaṭivilō, aṟu kōṇa vaṭivilō, aiṅ  kōṇa vaṭivilō, aṟukōṇa vaṭivilō eṇ kōṇa vaṭivilō aka nāḻikaikaḷ kaṭṭappaṭṭiruppatākat teriyavillai.  āṉāl vimāṉaṅkaḷil āṟu paṭṭai vaṭivaṅ
kaḷum eṭṭup paṭṭai vaṭivaṅkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.  avaikaḷukku taṉittaṉi peyarkaḷum uḷḷaṉa.
uṇṇāḻikai
āṉāl vaṭa intiyāvil aṟu kōṇa vaṭivilum eṇ kōṇa vaṭivilum karppak kirakaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉaveṉṟu cilar kūṟukiṟārkaḷ.  nāṉ aṟinta aḷavil eṅkum attakaiya amaippuṭaiya kōyilkaḷ iruppatākat teriyavillai.  namatu nāṭṭil palvēṟu iṭaṅkaḷilum uḷḷa kōyilkaḷai nēriṟ ceṉṟu pārttu uṇṇāḻikaiyiṉ taraiyiṉ varaipaṭaṅkaḷai naṉku veḷiyiṭṭa perkūcaṉ, hēval, ṭellā kiremariṣ, lāṅkarṭ, cōviyōtuprayal, kirēvli pōṉṟa enta mēṉāṭṭāciriyarum inta uṇṇāḻikaikaḷaippaṟṟi etuvum kūṟavillai.
tamiḻ nāṭṭuk kōyil amaippukaḷai āyntāl āyiram āyiram āṇṭukaḷukku muṉpē tamiḻarkaḷ vaṭiviyal cārnta kaṇitattil (Geometrical) nuṇukkamāṉa kaṇitap pulamai peṟṟiruntatu naṉku pulaṉākiṟatu.
nīṇṭa catura vaṭiva aka nāḻikai
tamiḻ nāṭṭil uḷḷa cila periya kōyilkaḷ ellām nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikaiyai uṭaiya kōyilākavē kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  caturak kōyilkaḷai viṭa nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikaiyaiyuṭaiya kōyilkaḷē tamiḻakattil atikamākak kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.  nīṇṭa catura vaṭivāṉa kōyilkaḷ, aka nāḻikaiyil uḷḷa tiru uruva amaippiṟkum pūcai ceyyum civāccāriyārkaḷiṉ vacatikkum ēṟpavē amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  paṭuttirukkum nilaiyil uḷḷa tirumāliṉ kōyil uṇṇāḻikaikaḷ cila nīṇṭa caturamāka irukkiṉṟaṉa.  
tirukkaḻukkuṉṟattiṟku aṇmaiyil uḷḷa uttaraṉ kōyil eṉṉum ūril uḷḷa kōyilāṉatu nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikaiyai (karuppakirukattai) uṭaiya aḻakāṉa amaippaiyuṭaiya kōyi
lākum. (paṭam  pārkka)  intak kōyilil iṭai nāḻikaiyai (artta maṇṭapattai) tavira vēṟu makā maṇṭapamō maṇi
maṇṭapamō pirakāraṅkaḷō amaikkappaṭavillai.  ivvāṟu akanāḻikaiyaic cūḻntu maṇṭapaṅkaḷum pirakāraṅkaḷum iruntāl maṇṭapaṅkaḷiṉ naṭuvil akanāḻikai iṭam peṟṟu kōyilil aḻakaiyum pārvaiyaiyum ciṟpac ciṟappaiyum maṟaittu viṭum.  pala kōyilkaḷil maṇṭapaṅkaḷum pirakāraṅkaḷum peritāka eḻuntu mūlavar amarntirukkum aka nāḻikaiyiṉ mītuḷḷa vimāṉamē teriyā vaṇṇam maṟaittu viṭṭiruppatu kavaṉikkattakkatu.  mēlum kōyilukkuḷ kāṟṟum veḷiccamum pukāta paṭi maṟaittup paṭṭap pakalil iruḷ cūḻntu vauvālkaḷ uṟaiyum pāḻum iṭam pōlāki viṭṭaṉa.  namatu puṉitamāṉa tirukkōyilkaḷil iruḷ cūḻntiruppataṟku mukkiya kāraṇam cuṟṟu maṇṭapaṅkaḷēyākum.  ātiyil tamiḻar kaṇṭa kōyilkaḷ aka nāḻiyai maṭṭum uṭaiyātu appāl iṭai nāḻikai eḻuntatu.  atai aṭuttē eṇṇilā maṇṭapaṅkaḷum piṟkālattil eḻuntu aka nāḻikaiyiṉ aḻakaiyum, ciṟpac ciṟappaiyum kaṇṭu kaḷikka muṭiyāmalum tūymaiyai uṇara muṭiyāmalum cukātārak kuṟaivu uṇṭākumpaṭi ceytu viṭṭatu.
catura vaṭiva aka nāḻikai
mikat toṉmaiyāṉa kālattil, aka nāḻikai (karuppak kirakam) perumpālum catura vaṭivilē amaikkappaṭṭatākat terikiṟatu.  akalamum, nīḷamum camamāka aḷavil vaittu  amaitta aka nāḻikai aḻakum vacatiyum uṭaiyatāka iruntatu.
turōpatai iratam
catura amaippuṭaiya aka nāḻikaiyaik koṇṭa oru kōyilukku  eṭuttukkāṭṭāka māmallapurattil uḷḷa turōpatai iratattai ēṟṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭākak koḷḷalām.  itu turōpataikkāka eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kōyil alla.  turkkai eṉṉum koṟṟavaikkāka eṭuppikkappaṭṭa kōyil ākum.  itu orē pāṟaiyil cīr peṟac cetukki, mikak kaccitamākak kaviṉ peṟak, kāṭcik kiṉiyatākak kaṭṭap peṟṟa karuṅkaṟ kōyilākum.  itu 1300- āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ amaikkappaṭṭa mātirik kōyil eṉṟālum itu puttam putiya kōyil pōl kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.  ikkōyiliṉ muṉ mūṉṟu paṭikaḷ naṉku amaintuḷḷaṉa.
intak kōyilukku iṭai nāḻikaiyum (artta maṇṭapamum) muka maṇṭapamum illai.  aka nāḻikai maṭṭum aḻakuṟap polikiṉṟatu.  aka nāḻikai catura vaṭivil amaikkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  vāyilukku mēlē iraṇṭu vaḷaivuḷḷa makara tōraṇaṅkaḷum irukkiṟatu.  vāyiliṉ iru maruṅkiṉum tuvāra pālikaiyar (peṇ vāyiṟ kāppāḷarkaḷ) uruvaṅkaḷ uḷḷaṉa.  intak karuvaṟaiyiṉ uḷḷē teyvat tiru uruvam illai.  āṉāl uḷ cuvaril koṟṟavaiyiṉ vaṭivam puṭaippuc ciṟpamāka cetukkap paṭṭuḷḷatu.  cuvariṉ veḷippuṟattil mūṉṟu pakkaṅkaḷilum koṟṟavaiyiṉ uruvam cetukkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  namatu varalāṟṟaṟivō, camaya aṟivō, ciṟpa nuṇakkumō atikam peṟāta āṅkila aṟiñarkaḷ ikkōyilai turōpatai iratam eṉṟum uḷḷē irukkum uruvam tirumakaḷ vaṭivam eṉṟum, vāyil kākkum makaḷir pauttarkaḷiṉ talaip pākaikaḷai uṭaiyavarkaḷ eṉṟum kūṟiyuḷḷārkaḷ.1  tamiḻk kalai aṟivum, moḻi aṟivum mikka eṉatu matippiṟkuriya naṇpar uyartiru mayilai cīṉi vēṅkaṭacāmi avarkaḷ itaṟku, tam nūṟkaḷil teḷivāṉa viḷakkam aḷittuḷḷārkaḷ.2  intak kōyil aka nāḻikaiyiṉ mītu amaikkappaṭṭa vimāṉam nāṉku paṭṭaiyāka kāṇappaṭukiṟatu ataṉ nāṉku mūlaikaḷilum curuḷ koṭi aḻakuṟac cetukkappaṭṭuḷḷatu.  vimāṉattil ēṉaiya kōyil vimāṉam pōl karṇak kūṭu pañcaram cālai pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷ illai.  mēlē ucciyil uḷḷa kumpak kalacamum kāṇappaṭa villai.  aka nāḻikai muṉ, iṭai nāḻikaiyum (artta maṇṭapamum) illai.  ikkōyil eḷiya vaṭivil eḻil peṟa amaikkap
paṭṭuḷḷatu.  itu iḷaṅkōyil amaippaiyuṭaiyatu.
iṅku inta iḷaṅkōyiliṉ uruvappaṭamum ataṉ catura vaṭivāṉa taraippaṭamum amaikkap peṟṟuḷḷaṉa.  itē pōṉṟa catura vaṭivilāṉa tiruvaṟaikaḷ (karuvaṟaikaḷ) paṉamalaik kōyililum, kāñcipuram kayilāca nātar kōyililum nākārccuṉa koṇṭāvil kuṭiyēṟiya pautta tuṟavikaḷukkāka pautta camaya pakti mikka peṇ cīmāṭṭiyāl kaṭṭappaṭṭa iru vikāraikaḷum, tirukkaḻukkuṉṟam kukaik kōyililum ciṟṟaṉṉal vāyil aṟivaṉ kōyililum, mēlaic cēri civa ceñcikkuṭaivaraik kōyililum tiruppāppuliyūr kōyililum uḷḷaṉa.
iṅku eṭuttuk kāṭṭap paṭṭirukkum uttaraṉ kōyil kāḷi kuṭi koṇṭirukkum aka nāḻikai cumār 15 aṭi akalamum 20- aṭi akalamum uḷḷa aḻakāṉa aka nāḻikaiyuṭaiyatu.  muṉpuṟam oru ciṟu iṭai nāḻikaiyum peṟṟu māmallapurattil uruvākkap peṟṟa mātirik kōyilaip pōl kaccitamāka viḷaṅkukiṟatu.
namatu nāṭṭilē nīṇṭa catura amaippuḷḷa karuvaṟaikaḷaik koṇṭa kōyilkaḷ pala.  māmallapurattil mātirik kōyilāka uruvākkap peṟṟa kaṇēcaratam - nīṇṭa catura aka nāḻikaiyaik koṇṭatu.
- tamiḻ nāṭṭil maṭṭumalla kēraḷam, āntiram, kaṉṉaṭam pōṉṟa nāṭṭilum vaṭa intiyāvilum pala catura vaṭivāṉa aka nāḻikaiyaiyuṭaiya kōyilkaḷ iruppatāka collappaṭukiṟatu.  avaikaḷ aṉaittum uṇmaiyil catura vaṭivāṉa amaip puṭaiyatalla.  nīṇṭa catura vaṭivamaippai uṭaiyavaikaḷēyākum.  āṉāl akalattai viṭa nīḷam iraṭṭippu maṭaṅku koṇṭavaikaḷ alla.  āṉāl akalam 10 aṭiyum nīḷam 11 aṭiyum irukkum.  ivaṟṟai yellām nīṇṭa catura vaṭivak kōyilākak karutalām.  eṭuttuk kāṭṭāka taḷavāṉūrk kōyil karuvaṟaiyiṉ nīḷam 8 aṭi 6 aṅkulam akalam 7 aṭi 10 aṅkulam; uyaram 6 aṭi 10 aṅkulam  1ivaṟṟaip perumpālōr catura vaṭivak karuvaṟai eṉṟu kūṟukiṉṟaṉar. itu tavaṟu; nīṇṭa catura vaṭiva aka nāḻikaiyēyākum.
muṭṭai vaṭiva aka nāḻikai
muṭṭai vaṭivil tamiḻ nāṭṭil aka nāḻikai amaikkap paṭṭirukkiṟatu.  muṭṭai vaṭivāṉa aka nāḻikai (karppak kirakam) atikam illai.  oṉṟē yoṉṟu tāṉ uṇṭu.  atu kāñcipurattil uḷḷa curaharēcuvarar kōyil ākum.
curaharēcuvarar kōyil
kāñcipuram māvaṭṭattil uḷḷa kāñcipurattil (periya kāñcipurattil) kāñci ēkāmparēcuvarar kōyiliṉ teṟkut teruvil jvara harēvaram eṉṟa peyaril oru kōyil amaintirukkiṟatu.  ikkōyilil iṉṟu pūcai naṭai peṟuvatākat teriyavillai.  itu tilli maiya araciṉ tol poruḷ āyvut tuṟaiyiṉariṉ ātikkattil irukkiṟatu.
pala kōyilkaḷil aka nāḻikaiyiṉ (mūlatāṉattiṉ) mēl uḷḷa vimāṉattaiyum maṇṭapaṅkaḷaiyum, kōpuraṅkaḷaiyum āyntāl aka nāḻikaiyiṉ mēl vimāṉam ciṟitākavum ēka taḷattai uṭaiyatākavum, tāḻntum amaikkappaṭṭirukkum.  pirakāraṅkaḷum, kōpuraṅkaḷum, tirumatilkaḷum aṭukkaṭukkākap parantum virintum uyarntum kāṇappaṭum.  ivai, virintu parantu viyāpittuḷḷa pirapañcattaiyum ataṉuḷ cūṭcamamāka iṟaivaṉ uḷḷāṉ eṉpataiyum kāṭṭukiṟatu eṉṟu ciṟpa nūṟ pulavarkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟārkaḷ.
namatu tiruk kōyiliṉ amaippai pirapañcattiṉ mātiri uruvam (Universe in Miniature) eṉṟu aṟiñarkaḷ kūṟuvar.
kāñci curaharēcuvarar kōyil (civaṉ kōyil) vimāṉam vaṭṭa vaṭivilē amaikkap peṟṟirukkiṟatu.  eṉavē aka nāḻikaiyum vaṭṭa vaṭivamāka amaintuḷḷatu eṉṟu kūṟiviṭukiṉṟārkaḷ.  kōyilkaḷaip paṟṟi nūl eḻutukiṟavarkaḷ kōyiliṉ uyir nāṭiyāka ilaṅkum aka nāḻikaiyaip paṟṟi naṉku āyntu nūl eḻutuvatillai.  akalam nīḷam, uyaram, ākiyavaikaḷai aḷantu viḷakkam kūṟuvatillai. karuvaṟai caturamā nīṇṭa caturamā, vaṭṭamā nīḷ uruṇṭai vaṭivamā (Oval) eṉṟu āyntu pārttu eḻutuvatillai.  pala aṟiñarkaḷ curakarēcuvarar kōyil vimāṉam vaṭṭa vaṭivam eṉṟu eḻuti muṭittu viṭṭārkaḷē yoḻiya aka nāḻikai ettakaiya amaippuṭaiyatu eṉṟu eḻutat tavaṟiviṭṭaṉar.  eṉatu matippiṟkum, aṉpiṟkum uriyavarāy viḷaṅkiya maṟainta (mārc 1940) māmētai ṭākṭar ci. mīṉāṭci em. ē. pi. eyc. ṭi. avarkaḷ kūṭa vaṭṭa vaṭivamāṉa aka nāḻikai eṉṟu tāṉ kuṟippiṭṭirun
tārkaḷē allatu itu muṭṭai vaṭivamāṉatu eṉṟu kuṟippiṭat tavaṟiviṭṭār eṉṟu tāṉ kūṟa vēṇṭum.1  āṉāl namatu tamiḻ nāṭṭu tapatikaḷiṉ paramparaiyil utittavarum, māmallapuram ciṟpakkallūri mutalvarumāṉa uyar tiru. vai. kaṇapati āccāri. pī.ē. avarkaḷ jcurakarēcuvarar kōyiliṉ karuvaṟaiyai (aka nāḻikaiyai)  nēril pārttu āyntu itu nīḷ uruṇṭai vaṭivāṉatu - atāvatu muṭṭai tothdJ(Oval) eṉṟu aiyamaṟa eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷār.  atu aṭiyil varumāṟākum:
karuvaṟai eṉṟu collappaṭum vimāṉattaip peṇ vaṭivam eṉṟum ataṉuḷḷirukkum mūrttiyai utarattil uḷḷa karppam eṉṟum varuṇikkappaṭukiṟatu.  utarattil karppamāka mūrtti amaiyap peṟṟiruppatālēyē ik kaṭṭiṭattaik karppak kiruham eṉṉum karuvaṟai eṉṟum aḻaikkiṉṟōm ikkaruttiṉai valiyuṟuttum poruṭṭē mūlamūrtti vīṟṟiruntaruḷum kaṭṭiṭattaik kukkiṭāṇṭa (kōḻi muṭṭai) vaṭivamākavum amaikkalām eṉṟu ciṟpa nūlkaḷ kūṟukiṉṟaṉa.  ittakaiya kukkiṭāṇṭa vaṭivattil oru kōyil kāñcipurattil nirmāṇikkappaṭṭirukkiṟatu ikkōyil kāñci ēkāmparēcuvarar kōyil teṟku vītiyil jvara harēvaram  eṉṟa peyaril amaikkap peṟṟirukkiṟatu.  eṉṟu kukkiṭāṇṭak karuvaṟai amaippiṟku viḷakkam kūṟi cāṉṟum eṭuttuk kāṭṭiyuḷḷaṉar.2
nīḷ uruṇṭai vaṭivil, kāñci curakarīracuvarar kōyilait tavira vēṟu kōyil eṅkum iruppatākat teriyavillai.
curakarēcuvarar kōyil atirṣṭāṉamum, karuvaṟaiyiṉ veḷippuṟap pakutiyum vimāṉamum aḻakiya ciṟpa nuṭpam ceṟi
vatākat tikaḻkiṉṟatu.
vaṭṭa vaṭivāṉa aka nāḻikai
vaṭṭa vaṭivamāṉa kōyil intiyāvil illai.  tamiḻar

(Geometrical knowledge) eṉṟu viṉāviṉār.  avarukku viṭaiyāka tampī!  nīr eṉṟaikkāvatu namatu tirukkōyilukkuc ceṉṟa tuṇṭā?  itaṟku muṉ pōkā
tiruntālum iṉṟāvatu kōyilukkup pōṅkaḷ.  iṟaivaṉ, tamiḻarkaḷiṉ nuṇṇiya vaṭiviyal kaṇita nuṭpam ettuṇai ciṟappuvāyntatu eṉpatai uṇarttuvāṉ:  namatu kōyilil uḷḷa caturam, nīṇṭa caturam, vaṭṭam, arai vaṭṭam āṟu paṭṭam, eṭṭup paṭṭam mukkōṇam, aṟu kōṇam ākiya vaṭivil āyiram āṇṭu kaḷukku muṉ amaikkappaṭṭa tūṇkaḷum, uṇṇāḻikaikaḷum vimāṉaṅkaḷum ōma kuṇṭaṅkaḷum, kuḷaṅ
kaḷum maṇṭapaṅkaḷum, pōtikaikaḷum, kōyilil tīṭṭappaṭṭa kōlaṅkaḷum malarkaḷiṉ ciṟpaṅkaḷum  kōyilkaḷum teḷivāka uṇarttum eṉṟēṉ.  kaṇitap pulamaiyil paṇṭum, iṉṟum eṉṟum, āṅkilēyar, amerikkar maṭṭumalla uruciyarkaḷum tamiḻarkaḷai miñca muṭiyātu eṉṟu patil viṭuttēṉ.  avar vāy aṭaipaṭṭup pōy viṭṭatu.

mēṟkūṟiya kīḻvāy ilakkattaic cērnta aḷavukaḷum tolkāppiyar kālattilē vaḻaṅkiṉatākat terikiṟatu.  nāṉ iṟṟaikku 65-āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ cāttaṉkuḷattil cūcai muttu vāttiyāriṭam inta vāyppāṭukaḷ payiṉṟiruntatōṭu perukkal, pakuttal, kaḻittal, kūṭṭal mutaliya tamiḻk kaṇakkum ceyyap payiṉṟiruntēṉ.  20-āṇṭukaḷukku muṉ varai tiṇṇaip paḷḷik kūṭaṅkaḷ eṇ cuvaṭi, tāṉap perukkam pōṉṟa kaṇitam ēṭukaḷ eḻuti nāḷ tōṟum paṭittu āciriyariṭam oppuvittuḷḷēṉ.
